detail.abstract:
Cet article mesure la réorganisation de la fonction d'octroi du crédit immobilier d'une banque coopérative française à la suite du choc monétaire de la Banque centrale européenne amorcé en juillet 2022. L'échantillon original compte 700 dossiers tirés du portefeuille de la Caisse d'Épargne Côte d'Azur (352 en 2021, 348 en 2023), ramené à 696 observations pour l'inférence.

Trois méthodes sont mobilisées : régression linéaire multiple à erreurs-types HC3, analyse en composantes principales, et régression poolée avec interactions année × variable complétée par un test de Chow.

Le test de Chow rejette à F(7, 682) = 7,31 (p = 1,78 × 10⁻⁸) l'égalité des deux fonctions d'évaluation. La rupture porte sur deux variables. Le coefficient standardisé du Salaire mensuel passe de +0,413 à +0,761 (interaction +0,349 ; p = 0,051). Celui de la Durée d'emprunt recule de +0,405 à +0,201 (interaction –0,204 ; p = 0,001). Le résultat sur la Durée est robuste à une correction Bonferroni à six tests ; celui sur le Salaire reste à la limite de la significativité conventionnelle. Les autres déterminants — Âge, Taux d'endettement, Statut Marital, Patrimoine Immobilier — n'évoluent pas significativement.

Nous interprétons cette bascule comme l'effet mécanique de la saturation des leviers macroprudentiels français, qui force la banque à reporter l'ajustement sur la sélection salariale ex ante. À notre connaissance, c'est la première formalisation économétrique d'une telle bascule à l'échelle d'un établissement bancaire français, avec test de rupture structurelle et interactions année × variable. La lecture théorique mobilise le canal du crédit (Bernanke et Gertler, 1995) prolongé par l'interaction macroprudentielle. Nous discutons les implications pour le régulateur, les banques et l'accès à la propriété des ménages modestes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用法国一家合作银行2021年和2023年的700份抵押贷款档案数据，通过多重线性回归、主成分分析和Chow检验，发现欧洲央行2022年7月货币冲击后，该银行的信贷评估函数发生了结构性断裂：月薪的标准化系数从+0.413升至+0.761，贷款期限系数从+0.405降至+0.201，而年龄、负债率、婚姻状况和房产财富等其他变量无显著变化。作者将这一转变解释为法国宏观审慎杠杆饱和后银行被迫转向事前薪资筛选的机械效应。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行2022年7月开启的货币冲击如何改变了法国合作银行的抵押贷款审批函数？
AI.motivation: 宏观审慎政策工具饱和后，银行如何调整信贷审批标准以应对货币政策冲击，这一问题缺乏微观层面的计量检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷渠道理论（Bernanke & Gertler, 1995）与宏观审慎政策交互作用。
AI.method: 样本包括700份贷款档案（2021年352份，2023年348份），最终696个有效观测值。采用三种方法：HC3稳健标准误的多重线性回归、主成分分析（PCA）、含年份×变量交互项的 pooled 回归及Chow结构性断点检验。
AI.findings: Chow检验拒绝了两期评估函数相等的原假设（F(7,682)=7.31, p=1.78×10⁻⁸）。断裂主要源于两个变量：月薪标准化系数从+0.413增至+0.761（交互项+0.349, p=0.051）；贷款期限系数从+0.405降至+0.201（交互项−0.204, p=0.001）。期限结果经Bonferroni校正后仍显著，薪资结果处于显著性边界。年龄、负债率、婚姻状况、房产财富无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在法国单一银行层面以计量方法（含结构性断点检验和年份×变量交互项）形式化证明了宏观审慎杠杆饱和后信贷审批函数向事前薪资筛选的转变，拓展了信贷渠道理论的微观应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、银行管理层及中低收入家庭的住房可及性提供了实证参考：利率上升叠加宏观审慎工具饱和后，银行更加依赖借款人薪资水平来筛选风险，可能加剧低收入群体的信贷排斥。

title: The Antitrust Tush Push and Institutional Identity in College Athletics
affiliations: University of Mississippi School of Law

detail.title: The Antitrust Tush Push and Institutional Identity in College Athletics
detail.abstract:
Recent preliminary-injunction antitrust challenges to NCAA athlete-eligibility rules suggest that the NCAA's procompetitive defense is nearing a breaking point. The "antitrust Tush Push" keeps moving the line.

The pressure point is a neglected threshold question. What feature actually differentiates college sports from minor-league alternatives?

This Article argues that the answer is institutional identity, meaning the alumni, regional, cultural, and geographic attachments that explain fan investment in university brands.

On the supply side, Division I athletics increasingly functions as a commercial enterprise housed in universities, often partially subsidized by academic funds and made more explicitly transactional by the post-House settlement revenue-sharing model. On the demand side, consumer interest has remained robust even as the student-athlete model has weakened through the COVID-19 waiver, NIL compensation, transfer-portal liberalization, and one-and-done basketball.

Reframing the product around institutional identity illustrates the vulnerability of the NCAA’s educational-character justifications at Step Two of the Rule of Reason. If the consumer-facing attribute is institutional identity rather than education, many eligibility restraints function as labor-market regulation with only a weak connection to product quality. Durable eligibility governance will therefore require collective bargaining rather than litigation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出NCAA的业余体育规则在反垄断挑战下濒临崩溃，核心问题在于大学体育与次级联盟的本质区别——不是教育属性，而是机构身份（校友、地域、文化等认同）。如果消费者看重的是机构身份而非教育，那么NCAA的资格限制实质上是劳动力市场管制，最终需要集体谈判而非诉讼来维持规则合法性。
AI.research_question: 大学体育与次级职业体育联盟之间的本质区别是什么？NCAA的运动员资格规则在反垄断合理原则分析下能否通过"教育性质"的正当性辩护？
AI.motivation: 近年来NCAA的业余运动员资格规则在反垄断诉讼中屡遭初步禁令挑战，NCAA的"促进竞争"辩护正逼近临界点，亟需重新审视大学体育区别于职业体育的核心特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断合理原则（Rule of Reason）、机构身份理论（Institutional Identity）、劳动力市场管制理论
AI.method: 法律分析、理论论证
AI.findings: 1. 大学体育的核心差异化特征并非"教育特性"，而是机构身份（校友、地域、文化、地理认同）。2. 供给端：D-I体育日益商业化，由学术基金补贴，且在House案后转向收入分成模式。3. 需求端：即便学生运动员模式被削弱（COVID豁免、NIL补偿、转会自由化、一年即走篮球），消费者兴趣依然强劲。4. 将产品重新定义为机构身份，暴露了NCAA的教育性质辩护在合理原则第二步分析中的脆弱性——若消费者看重的是机构身份而非教育，则多数资格限制实质是劳动力市场管制，与产品质量关联微弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"机构身份"作为大学体育区别于职业体育的核心理论框架，重构反垄断合理原则分析中的产品定义，揭示NCAA教育性质辩护的理论漏洞。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学体育反垄断诉讼提供新的分析路径：建议通过集体谈判（而非诉讼）解决资格规则合法性问题；为政策制定者和法院评估NCAA规则的反垄断正当性提供理论工具。

title: The Ballot and the Branch ADR as a Pillar for Sustainable Electoral Governance and Peace in Africa ADDENDUM: A Gender-Responsive Framework for Women's Electoral Justice

detail.title: The Ballot and the Branch ADR as a Pillar for Sustainable Electoral Governance and Peace in Africa ADDENDUM: A Gender-Responsive Framework for Women's Electoral Justice
detail.abstract: This addendum to the original policy paper was developed following its first publication in May 2026 and reflects the author's ongoing practitioner research into the gender dimensions of electoral dispute resolution across East Africa. The arguments presented draw on over fourteen years of professional experience in electoral governance, dispute resolution practice, and institutional capacity building across the region. They are informed by the Women, Peace and Security framework (UNSCR 1325 and successor resolutions), the IFES Practitioner Brief on ADR in Elections, and the IEP Positive Peace framework. This addendum is intended to be read alongside the original paper and may be cited independently. A. THE GENDERED ARCHITECTURE OF ELECTORAL EXCLUSION The original paper established that electoral disputes in Africa encompass complex political, social, and psychological dynamics that litigation alone cannot resolve. This addendum extends that argument to its logical frontier: the recognition that those dynamics are profoundly and structurally gendered-and that electoral ADR systems, however well-designed in principle, reproduce the very exclusions they are meant to address unless gender-responsive design is built into their foundations. Women in African electoral contexts face a dual and compounding exclusion. First, they are structurally underrepresented as candidates, voters, election officials, and political party decision-makers-a participation deficit extensively documented by UN Women, the African Union's Gender, Peace and Development Centre, and the Electoral Integrity Project. Second, and less examined, when women experience electoral violence, intimidation, harassment, or procedural injustice, the formal mechanisms designed to provide redress-electoral dispute resolution bodies, tribunals, and complaint systems-are systemically inaccessible to them. KEY INSIGHT Women are doubly excluded in electoral systems: first from meaningful participation, and second from the justice mechanisms that should protect that participation. ADR that does not address both exclusions simultaneously is structurally incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文是对原政策文件的补充，探讨东非选举争议解决中的性别维度，指出选举替代性争议解决（ADR）机制若缺乏性别响应设计，会复制其本应解决的排斥问题。女性面临双重排斥：一是结构性参与不足，二是当遭遇选举暴力或不公时，正式救济机制在系统上对她们不可及。
AI.research_question: 东非选举争议解决机制如何体现和复制性别排斥？如何通过性别响应设计来克服这种双重排斥？
AI.motivation: 原论文已指出选举争议涉及政治、社会和心理等多重维度，诉讼无法解决。本文将其推至逻辑前沿：这些维度在结构上是性别化的，若缺乏性别响应设计，ADR系统会复制其本应解决的排斥。
AI.theoretical_framework: 妇女、和平与安全框架（UNSCR 1325及后续决议）；IFES选举ADR从业者简报；IEP积极和平框架。
AI.method: 基于作者在东非地区超过十四年选举治理、争议解决实践和机构能力建设的专业经验，结合实践者研究。
AI.findings: 女性在东非选举语境中面临双重且复合的排斥：第一，作为候选人、选民、选举官员和政党决策者，结构性代表不足；第二，当遭遇选举暴力、恐吓、骚扰或程序不公时，旨在提供救济的正式机制（选举争议解决机构、法庭、投诉系统）在系统上对她们不可及。若不同时解决这两种排斥，ADR在结构上是不完整的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将性别分析系统性地引入选举争议解决领域，提出"双重排斥"概念，阐明ADR机制可能无意中复制性别排斥的理论逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为选举治理实践者提供性别响应型ADR设计的理论基础和行动方向，强调性别响应设计必须嵌入ADR系统的基础，而非事后补救。

title: Welfare Litigation, State Courts, and Social Citizenship
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: Welfare Litigation, State Courts, and Social Citizenship
detail.abstract: For half a century, federal courts have stood at the center of welfare rights enforcement. That era is ending. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act's historic cuts to Medicaid and SNAP will generate an avalanche of benefit terminations, work requirement sanctions, and overpayment actions from state agencies. And with a federal judiciary increasingly hostile to the private enforcement of public law, state courts will become not just a concurrent forum for welfare litigation, but an increasingly important one. Understanding how state courts have handled welfare litigation over the past three decades, then, is essential to anticipating what comes next. This Article is the first to offer a typology of state court review of welfare administration across the United States over the last thirty years. Cases decided since the 1996 Welfare Reform Act reveal three distinct categories of litigation-challenges to agency decisions brought by claimants, overpayment actions brought by states, and reimbursement disputes brought by providers-each with different doctrinal patterns and access-to-justice concerns. The resulting picture challenges two scholarly understandings: the federal courts as the premier fora for civil rights, and state courts as mere sites of routinized dispute processing. State courts regularly adjudicate public benefit controversies, often involving unrepresented claimants, and have developed distinctive approaches to reviewing agency action. organizational infrastructure capable of transforming individual grievances into systemic challenges. The welfare rights tradition need not end, but it must find a new home.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对美国过去三十年间州法院审理福利诉讼的情况进行了类型学分析，揭示了联邦法院在福利权利执法中的核心地位正在终结，而州法院将成为日益重要的福利诉讼论坛。
AI.research_question: 过去三十年间，美国各州法院如何处理福利行政案件？这些案件呈现怎样的类型学特征和司法审查模式？
AI.motivation: 《一项大而美的法案》对Medicaid和SNAP的大幅削减将引发大量福利终止、工作要求制裁和超额付款诉讼，而联邦司法系统对公共法律的私人执行日益敌视，因此州法院将成为福利诉讼的重要论坛。理解州法院过去三十年的福利审判实践，对于预测未来发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利权利执法理论、类型学分析方法、联邦与州司法系统的比较理论、程序正义与司法可及性理论。
AI.method: 对1996年《福利改革法案》以来各州法院判决的类型学分析，通过法律案例研究构建三种诉讼类型的分类体系。
AI.findings: 州法院福利诉讼呈现三种类型：申请人质疑机构决定的诉讼、州政府提起的超额付款诉讼、以及提供者提起的报销纠纷诉讼。每种类型都有不同的教义模式和司法可及性问题。研究发现挑战了两项学术共识：一是联邦法院是民权的主要论坛，二是州法院仅仅是常规化纠纷处理场所。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建了州法院福利行政诉讼的类型学框架，修正了学界对联邦与州法院在福利权利保护中角色的传统理解，揭示了州法院在公共福利争议中的实质性司法审查功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对联邦福利削减后州法院将成为福利权利保护新阵地的现实提供了实证基础和行动指南，指出了州法院系统中当事人无律师代理等司法可及性问题。

detail.abstract: ICC records), the analysis demonstrates that collective punishment is not an expression of "entrenched savagery" in any ethnic or regional group but rather a deliberate state and paramilitary tactic to break civilian resistance, effect demographic change, and dismantle state institutions. The paper introduces the concept of extended hatred as a political technology transmitted through narratives, legal decrees, and fatwas. Tables and Mermaid diagrams illustrate causal mechanisms. Findings show that from the Mahdi's circular on marriage annulment to Al-Bashir's Janjaweed to the 2023 ethnic detention campaigns, the same administrative logic of "total spoils" repeats. Policy implications emphasize transitional justice, disarming ethnic narratives, and a comprehensive Sudanese-Sudanese dialogue.

AI.tldr: 本文通过ICC记录等证据，论证了苏丹的集体惩罚并非源于任何民族或地区的"根深蒂固的野蛮性"，而是一种蓄意的国家及准军事策略，旨在瓦解平民抵抗、实现人口变迁和摧毁国家机构。论文提出了"扩展的仇恨"这一概念，将其视为通过叙事、法律法令和法特瓦传播的政治技术。研究发现，从马赫迪的婚姻无效通告到巴希尔的金戈威德武装，再到2023年的种族拘留运动，同样的"全部战利品"行政逻辑反复出现。
AI.research_question: 苏丹的集体惩罚行为是根深蒂固的种族/地区野蛮性的表达，还是一种蓄意的国家及准军事政治策略？"扩展的仇恨"如何作为一种政治技术在苏丹历史中运作？
AI.motivation: 揭示苏丹集体惩罚背后的真实逻辑，反驳将其简单归因为种族或地区"野蛮性"的简化论解释，揭示其作为系统性的国家策略的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: "扩展的仇恨"（extended hatred）作为政治技术的概念；"全部战利品"（total spoils）的行政逻辑。
AI.method: 基于ICC记录等档案资料的分析；使用表格和Mermaid图表说明因果机制。
AI.findings: 从马赫迪的婚姻无效通告到巴希尔的金戈威德武装，再到2023年的种族拘留运动，苏丹历史上反复出现"全部战利品"的行政逻辑；集体惩罚是蓄意的国家及准军事策略，旨在瓦解平民抵抗、实现人口变迁和摧毁国家机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"扩展的仇恨"这一新概念，将其定义为通过叙事、法律法令和法特瓦传播的政治技术，为理解集体暴力的制度化机制提供了理论工具。

detail.abstract: This study examines the determinants of retirement security in the Visegrad Four (V4) countries, evaluating the endogenous linkages among residential housing wealth, financial capability, credit market maturity, and long-term care infrastructure. We examine the structural and behavioral frictions driving late-life economic vulnerabilities in post-transition economies. While high regional homeownership rates historically served as a defensive cushion, this extreme concentration of illiquid real assets poses a structural obstacle due to low digital financial literacy and underdeveloped retail financial markets. Consequently, locked-in housing equity hinders late-life consumption smoothing, elevating elderly poverty risks and deteriorating living conditions rather than improving retirement security. We contribute to the urban and pension economics literature by framing housing as a critical but undergoverned component of retirement frameworks, providing direct policy implications for coordinated housing, finance, and social protection reforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨维谢格拉德四国（V4）退休保障的决定因素，重点分析住宅房产财富、金融能力、信贷市场成熟度和长期照护基础设施之间的内生关联，发现高住房拥有率与低数字金融素养共同导致住房资产被锁定，反而加剧老年贫困。
AI.research_question: 在维谢格拉德四国（V4）转型经济体中，住宅房产财富如何通过金融能力、信贷市场和长期照护等内生机制影响退休保障？
AI.motivation: V4国家拥有极高的住房拥有率，但居民却面临严重的退休不安全问题。这种看似矛盾的"有房却贫困"现象亟需解释。现有文献忽视了住房作为退休框架中一个关键但治理不足的组成部分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将住房纳入退休经济学的分析框架，强调住房资产流动性约束理论、消费平滑理论以及转型经济中的制度性摩擦。
AI.method: 对V4国家进行结构性分析，考察住房财富、金融素养、信贷市场和长期照护之间的内生联系。
AI.findings: 高居住房拥有率曾作为防御缓冲，但极端集中于非流动性实体资产、低数字金融素养和不发达的零售金融市场，导致住房资产被锁定，阻碍晚年消费平滑，反而加剧老年贫困风险，恶化居住条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将住房界定为退休框架中关键但治理不足的组成部分，拓展城市经济学与养老金经济学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房、金融和社会保障的协调改革提供直接政策启示。

title: The Fall Of Democracy

detail.title: The Fall Of Democracy
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the condition of Indian democracy through the history, constitutional structure, and contemporary political meaning of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest and Sonam Wangchuk's 2026 hunger strike. The title, The Fall of Democracy, is a warning rather than a declaration that India has ceased to hold meaningful elections. India remains a competitive, federal, multiparty republic with an active judiciary, a vast civil society, regular transfers of power in many states, and an electorate that has repeatedly surprised incumbents. Yet democracy is more than the counting of votes. It also depends on free expression, equal citizenship, institutional restraint, governmental accountability, transparent political finance, legislative scrutiny, federal balance, and the ability of citizens to protest without being treated as enemies of the state.

The paper reconstructs Indian democracy from colonial rule and the Constituent Assembly to the present. It identifies the democratic achievements and nationally significant controversies of every Union government, while devoting particular attention to the concentration of executive power and civil-liberties disputes under the government in office from 2014 to the source cutoff. It analyzes the Emergency of 1975-77 as India's clearest historical breakdown, but also argues that modern democratic erosion is often incremental, legalistic, and electorally ratified. Comparative chapters draw parallels - and important distinctions - with Weimar Germany, Fascist Italy, Hungary, Turkey, Venezuela, Poland, Chile, and other cases of democratic backsliding or collapse.

The CJP movement arose in May 2026 amid youth anger over alleged examination-paper leaks, the cancellation and rescheduling of a national medical entrance examination affecting millions of candidates, unemployment anxieties, and a controversial judicial reference to unemployed youth as "cockroaches." The movement transformed the insult into a symbol of resilience and demanded the resignation of the Union Education Minister, systemic examination reform, accountability, compensation for families affected by examination-related student suicides, and stronger mental-health support. Sonam Wangchuk began an indefinite fast at Jantar Mantar on 28 June 2026. On 18 July, the twenty-first day of the fast, authorities moved him to Safdarjung Hospital against his expressed wish, citing medical advice and a Delhi High Court direction to monitor and intervene if necessary (Reuters 2026a; Associated Press 2026a).

The paper places this fast within the Indian political tradition of bodily protest: Gandhi's fasts, the 1929 Lahore jail hunger strike and the death of Jatin Das, Potti Sriramulu's fatal fast for an Andhra state, Irom Sharmila's sixteen-year protest against the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, the anti-corruption fasts of Anna Hazare, environmental fasts, and Wangchuk's earlier Ladakh campaigns. Hunger strikes can dramatize exclusion and create moral urgency, but they also raise difficult questions about coercion, consent, state duties to preserve life, and the substitution of personal sacrifice for institutional deliberation.

The central conclusion is conditional. Indian democracy has not simply "fallen," but several safeguards have weakened, and the costs of political exclusion are increasingly displaced onto citizens, journalists, students, minorities, opposition parties, and protesters. The CJP episode demonstrates a wider legitimacy problem: when ordinary channels of representation appear unresponsive, young citizens may conclude that only virality, street occupation, or bodily risk can make the state listen. The proper democratic response is neither romanticization of starvation nor suppression of dissent. It is credible institutional reform - independent examination administration, transparent investigations, parliamentary accountability, protected protest, federal and judicial restraint, and a politics that treats the young as citizens rather than as a demographic resource.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蟑螂党（CJP）抗议和Sonam Wangchuk 2026年绝食事件，警示印度民主制度正在遭受侵蚀。印度仍保有选举民主形式，但言论自由、公民平等、制度制衡等民主实质正被削弱，公民日益需要以身体风险换取国家倾听。
AI.research_question: 印度民主制度的现状如何？通过历史梳理和当代抗议事件分析，判断印度民主是否已经"衰落"。
AI.motivation: 印度表面维持着竞争性多党选举等民主形式，但公民需通过极端方式（如绝食、病毒式传播）才能使国家回应诉求，这引发了对民主实质是否遭到侵蚀的深层担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主的多维定义（不止于投票，还包括自由表达、平等公民权、制度约束、政府问责等）；民主侵蚀的渐进性、法律化和选举合法化理论；与魏玛德国、匈牙利、委内瑞拉等国家的比较案例研究。
AI.method: 历史制度分析（从殖民时期到制宪会议再到当代）；案例研究（CJP抗议、Wangchuk绝食）；比较政治分析（与多国民主倒退案例进行对比）。
AI.findings: 印度民主未完全"崩溃"，但多个制度保障已被削弱；政治排斥的成本日益转移到公民、记者、学生、少数群体和抗议者身上；传统的代表渠道失灵时，公民只能通过病毒式传播、街头占领或身体风险来寻求回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了民主"崩溃"与民主"侵蚀"的概念，强调现代民主倒退往往是渐进、合法且经选举确认的；将身体抗议（绝食）纳入民主理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了民主改革的具体方向：独立的考试管理、透明的调查、议会问责、受保护的抗议权、联邦与司法克制，以及将年轻人视为公民而非人口资源的新政治理念。

title: Children as Canaries: Disaggregating the Sentinel Claim into Three Mechanisms of Early Harm

detail.title: Children as Canaries: Disaggregating the Sentinel Claim into Three Mechanisms of Early Harm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: The claim that children function as canaries for harms later reaching adults is intuitive, rhetorically powerful, and used loosely. It is applied indiscriminately to cases sharing only the fact that children were hurt. This paper does not argue that every harm announces itself in children first; harms attaching to adult roles have no pediatric precursor and none should be sought. It argues that a real and recurring pattern in the documented record is being obscured by the imprecision, and that the sentinel claim collapses three mechanisms with different causal structures, different evidence, and different remedies. Mechanism one, sentinel proper, describes harm registering first in children through developmental susceptibility and becoming legible in adults only later: leaded gasoline, where 170 million Americans were exposed as children and roughly 824 million cumulative IQ points and 151 million excess mental disorders arrived decades after the pediatric signal; the Great Smog, where prize cattle sickened before the human toll was counted; radioiodine concentrated through milk at Nevada and Hanford; and swill milk in New York. Mechanism two, targeted selection, describes harm in which children were chosen because they were children: the devshirme, which took roughly 200,000 boys; the Mamluk system, which excluded its own elite's sons and so required perpetual purchase; Canada's residential schools, through which more than 150,000 children passed and at least 4,200 died; Willowbrook; Fernald; and the North Carolina Eugenics Board, which sterilized more than 7,600 people, some as young as ten. Fernald establishes the decisive point: a federal advisory committee found the radiation doses unlikely to have caused physical injury and concluded the studies wronged the boys regardless. Mechanism two is not a dose story. Mechanism three, captive absorption, describes children neither selected nor more susceptible who could not leave: asbestos in roughly 34,800 schools, lead in public housing, Flint, and 4 million lead service lines still in the ground. Only the first is a sentinel effect. The second and third are childism. The paper closes on a recourse asymmetry running from North Carolina, where fewer than 220 of more than 7,600 sterilized people were ever compensated, to the contemporary platform cases, where the barriers defeating child plaintiffs are general rather than child-specific, and therefore will not yield to child-specific advocacy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地解构了“儿童是哨兵（canary）”这一隐喻，指出其被滥用且掩盖了三种因果机制不同的伤害类型：真正的哨兵效应（儿童因发育易感性先受伤害）、针对性选择（因是儿童而被选中的伤害）和被动吸收（无法逃离环境而受害）。只有第一种是真正的哨兵效应，后两种实为“儿童歧视”（childism）。文章还指出了赔偿不对称和当代平台案件中儿童原告面临的普遍性障碍。
AI.research_question: “儿童是哨兵（可以提前预警成人危害）”这一说法在多大程度上是准确的？不同伤害类型背后的因果机制、证据和应对方案有何差异？
AI.motivation: “儿童是哨兵”的说法直观且具有修辞力量，但被不加区分地用于所有儿童受害的案例，掩盖了不同伤害类型在因果结构、证据要求和补救措施上的本质差异，导致误诊和不当应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哨兵效应机制（三种类型）：哨兵效应（sentinel proper）、针对性选择（targeted selection）、被动吸收（captive absorption）；儿童歧视（childism）概念；赔偿不对称（recourse asymmetry）理论。
AI.method: 概念辨析与案例分析：含铅汽油、伦敦大雾、放射性碘牛奶、纽约泔水牛奶（机制一）；德夫希尔梅制度、马穆鲁克制度、加拿大寄宿学校、威洛布鲁克、弗纳尔德、北卡罗来纳优生委员会（机制二）；学校石棉、公共住房铅、弗林特水危机、铅服务管道（机制三）。
AI.findings: 1. 只有机制一（哨兵效应）符合“儿童先受伤、成人后显现”的因果关系。2. 机制二（针对性选择）的伤害核心不在于剂量或生理损伤，而在于儿童被当作工具对待的伦理错误。3. 机制三（被动吸收）的伤害源于儿童无法脱离有害环境。4. 后两种机制本质上是“儿童歧视”（childism），而非哨兵效应。5. 赔偿存在严重不对称：北卡罗来纳州7,600多名被绝育者中仅不到220人获得赔偿。6. 当代平台案件中儿童原告面临的障碍是普遍性的而非儿童特有的，因此儿童专属的 advocacy 无法解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统性地解构和澄清了“儿童是哨兵”这一被广泛误用的概念，将其拆解为三种截然不同的因果机制。2. 引入“儿童歧视”（childism）概念来解释针对性选择和被动吸收这两种伤害类型。3. 提出“赔偿不对称”概念，揭示了对儿童伤害的制度性补偿缺失。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者和公共卫生从业者提供了区分不同类型儿童伤害的分析框架，避免误用“哨兵”修辞。2. 指出了当代平台案件（如社交媒体对儿童的伤害）中，儿童原告面临的障碍是普遍性的而非儿童特有的，因此需要超越儿童专属 advocacy 的解决方案。3. 为历史性的儿童伤害案件（如优生绝育、寄宿学校）提供了更精确的道德和法律归责框架。

title: A Commercial Ceasefire: Why the EU-US Data Privacy Framework Cannot Survive Schrems III

detail.title: A Commercial Ceasefire: Why the EU-US Data Privacy Framework Cannot Survive Schrems III

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a doctrinal legal analysis based on published case law, legislation, and secondary scholarship. It did not involve human participants, personal data collection, or case studies requiring consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The adequacy mechanism under GDPR Article 45 is structurally incapable of delivering legal certainty across divergent constitutional orders without a binding international treaty. Despite representing the most sophisticated transatlantic data transfer arrangement to date, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework remains a 'commercial ceasefire' built on executive discretion rather than structural reform and is likely to face invalidation in a future 'Schrems III' before the CJEU Grand Chamber. The paper begins by isolating the 'essential equivalence' standard established in Schrems I and Schrems II as the constitutional metric against which the Framework must be judged. It then analyses the architecture of the DPF, specifically Executive Order 14086's necessity and proportionality safeguards and the Data Protection Review Court, before examining the General Court's pragmatic endorsement of these mechanisms in Latombe v Commission (2025). Three unresolved deficits are identified. First, an independence deficit: the DPRC remains a creation of the executive branch lacking statutory permanence. Second, a proportionality mismatch: the US balancing standard for surveillance does not equate to the EU's strict necessity requirement. Third, a systemic conflict of laws: US processors complying with FISA Section 702 orders inevitably breach GDPR Articles 29 and 48. True legal certainty cannot be achieved through administrative patches, and only a binding international treaty can resolve the fundamental tension between US national security architecture and EU fundamental rights law.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了GDPR第45条的充分性机制在缺乏具有约束力的国际条约的情况下，无法在不同宪政秩序之间提供法律确定性。EU-US数据隐私框架尽管是迄今最成熟的跨大西洋数据传输安排，但本质上是建立在行政裁量权而非结构性改革之上的"商业休战"，可能在未来的"Schrems III"案中被欧盟法院大审判庭宣告无效。文章识别了三个未解决的缺陷：独立性缺陷、比例性错位以及系统性法律冲突，最终结论是只有具有约束力的国际条约才能解决美国国家安全架构与欧盟基本权利法之间的根本张力。
AI.research_question: EU-US数据隐私框架（DPF）能否在欧盟与美国不同的宪政秩序之间实现法律确定性？GDPR第45条的充分性机制是否足以解决跨大西洋数据传输中的结构性冲突？
AI.motivation: 自Schrems I和Schrems II以来，欧盟-美国数据 transfer 机制屡遭无效化，EU-US数据隐私框架作为最新安排仍面临法律不确定性。2025年Latombe案的务实认可并未解决根本问题，有必要系统评估该框架的宪法合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: "基本等同"标准（Essential Equivalence Standard，源自Schrems I和Schrems II）、欧盟比例性原则（严格必要性）、美国国家安全法与欧盟基本权利法之间的冲突法分析。
AI.method: 法律教义学分析（Doctrinal Legal Analysis）：通过对Schrems I、Schrems II、Latombe案等判例法的梳理，结合对行政命令14086、数据保护审查法院（DPRC）等制度架构的文本分析，识别结构性缺陷。
AI.findings: (1) 独立性缺陷：DPRC是行政部门的产物，缺乏法定永久性；(2) 比例性错位：美国的监控平衡标准不等同于欧盟的严格必要性要求；(3) 系统性法律冲突：遵守FISA第702条命令的美国处理者不可避免地违反GDPR第29条和第48条。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GDPR第45条充分性机制的局限性——在缺乏国际条约的情况下，行政性安排无法在不同宪政秩序间提供宪法级别的法律确定性；提出了从"行政修补"到"条约解决"的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律从业者提供了清晰的评估框架，预见未来Schrems III案的核心争议焦点；建议推动具有约束力的国际条约作为解决跨大西洋数据流动法律不确定性的最终方案。

title: Should I stay or should I go? The role of fluid and crystallized intelligence onretirement decisions
affiliations: Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore di Milano and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Should I stay or should I go? The role of fluid and crystallized intelligence onretirement decisions
detail.abstract: We combine insights from cognitive psychology and economics to distinguish crystallized from fluid intelligence and assess their role in the decision to work longer. We use data from the Survey on Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), employing cognitive tests to construct indicators of fluid and crystallized intelligence. We investigate the probability of retirement and the distance between actual retirement age and ordinary retirement age. Our main findings reveal differential contributions of the two cognitive domains to retirement decisions, suggesting that crystallized intelligence plays a compensatory role in maintaining older workers’ employability. This has implications for active aging policies, emphasizing the potential of knowledge-based tasks and on-the-job training to enhance the productivity andworkability of our aging workforce.

AI.tldr: 本文结合认知心理学和经济学，区分了晶体智力与流体智力，并评估了它们在延迟退休决策中的作用。使用SHARE欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查数据，通过认知测试构建两种智力指标，研究发现晶体智力在维持老年劳动者就业能力方面发挥补偿作用，对积极老龄化政策有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 晶体智力与流体智力如何影响老年工作者的退休决策？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化，理解哪些认知能力有助于延长工作寿命，对于制定有效的积极老龄化政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知心理学中晶体智力（积累的知识与经验）与流体智力（逻辑推理与信息处理能力）的区分；经济学中的退休决策理论。
AI.method: 使用SHARE欧洲跨国面板数据，通过认知测试构建流体与晶体智力指标，分析退休概率及实际退休年龄与法定退休年龄的差距。
AI.findings: 两种认知能力对退休决策有不同的贡献：晶体智力在维持老年劳动者就业能力方面发挥补偿作用，有助于延迟退休。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知心理学中的晶体/流体智力区分应用于退休决策研究，为"认知补偿"机制提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为积极老龄化政策提供了方向：强调知识型任务和在职培训的重要性，通过提升晶体智力来增强老年劳动力的生产力和工作能力。

title: Detecting Genuine Doctrinal Ambiguity: A Multi-Layer Framework for Identifying Structural Indeterminacy in Judicial Reasoning
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Detecting Genuine Doctrinal Ambiguity: A Multi-Layer Framework for Identifying Structural Indeterminacy in Judicial Reasoning
detail.abstract: Legal indeterminacy has been extensively theorized in jurisprudence and partially formalized in computational law, yet no framework bridges theoretical accounts of indeterminacy and scalable, grounded detection. This article makes three contributions. First, it develops the distinction between shallow ambiguity (resolvable through further research) and genuine ambiguity (a structural feature of the law itself), a distinction implicit but undertheorized in both the Hart-Dworkin debate and the computational law tradition from Allen through Prakken. Second, it proposes a five-type taxonomy of genuine indeterminacy (semantic, normative, methodological, jurisdictional, analogical) and specifies the Gray Area Detection Framework: eighteen tests in three layers mapping the taxonomy onto extraction-time, aggregation-time, and structural detection strategies. Third, it specifies a pre-registrable validation methodology with explicit confirmation and disconfirmation criteria, a commitment to release the resulting expert-annotated benchmark, and a companion interventional modality, posture-dispersion measurement over the same verified substrate (Brodskiy and Pokov 2026), that supplies method-independent convergent validity. The practical stakes are professional: systems that cannot distinguish settled from contested law present contested conclusions with unwarranted confidence, and explicit indeterminacy detection is a precondition of responsible legal AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个桥接法律不确定性理论与可扩展检测的框架，区分了浅层歧义与真正歧义，构建了五类真正不确定性的分类法及灰度区域检测框架（18项测试、三层策略），并设计了可预注册的验证方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能桥接法律不确定性理论又能实现可扩展、有根基的检测的框架？
AI.motivation: 法律不确定性在法理学中已被广泛理论化，并在计算法学中部分形式化，但尚无框架能够将不确定性的理论论述与可扩展、有根基的检测相衔接。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈特-德沃金辩论中隐含但未充分理论化的区分（浅层歧义与真正歧义）；法律不确定性的五类分类法（语义、规范、方法、管辖权、类比）；灰度区域检测框架
AI.method: 提出18项测试的三层检测框架（提取层、聚合层、结构层），映射五类不确定性分类法；设计可预注册的验证方法，包含明确的确认与否定标准；采用姿态离散度测量作为方法独立的收敛效度验证
AI.findings: 区分了浅层歧义（可通过进一步研究解决）与真正歧义（法律本身的结构性特征）；构建了五类真正不确定性的系统分类法；提出了三层18项测试的可操作检测框架
AI.theory_contributions: 明确界定了长期隐含于哈特-德沃金辩论及计算法学传统中的浅层歧义与真正歧义之区分；系统化了法律不确定性的五类分类法
AI.practical_contributions: 为负责任的AI法律部署提供了前提条件——明确的不确定性检测；防止系统将争议性结论以不当自信呈现；提供了可预注册的验证方法论及公开基准数据集

title: A Multi-Axis Pre-Deployment Predictor of Cross-City Fairness-Audit Transfer in Spatial Crime Models: Evidence from a Twenty-Two-City UK Cohort
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: A Multi-Axis Pre-Deployment Predictor of Cross-City Fairness-Audit Transfer in Spatial Crime Models: Evidence from a Twenty-Two-City UK Cohort
detail.abstract: We ask whether ship-gate failure of cross-city fairness-audit transfer in spatial crime models can be predicted before deployment from properties of a holdout city, where ship-gate failure is the joint criterion of (mean |∆DIR|, max |∆DIR|, count of |∆DIR| > 10) and DIR is the disparity index ratio of top-decile predicted-violent-crime flagging in above-median versus below-median demographic cells on a given axis. We assemble a twenty-two-city UK production cohort (nineteen Tier 2 cities plus three Tier 1 baselines) using police incident data from data.police.uk over a 35-36-month window, fit per-city violent-crime spatial models on H3 r9 hexagonal cells (≈ 0.105 km 2) using a gradient-boosting ensemble, and audit DIR on three minority axes from the 2021 UK Census and one deprivation axis from the English Index of Multiple Deprivation 2019 and Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2019. We construct four single-feature pre-deployment predictors (three minority-axis predictors measuring the percentage of top-decile predicted-violent-crime cells above the within-city median on each axis; plus a graded three-level ordinal IMD-severity indicator), calibrate class boundaries on a 20-city retroactive set (17 Tier 2 + 3 Tier 1), and test two post-calibration cities (Southampton, Portsmouth) prospectively. The four-axis aggregate score yields perfect boundary-score separation of the Tier 2 cohort: score = 0 maps to ship-gate PASS for 4/4 cities (100%); score ≥ 2 maps to non-PASS for 10/10 cities (100%); the middle band (score = 1) is heterogeneous across 5 cities (4 PASS, 1 MARGINAL, 0 TRIPLE-FAIL), with zero rank inversions across all 171 Tier 2 city pairs at the published thresholds. A six-mechanism failure taxonomy assigns every non-PASS verdict to a predictor-detectable mechanism family. Event-probability calibration via Brier score with Murphy decomposition across 46 (city, type) pairs shows all 46 calibration slopes within the conventional 30% deviation flag threshold. Within the UK jurisdictional scope, pre-deployment city properties are sufficient to predict cross-city fairness-audit ship-gate failure; classification at the middle score band requires per-axis review. Findings should not be generalized cross-jurisdictionally without re-calibration.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种部署前预测方法，利用留出城市的单特征指标（少数群体轴百分比+剥夺严重程度分级），成功预测跨城市空间犯罪模型公平性审计的“船闸失效”（ship-gate failure）。基于22个英国城市数据，四轴聚合评分实现了Tier 2城市队列的完美边界分离（得分0=100%通过，得分≥2=100%不通过），并建立了六机制失效分类法。
AI.research_question: 能否在部署前，仅利用留出城市的属性（而非目标城市数据），预测跨城市公平性审计迁移中的“船闸失效”？
AI.motivation: 跨城市迁移公平性审计（fairness-audit transfer）是算法公平领域的关键挑战，但缺乏在部署前预测审计失败的系统方法。本文旨在填补这一空白，为城市级预测模型提供实用的预检工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 公平性审计迁移理论（cross-city fairness-audit transfer）；2. 空间犯罪模型中的差异指数比（DIR）；3. 船闸失效联合判据（均值|ΔDIR|、最大值|ΔDIR|、|ΔDIR|>10的计数）；4. 六机制失效分类法；5. Brier分数与Murphy分解的校准评估。
AI.method: 数据：英国22城市（19个Tier 2 + 3个Tier 1基线），data.police.uk 35-36个月警察事件数据。建模：每个城市独立拟合暴力犯罪空间模型（H3 r9六边形网格≈0.105 km²），使用梯度提升集成。审计：在三个少数群体轴（2021英国人口普查）和一个剥夺轴（IMD 2019）上计算DIR。预测器：四个单特征部署前预测器（三个少数群体轴预测器：高于城市中位数的top十分位预测暴力犯罪细胞百分比；一个三级有序IMD严重程度指标）。校准：20城市回顾性集（17 Tier 2 + 3 Tier 1）校准类别边界；南安普顿和朴茨茅斯前瞻性测试。
AI.findings: 1. 四轴聚合评分实现Tier 2城市完美边界分离：得分0→4/4城市通过（100%）；得分≥2→10/10城市不通过（100%）；得分=1的中等带5城市异质（4通过，1边缘，0三重失败），无排名反转。2. 六机制失效分类法将所有非通过判定归入预测器可检测的机制家族。3. Brier分数与Murphy分解显示所有46个（城市，类型）对的校准斜率均在30%偏差阈值内。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提出并验证了部署前预测跨城市公平性审计失败的方法论框架。2. 建立了六机制失效分类法，为理解公平性迁移失败提供了理论分类体系。3. 证明了城市级属性（而非模型参数）足以预测审计迁移结果，拓展了公平性审计迁移的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市管理者提供了一种低成本的部署前预筛工具，避免在敏感城市部署可能产生严重公平性问题的犯罪预测模型。2. 四轴聚合评分提供了直观的“红绿灯”分类机制（通过/需审查/不通过），便于决策者快速判断。3. 中等分数带需逐轴审查的建议，提供了精细化的风险管理路径。4. 警告跨管辖区泛化需重新校准，强调了模型应用的地域边界。

title: Bridging Legacy Core Banking to Both U.S. Instant Payment Rails: FedNow and RTP
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bridging Legacy Core Banking to Both U.S. Instant Payment Rails: FedNow and RTP

declarations.funderStatement: This work was conducted independently and received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The United States operates two ISO 20022 instant payment networks — the Federal Reserve's FedNow Service and The Clearing House's RTP® — yet fewer than 1,700 of the nation's 10,000+ eligible financial institutions are connected to FedNow and fewer than 1,100 to RTP. The central barrier is legacy core banking integration: 73% of non-connected institutions cite their existing core systems as a moderate-to-severe obstacle. This paper presents OpenFedNow, an open-source dual-rail middleware layer that bridges legacy core banking platforms (Fiserv, FIS, and Jack Henry) to both instant payment networks simultaneously. The architecture comprises five layers: Rail Gateways, an Anti-Corruption Layer, a Shadow Ledger, a Saga Orchestration engine, and Vendor Adapters. The design draws directly on production experience building PIX integration at Santander Brazil — one of the most demanding real-time payment deployments in the world — and adapts that architecture to the structural requirements of U.S. rails. All three vendor adapters are complete and the project is released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenFedNow，一个开源中间件架构，通过五层设计（Rail Gateways、Anti-Corruption Layer、Shadow Ledger、Saga Orchestration、Vendor Adapters）桥接美国传统核心银行系统与FedNow和RTP两大即时支付网络，借鉴巴西PIX生产经验，解决核心系统集成障碍。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个开源中间件架构，使美国传统核心银行平台（Fiserv、FIS、Jack Henry）能够同时接入FedNow和RTP两大即时支付网络？
AI.motivation: 美国虽有两大ISO 20022即时支付网络（FedNow和RTP），但10,000多家合格金融机构中，接入FedNow的不到1,700家，接入RTP的不到1,100家。73%未接入机构将核心系统视为中度至重度障碍，亟需解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双轨中间件架构（Dual-Rail Middleware）、防腐层模式（Anti-Corruption Layer）、Saga分布式事务模式、影子账本（Shadow Ledger）模式
AI.method: 基于生产经验的架构设计，借鉴Santander巴西分行PIX集成实践，将其适应美国即时支付轨道结构要求，实现三大核心供应商（Fiserv、FIS、Jack Henry）适配器。
AI.findings: 三大供应商适配器均已开发完成，项目以Apache 2.0许可证开源发布。五层架构设计能够桥接传统核心银行系统与两大即时支付网络。
AI.theory_contributions: 将巴西PIX的生产级即时支付架构经验迁移至美国双轨支付环境，提出适用于多供应商、多支付轨道的通用中间件设计模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供开源、可部署的OpenFedNow中间件解决方案，直接解决美国金融机构因核心系统限制而无法接入即时支付网络的现实问题，降低集成门槛。

title:
Humanning: Measuring the Human Dimension

 Why Global Statistics Still Fail to Measure It, How to Measure It, And the Bridge to Human Understanding

detail.title:
Humanning: Measuring the Human Dimension

 Why Global Statistics Still Fail to Measure It, How to Measure It, And the Bridge to Human Understanding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethical approval according to local/national legislation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper documents and explains a structural contradiction in the dominant global measurement apparatuses: democracy indices, corporate human-sustainability frameworks, human-development indices. All of them declare that the human being is at the center. Yet each measures its own frame of reference with rigor (democracy, the corporate organization, the development aggregate), not the actual human who lives inside that system. The human is left at the periphery of the very apparatus that claims to place it at the center. Two paradigmatic measurement apparatuses are examined in depth: 1) the international democracy indices (V-Dem, the EIU Democracy Index, Freedom House) 2) the corporate human-sustainability frameworks (Deloitte Human Sustainability Report, human-capital metrics in ESG frameworks, Gallup engagement surveys). 3) A third apparatus, the UNDP Human Development Index, exhibits the same structural pattern in the field of aggregate human development and will be the object of specific treatment in a later piece of the program. The same void reappears, with greater consequences, in the way artificial intelligence is being measured and governed: systems that declare themselves aligned with the human without an operational definition of what that human is. This extension is developed in section 5.5.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了全球三大测量体系（民主指数、企业人类可持续性框架、人类发展指数）的结构性矛盾：它们宣称以人为中心，但实际测量的是各自框架的参照系（民主制度、企业组织、发展总量），而非活生生的人本身。这一空洞同样出现在AI治理领域，系统宣称“与人类对齐”却没有对人的操作性定义。
AI.research_question: 为什么全球号称“以人为中心”的主要测量体系（民主指数、企业人类可持续性框架、人类发展指数）实际上将人置于边缘？这种结构性矛盾如何延伸到AI治理领域？
AI.motivation: 现有测量体系普遍存在“以人为中心”的宣称与“以系统为中心”的实践之间的结构性断裂，且这一矛盾在AI治理领域可能产生更严重的后果，亟需被系统性地揭示和解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量批判理论；结构性矛盾分析；以人为中心的治理理论
AI.method: 对三类测量体系（V-Dem、EIU民主指数、Freedom House；德勤人类可持续性报告、ESG人力资本指标、盖洛普敬业度调查；UNDP人类发展指数）进行深度案例分析和结构性比较。
AI.findings: 三大测量体系均存在结构性的“人”的缺位：民主指数测量制度框架而非公民体验，企业框架测量组织绩效而非员工福祉，发展指数测量宏观总量而非个体发展。同样的空洞出现在AI对齐宣称中。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了“以人为中心”话语与测量实践之间的结构性矛盾，为测量批判理论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进民主、企业可持续性和人类发展测量体系提供诊断框架；警示AI治理中“人类对齐”概念的空洞化风险。

title: Post-Conflict Repair Capacity: Organizational Silence, Ordinary Interaction, and the Social Repair of Workplace Conflict
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Post-Conflict Repair Capacity: Organizational Silence, Ordinary Interaction, and the Social Repair of Workplace Conflict
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes the concept of post-conflict repair capacity to explain why workplace conflict sometimes leads to relational repair and organizational learning, while in other cases it turns into silence, avoidance, information blocking, and relational disconnection. Post-conflict repair capacity refers to the ability to resume ordinary interaction after conflict, criticism, shame, hurt, or failure without fixing the other person as a permanent threat. Such ordinary interaction includes greetings, responses, workplace conversation, work coordination, information sharing, light humor, and the minimal gestures through which people are returned to a shared social relationship.

Previous research has examined workplace conflict through psychological safety, organizational silence, abusive supervision, emotion regulation, shame, organizational learning, and defensive routines. However, less attention has been paid to what happens after conflict: how damaged interactional order is repaired, or how it fails to be repaired and becomes stabilized as silence or avoidance.
This paper reframes psychological safety not only as the confidence to speak while taking interpersonal risks, but also as the expectation that relationships remain repairable after speaking. Employees may remain silent not simply because speaking is immediately punished, but because they anticipate that ordinary interaction will not return afterward. When criticism leads to avoidance, ignored communication, exclusion from information flows, or loss of everyday recognition, silence becomes a relational structure rather than a mere absence of speech.

The paper distinguishes between repairable authority and non-repairable authority. Repairable authority can accept partial criticism, contest other parts, and return the other person to ordinary interaction. Non-repairable authority treats criticism as a threat to self-image or legitimacy and manages the relationship through silence, distance, and contact inhibition. The paper also introduces post-conflict contact inhibition to describe the condition in which speaking, responding, sharing information, or even acknowledging the other person becomes experienced as psychologically or socially dangerous.

The central claim is that the problem of workplace conflict is not that conflict occurs. The problem is that, after conflict, people may no longer be able to talk. A mature workplace is not one without conflict, but one in which people can return to ordinary interaction after conflict and transform disturbance into learning rather than silence. Post-conflict repair capacity provides a theoretical bridge between organizational silence, psychological safety, ordinary interaction, and the social repair of workplace conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"冲突后修复能力"概念，解释为何职场冲突有时带来关系修复与组织学习，有时却导致沉默、回避与关系断裂。核心观点：职场冲突的问题不在于冲突本身，而在于冲突后人们是否还能恢复日常互动。可修复的权威能接受批评并恢复互动，不可修复的权威则将批评视为威胁并动用沉默与疏远来管理关系。
AI.research_question: 为何职场冲突在某些情况下会导向关系修复和组织学习，而在其他情况下却演变为沉默、回避、信息阻断和关系断裂？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注心理安全感、组织沉默、辱虐管理等议题，但较少关注冲突发生后互动的修复与失败过程，缺乏解释“冲突后为何有时修复、有时恶化”的理论概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突后修复能力；可修复权威 vs. 不可修复权威；冲突后接触抑制；心理安全感（重新定义为不仅包括发言的信心，还包括对关系可修复性的预期）；日常互动理论；组织沉默理论。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过整合心理安全感、组织沉默、组织学习、羞辱理论等文献，提出新概念框架。
AI.findings: 1. 冲突后的关键在于能否恢复日常互动（问候、回应、工作协调、信息共享等）；2. 员工沉默不仅因立即惩罚，更因预期日常互动无法恢复；3. 可修复权威能接受部分批评并恢复互动，不可修复权威将批评视为威胁并采用沉默、疏远、接触抑制来管理关系；4. 冲突后接触抑制使说话、回应、信息共享甚至承认对方的存在变得心理或社会危险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"冲突后修复能力"概念，将心理安全感重新定义为包含对关系可修复性的预期，为组织沉默、心理安全感、日常互动与职场冲突的社会修复之间建立理论桥梁，区分可修复权威与不可修复权威两种权威类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出成熟的工作场所不是没有冲突，而是冲突后人们能恢复日常互动并将扰动转化为学习而非沉默。为管理者建设可修复权威、提升组织冲突后修复能力提供了方向。

title: To What Extent Can Green Infrastructure Investment Mitigate China's Clean-Energy Overcapacity?
affiliations: Bruegel and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: To What Extent Can Green Infrastructure Investment Mitigate China's Clean-Energy Overcapacity?
detail.abstract: China's industrial policies have made it the global leader in the manufacturing of solar panels, wind turbines and other renewable technologies, but at the cost of severe overcapacity that is now compressing margins across the entire sector. This paper evaluates greater investment in power infrastructure as a potential solution to stimulate energy demand, reduce curtailment and alleviate the renewable tech manufacturing overcapacity problem. Using scenario analysis, we show that grid expansion provides meaningful near-term demand relief, though supply-side consolidation remains necessary to restore durable market equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了加大电力基础设施投资（特别是电网扩张）作为缓解中国可再生能源制造业产能过剩问题的潜在解决方案。通过情景分析发现，电网扩张能在短期内提供有意义的电力需求提振，但要恢复持久市场均衡，供给侧整合仍然必不可少。
AI.research_question: 加大电力基础设施投资能否有效缓解中国可再生能源制造业的产能过剩问题？
AI.motivation: 中国通过产业政策成为太阳能电池板、风力涡轮机等可再生能源技术的全球领导者，但面临着严重的产能过剩问题，压缩了整个行业的利润率。研究旨在寻找缓解这一问题的可行方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供需均衡理论、基础设施投资对能源需求的拉动效应、产能过剩与市场出清理论。
AI.method: 情景分析法（Scenario Analysis）
AI.findings: 电网扩张能够在短期内有效提振能源需求、减少弃电现象，从而缓解可再生能源技术制造业的产能过剩压力；但从长期看，供给侧整合（如淘汰落后产能、行业重组）仍然是恢复市场持久均衡的必要条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将基础设施投资需求侧与制造业产能过剩的供给侧问题联系起来，为理解产业政策导致的产能过剩缓解路径提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确的政策启示：单纯依靠电网扩张等需求侧刺激只能短期缓解产能过剩，必须同时推进供给侧整合才能实现长期市场均衡。

title: Default Risk Management in Impact Lending: Evidence from Student-run Microfinance Funds and CDFIs
affiliations: Emory University, , Emory University, Emory University, Emory University and Emory University

detail.title: Default Risk Management in Impact Lending: Evidence from Student-run Microfinance Funds and CDFIs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced, or could be perceived to have influenced, this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve patients, clinical data, or biomedical human-subjects research. The qualitative component consisted of informational interviews with representatives of peer impact investing funds and Community Development Financial Institutions. No formal ethics approval was sought or required for this student-led organizational research project.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This research investigates how the Emory Impact Investing Group (EIIG) can restructure its due diligence and risk management processes to mitigate default exposure. Currently, EIIG faces challenges stemming from unstandardized screening processes and extended disbursement cycles, which often delay the discovery of poor-fit candidates until late in the consulting cycle.

To address this, we employed a mixed-methods approach, beginning with a foundational literature review. We then conducted qualitative interviews with peer impact funds and Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs), specifically DreamSpring, UNC’s Impact Investing Club (UNC IIC), and Northwestern’s Lending for Evanston and Northwestern Development (LEND). Quantitatively, we analyzed national revenue trends by firm size using the Small Business Credit Survey. Our analysis suggests that portfolio performance is heavily shaped during the underwriting phase and reinforced through structured post-disbursement communication.

We found that relationship-driven, holistic underwriting (prioritizing revenue stability over traditional credit scores) is the primary driver of risk management. Furthermore, delinquency is heavily concentrated early in the loan cycle, particularly in the first 90 days post-disbursement. Because smaller firms face greater revenue volatility, they carry an inherently higher default risk. However, relationship-based lending significantly improves repayment when paired with clear expectations and structured communication.

Based on these insights, we recommend two primary operational shifts. First, EIIG should replace its informal application tools with financial-specific software, such as Plaid or lower-cost alternatives, to streamline data collection and reduce borrower friction. Second, EIIG must implement a mandatory, high-touch "client stewardship" communication protocol during the first 90 days post-disbursement, utilizing a custom tracking dashboard to monitor early risk signals and maintain accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Emory影响力投资集团（EIIG）如何通过重构尽职调查与风险管理流程来降低违约风险。基于混合研究方法（文献综述、同行基金定性访谈、小企业信贷调查定量分析），发现关系导向的整体承销是风险管理的核心驱动力，且逾期高度集中在贷款发放后的前90天。建议EIIG采用金融软件取代非正式申请工具，并在放款后90天内实施强互动的"客户管理"沟通协议。
AI.research_question: Emory影响力投资集团（EIIG）如何重构其尽职调查与风险管理流程，以降低贷款违约风险？
AI.motivation: EIIG当前面临非标准化筛选流程和冗长的放款周期问题，导致不适合的候选者往往在咨询周期后期才被发现，增加了违约风险敞口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系驱动型整体承销理论（优先考虑收入稳定性而非传统信用评分）；贷款早期违约集中理论（放款后90天是高危期）；小企业规模与收入波动性关系理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：基础文献综述；对同行影响力基金和社区发展金融机构（DreamSpring、UNC IIC、LEND）的定性访谈；利用小企业信贷调查数据，按企业规模分析全国收入趋势的定量分析。
AI.findings: 1）关系驱动、整体性承销是风险管理的核心驱动力；2）逾期高度集中在放款后前90天；3）小型企业因收入波动性大，固有违约风险更高；4）关系型贷款配合清晰的期望和结构化沟通可显著改善还款表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了关系型承销在小额影响力投资中的风险管理价值；揭示了贷款早期违约集中现象在影响力投资情境下的适用性；建立了企业规模、收入波动性与违约风险之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为EIIG提出两项具体操作建议：采用Plaid等金融软件替代非正式申请工具以标准化数据收集；在放款后90天内实施强制的高触达"客户管理"沟通协议并配套定制跟踪仪表盘。

title: HRM Practices and Organizational Citizenship Behaviour (OCB): Evidence from Bangladeshi Commercial Banks
affiliations: Sohar University, Jahangirnagar University, Jahangirnagar University and Sohar University

detail.title: HRM Practices and Organizational Citizenship Behaviour (OCB): Evidence from Bangladeshi Commercial Banks
detail.abstract: Human Resource Management (HRM) approaches play a critical role in enhancing the culture in organizations by inspiring employees to perform their best through practicing organizational citizenship behavior (OCB). The prime purpose of this study is to investigate the influence of four human resource practices— recruitment and selection, training and development, performance appraisals, and compensation on employees’ OCB in the commercial banking sector of Bangladesh. The study collected 170 samples from various commercial banks in Dhaka city to conduct the study, using a structured questionnaire. The study conducted Structural Equation Modeling PLS-SEM, which revealed that all the HRM practices have a significant positive relationship with OCB and performance appraisal, and training & development are the strongest predictors of OCB. The significance of this study is that it gives insights into commercial banks’ employees OCB and HRM practices relationship from a Bangladeshi context.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了孟加拉国商业银行中四种人力资源管理实践（招聘选拔、培训开发、绩效评估、薪酬）对员工组织公民行为（OCB）的影响，发现所有实践均与OCB显著正相关，其中绩效评估和培训开发是最强预测因素。
AI.research_question: 四种人力资源管理实践（招聘选拔、培训开发、绩效评估、薪酬）如何影响孟加拉国商业银行员工的组织公民行为（OCB）？
AI.motivation: 人力资源管理方法在通过激发员工组织公民行为来提升组织文化方面至关重要，但现有研究对孟加拉国商业银行这一特定情境下的HRM实践与OCB关系探讨不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织公民行为（OCB）理论；人力资源管理实践与员工行为关系理论
AI.method: 问卷调查法，收集孟加拉国达卡市多家商业银行170份样本；采用结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 所有四种HRM实践（招聘选拔、培训开发、绩效评估、薪酬）均与OCB呈显著正相关；其中绩效评估和培训开发是OCB的最强预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 从孟加拉国商业银行情境出发，验证并扩展了HRM实践与OCB关系的理论框架，揭示了不同HRM实践对OCB的相对预测强度差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国商业银行的管理者提供了具体指导：应重点优化绩效评估和培训开发实践，以有效提升员工的组织公民行为和组织文化。

title: Self-Financing Capacity in Zero-Price Platform Markets : Scale, Monetisation, and Asymmetric Market Shares
affiliations: CNR - Intitute for Complex Systems and Ca Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Self-Financing Capacity in Zero-Price Platform Markets : Scale, Monetisation, and Asymmetric Market Shares

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Advertising-funded platforms typically charge users zero monetary price and compete through costly user-side investments: content supply, recommendation quality, creator incentives, interface design, trust and safety, and acquisition spending. This paper asks how scale-dependent monetisation changes the level of user-side attractiveness that a platform can finance from its own operations. It represents that capacity by net operating surplus per user, $g(N)=[R(N)-C(N)]/N$.

When surplus per user rises with scale, a small market-share advantage can relax the larger platform's financing constraint, support greater user-side attractiveness, and induce further user reallocation. In a two-platform logit benchmark, the equal-share configuration remains locally robust only when this scale-financing feedback is sufficiently weak. The curvature of surplus per user then determines whether asymmetric market shares emerge gradually or whether highly asymmetric configurations can coexist with a locally stable equal-share configuration. Under power-law monetisation, the classification changes at exponent four; under exponential monetisation, it depends on market size relative to the curvature scale, so the same technology can imply different local market-share regimes in small and large markets. A compatible gradual-adjustment process gives the resulting stability landscape a precise interpretation. The mechanism complements standard explanations of platform concentration based on direct network effects, switching costs, data advantages, and strategic conduct, while identifying a distinct empirical diagnostic and a set of implications for contestability policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究广告型平台如何通过规模依赖的货币化能力影响用户侧吸引力的融资约束，以及由此导致的市场份额非对称性。当单位用户运营盈余随规模递增时，规模优势可通过融资约束反馈机制放大领先地位，导致市场集中。文章通过逻辑特模型和幂律/指数货币化函数刻画了不同条件下的市场均衡稳定性。
AI.research_question: 广告型平台的规模依赖货币化能力如何影响其用户侧吸引力（如内容供给、推荐质量、创作者激励等）的融资约束，进而影响平台间市场份额的分布与稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统平台经济理论多从直接网络效应、转换成本、数据优势等角度解释平台集中化，但广告型平台的核心特征——零货币定价、用户侧投资竞争、规模依赖的广告变现能力——尚未得到充分的理论刻画。本文旨在揭示"规模-融资-吸引力"这一反馈循环如何独立于传统机制驱动市场集中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 规模依赖货币化理论：单位用户净运营盈余 g(N)=[R(N)-C(N)]/N 的曲率决定融资约束的动态特征；2) 逻辑特（Logit）竞争模型：两平台用户份额博弈均衡；3) 稳定性分析：幂律与指数货币化函数下的局部/全局稳定性分类。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析。构建两平台逻辑特竞争框架，引入单位用户净运营盈余函数 g(N)，分析其曲率对均衡稳定性的影响。采用幂律和指数两类货币化函数进行分类讨论，并通过渐进调整过程赋予稳定性景观精确解释。
AI.findings: 1) 当单位用户盈余随规模递增（g'(N)>0）时，小市场份额优势可通过融资约束放大，引发用户再分配的正反馈；2) 等份额配置的局部稳健性仅在规模融资反馈足够弱时成立；3) 幂律货币化下，指数4为临界值；指数货币化下，市场大小与曲率尺度的相对关系决定均衡类型——相同技术在不同市场规模下可能导致不同市场结构；4) 该机制可与非对称均衡共存，且等份额配置可保持局部稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统建立"规模依赖货币化→融资约束→用户侧投资→市场份额"的反馈理论，区别于传统网络效应、转换成本等解释；2) 提供基于单位用户盈余曲率的新的经验诊断指标；3) 为平台集中化提供了一种独立的理论机制，丰富了平台竞争理论的工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为反垄断与可竞争性政策提供新视角：监管者应关注单位用户盈余的规模弹性，而非仅关注市场份额本身；2) 揭示相同货币化技术在不同市场大小下可能导致差异化的竞争格局，提醒政策制定需因地制宜；3) 为平台企业的用户侧投资策略和融资决策提供理论指导。

The subject matter is Stability, Instability, Representation and Misrepresentation Characteristics of National Government with 1st Past the Post (1PP) MP Election + Majority Government

detail.abstract: This paper uses simple mathematical modelling to consider the characteristics, particularly in terms of stability, instability and accuracy of representation of the views of citizens, in national government systems where governing power is controlled by a dominant party or coalition in parliament and individual MPs are elected to represent individual constituencies under a 1st past the post (1PP) system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过简单数学模型分析了一党或联盟主导的议会制下，单一选区简单多数制（FPTP）选举体系在稳定性、不稳定性和公民观点代表性准确性方面的特征。
AI.research_question: 在多数党或联盟主导的议会制政府中，单一选区简单多数制（FPTP）选举体系在稳定性、不稳定性和公民观点代表性准确性方面有何特征？
AI.motivation: 探究简单多数制（FPTP）选举体系在不同政治格局下的表现，尤其是权力集中时对民主代表性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 简单数学模型建模，用于分析选举制度与政府系统的互动关系。
AI.method: 简单数学建模分析。
AI.findings: 该选举体系在稳定性与公民代表性之间存在权衡关系，多数党主导下可能出现代表性失真或系统不稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 为选举制度与政府系统的理论研究提供了基于简单数学建模的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了FPTP体系在现实政治运行中的潜在问题，为选举制度改革提供理论依据。

title:
Human Understanding and Artificial Intelligence 
A Dynamic Force in the International Arena
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title:
Human Understanding and Artificial Intelligence 
A Dynamic Force in the International Arena
detail.abstract: Agenda 2063 envisions 'an integrated, prosperous and peaceful Africa, driven by its own citizens and representing a dynamic force in the international arena' (African Union Commission, 2015). This paper argues that the ambition rests upon a neglected foundation, namely the structures through which societies develop understanding. While African development scholarship has long emphasised endogenous institutions, intellectual autonomy and knowledge production, little attention has been given to how Artificial Intelligence is transforming these foundations. Drawing on the Four Worlds framework, the paper examines human understanding as an evolving relationship between Being, Perturbation, Meaning and Instrumentation. It argues that families, communities, religion, schools and universities have historically constituted humanity's principal structures of understanding, while Large Language Models represent a new and powerful form of instrumentation that is reshaping how knowledge is accessed, produced and communicated. The analysis locates this transformation within Africa's distinctive human ecosystem, characterised by relatively young states and markets alongside ancient, though strained, societies. It argues that the African university now occupies a pivotal position, linking inherited systems of meaning with scientific inquiry and technological change. The paper concludes that Africa's aspiration to become a dynamic force in the international arena will depend not simply upon adopting Artificial Intelligence, but upon strengthening the human institutions that cultivate understanding, judgement and wisdom. Artificial Intelligence may extend human cognition, but it cannot replace the uniquely human responsibility for meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，非洲联盟《2063年议程》所构想的繁荣与一体化非洲，其根基在于人类社会理解世界所依赖的制度结构。大型语言模型作为新型工具正在重塑知识获取与传播方式，而非洲大学处于连接传统意义体系与科学技术变革的关键位置。非洲要实现其国际愿景，不能仅靠采用人工智能，更需强化培养理解力、判断力与智慧的人类制度。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（特别是大型语言模型）如何改变非洲社会理解世界所依赖的制度结构？非洲大学在这一变革中扮演什么角色？非洲应如何应对人工智能对其发展议程基础的影响？
AI.motivation: 非洲发展学术界长期关注内生制度、知识自主与知识生产，但鲜有研究关注人工智能如何重塑这些基础。本文旨在填补这一空白，探讨人工智能对非洲社会理解结构的深层影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四世界框架（Four Worlds framework）：将人类理解视为存在（Being）、扰动（Perturbation）、意义（Meaning）与工具（Instrumentation）之间不断演变的关系。
AI.method: 理论分析与概念推演，结合四世界框架审视人工智能（特别是LLMs）对非洲社会理解结构的冲击，并将其置于非洲独特的人类生态系统（年轻的国家与市场、古老但紧张的社会）中进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）家庭、社区、宗教、学校与大学历来是人类理解的主要制度结构，而LLMs代表一种新型强大工具，正在重塑知识获取、生产和传播方式。2）非洲大学处于关键枢纽位置，连接着继承的意义体系、科学探究与技术变革。3）非洲成为国际动态力量的愿景，取决于强化培养理解力、判断力与智慧的人类制度，而非仅仅采用AI技术。4）AI可以延伸人类认知，但无法替代人类对意义建构的独特责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 将四世界框架应用于非洲发展语境，揭示人工智能作为新型"工具"（Instrumentation）如何改变人类理解的制度基础，拓展了发展研究中对知识生产与制度结构的理论思考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲政策制定者与教育机构提供警示：在拥抱AI技术的同时，必须优先强化家庭、社区、宗教、大学等人类理解制度，特别是发挥非洲大学在连接传统与现代中的枢纽作用。

title: Africa, Infrastructure, and Complexity
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Africa, Infrastructure, and Complexity
detail.abstract: Infrastructure has traditionally been viewed as an optimisation problem. Governments seek the right projects, economists estimate the right models and planners search for the best allocation of scarce resources. This paper argues that such thinking begins too late. Before societies can optimise, they must first learn. Infrastructure is fundamentally an investment in uncertain futures, yet the systems within which it operates continually evolve through technological change, institutional adaptation and shifting human behaviour. The central challenge is therefore not simply to explain reality, but to learn from a reality that is itself changing. Drawing on Bernard Koopman's philosophy of observation, the paper distinguishes learning through observation from learning through explanation, arguing that the former provides the broader scientific foundation within which the latter should be understood. Regression remains indispensable for explaining relationships among recognised variables, but observation determines which variables deserve explanation in the first place. The paper proposes that infrastructure appraisal should therefore evolve from a one-off exercise in optimisation into a continuous process of observation, learning and adaptation. It concludes that Africa's greatest infrastructure opportunity lies not only in building physical assets, but in building institutions capable of learning continuously. In a complex world, development depends less on finding optimal solutions than on navigating an evolving reality.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将基础设施视为纯优化问题的传统观点，提出在优化之前必须先学习。基于Koopman的观察哲学，区分了"通过观察学习"与"通过解释学习"，主张基础设施评估应从一次性优化转变为持续的观察、学习和适应过程。非洲最大的基础设施机遇在于建立能持续学习的制度，而非仅仅建设物理资产。
AI.research_question: 基础设施评估应如何从静态优化范式转向动态学习范式？在不确定性环境下，观察与解释（如回归分析）在基础设施决策中各自扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统基础设施思维将其视为优化问题，但现实中的基础设施系统持续受到技术变革、制度适应和人类行为变化的影响，呈现出动态演化的特征。在此复杂且不确定的环境中，先优化后学习的顺序是错误的——必须先学会观察和学习，才能有效优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bernard Koopman的观察哲学——区分"通过观察学习"与"通过解释学习"，认为前者是后者的科学基础。观察决定哪些变量值得解释，而回归等工具则用于解释已识别变量之间的关系。
AI.method: 概念性/哲学性论证方法，基于Koopman的观察哲学理论进行演绎推理，提出基础设施评估的新框架。
AI.findings: 1）基础设施决策的核心挑战不是解释现实，而是从不断变化的现实中学习；2）观察优先于解释，观察决定哪些变量值得被纳入解释模型；3）基础设施评估应从一次性优化转变为持续的观察-学习-适应循环；4）非洲最大的机遇在于建设能持续学习的制度基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Koopman的观察哲学引入基础设施研究领域，重新定义了优化与学习的关系，提出了"先学习后优化"的理论框架，挑战了主流经济学和规划学中占主导地位的优化范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基础设施评估实践提供了全新方向：从追求一次性最优方案转向建立持续学习和适应能力；特别对非洲等发展中地区的基础设施战略具有指导意义——制度能力建设比物理资产建设更为根本。

title: AI-Enabled Fraud and Its Dual Nature: A Conceptual Framework for Accounting and Auditing Practice
affiliations: University of Duisburg-Essen, Mercator School of Management, University of Duisburg-Essen - Mercator School of Management and

detail.title: AI-Enabled Fraud and Its Dual Nature: A Conceptual Framework for Accounting and Auditing Practice
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of AI on fraud detection and perpetration within accounting and auditing contexts. Drawing on agency theory, routine activities theory, and technology acceptance literature, we develop a conceptual framework that positions AI as a dual-use technology that simultaneously enabling fraud schemes while enhancing detection capabilities. We synthesize evidence on AI-enabled fraud typologies including deepfake-facilitated schemes, automated social engineering, synthetic identity fraud, and algorithmic manipulation of financial reporting. The paper proposes a tri-dimensional preparedness model encompassing technical competency, organizational alignment, and collaborative governance as essential elements for effective fraud prevention. We argue that the accounting profession faces a critical inflection point where traditional audit methodologies and fraud detection frameworks require reconceptualization to address AI-mediated risks. This work contributes to emerging technologies literature by providing theoretical grounding for understanding AI's paradoxical role in fraud ecosystems and offering insights for practitioners navigating this complex landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI在会计与审计领域对欺诈的双重影响——既增强欺诈手段又提升检测能力，提出了包含技术能力、组织协调与合作治理的三维防范模型。
AI.research_question: AI作为双重用途技术，如何在会计与审计领域同时影响欺诈的实施与检测？
AI.motivation: 传统审计方法和欺诈检测框架已难以应对AI介导的新型风险，会计行业正处于关键转折点，亟需理论重构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论、日常活动理论、技术接受文献
AI.method: 概念性框架研究，综合分析与理论推演
AI.findings: 识别了AI赋能的欺诈类型（深度伪造欺诈、自动化社会工程、合成身份欺诈、财务报告算法操纵）；提出了三维准备模型（技术能力、组织协调、合作治理）作为有效欺诈防范的核心要素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解AI在欺诈生态系统中的悖论角色提供了理论依据，丰富了对新兴技术双重用途属性的学术认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业人员应对AI介导的复杂欺诈风险提供了三维准备模型作为实践指导，推动审计与反欺诈框架的重新概念化。

The organizational structure of a large railway company in Spain: the rail company of Madrid-Zaragoza-Alicante (MZA): 1900–1941. Management & Organizational History, 1–34. https://doi.org/10.1080/17449359.2026.2688255
title: The Organisational Structure of a Large Railway Company in Spain: The Rail Company of Madrid-Zaragoza-Alicante (MZA): 1900-1941
affiliations: University of Valladolid - Universidad de Valladolid and Universidad de Valladolid - Department of Finance and Accounting

detail.title: The Organisational Structure of a Large Railway Company in Spain: The Rail Company of Madrid-Zaragoza-Alicante (MZA): 1900-1941

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation [grant number PID2024-155796NB-I00]

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ortúñez-Goicolea, P. P., & López-Iturriaga, F. J. (2026). The organizational structure of a large railway company in Spain: the rail company of Madrid-Zaragoza-Alicante (MZA): 1900–1941. Management & Organizational History, 1–34. https://doi.org/10.1080/17449359.2026.2688255

detail.abstract: Which mechanisms can the owners of a large firm use to ensure control when the firm grows, diversifies and merges with others and they lose some ownership? We discuss the sometimes conflicting relationships among the founders, shareholders, and managers of the Madrid to Zaragoza and Alicante Railway Company, a Spanish firm that was in operation between 1856 and 1941. We review the mechanisms through which communication among the stakeholders flowed in an effort to bridge possible conflicts of interests. From a historical perspective, we also show the effectiveness of the mechanisms adopted by the owners (mainly the Rothschild family) to ensure control over the company. We highlight how the executive committee played a key role in taking control of the firm.

AI.tldr: 本文以西班牙一家铁路公司（1856-1941年）为案例，探讨大公司所有者在企业扩张、多元化及合并导致所有权稀释时，如何通过执行委员会等机制确保控制权，并揭示了股东、创始人与管理层之间的利益冲突与协调机制。
AI.research_question: 当企业成长、多元化及并购导致所有权稀释时，大公司的所有者可以使用哪些机制来确保控制权？
AI.motivation: 探讨大企业在扩张过程中所有权与控制权分离的问题，从历史案例中寻找所有者维持控制的有效机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 所有权与控制权分离理论；利益冲突与协调机制；公司治理中的沟通与决策机制。
AI.method: 历史案例分析法，基于马德里至萨拉戈萨及阿利坎特铁路公司（1856-1941年）的档案资料进行纵向研究。
AI.findings: 执行委员会在所有者（罗斯柴尔德家族）维持公司控制权中发挥了关键作用；多种沟通与协调机制被用于弥合利益冲突；历史视角证明了这些机制的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 从历史角度丰富了所有权与控制权理论，揭示了执行委员会作为控制机制的重要作用，为现代公司治理中的控制权设计提供了历史证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型企业在扩张和所有权稀释过程中如何设计有效的控制机制提供了历史经验借鉴，特别强调了执行委员会在集中决策与控制中的核心地位。

title: Layered Intelligence Theory in the Logic of Reality: A Process-Logical Case for Deeply Human and Deeply AI Cognition
affiliations: Astrala Advisory Services Ltd

detail.title: Layered Intelligence Theory in the Logic of Reality: A Process-Logical Case for Deeply Human and Deeply AI Cognition
detail.abstract: Conventional models of intelligence treat cognition as an inventory of separable facultieslinguistic, logical, interpersonal, emotionalthat can be measured, ranked, and trained independently (Gardner, Frames of Mind, 1983; Goleman, Emotional Intelligence, 1995). Empirical work on latent structure contradicts this partition (Visser, Ashton & Vernon, Intelligence, 2006), and neurological evidence shows that the brain operates as a single integrated system in which emotional, intuitive, and cognitive processing cannot be cleanly separated (Ezuz, Reimagining New Approaches in Teacher Professional Development, 2018). This paper introduces Layered Intelligence Theory (LIT) as a process-logical account of cognition grounded in Brenner's Logic in Reality (LIR) (Brenner, Logic in Reality, 2008). Five nested layers physiological, emotional, associative, symbolic, and integrativeemerge not as independent modules but as dialectically interdependent regimes of a single learning system. LIT is then positioned inside a dual programme, here called the Deeply Human, Deeply AI framework, arguing that the conditions Ken Robinson identified for human creativity (Robinson, Out of Our Minds, 2001; Robinson, 2006) and the conditions Ezuz identified for independent creative learning (Ezuz, 2018) are the same conditions under which artificial cognitive systems must be designed if they are to avoid collapsing into narrow expertise, taming, and hegemonic automation. The paper closes with four falsifiable predictions and an empirical research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层智能理论（LIT），认为认知不是独立能力的集合，而是生理、情绪、联想、符号和整合五个嵌套层次构成的辩证统一系统，并基于此构建"深度人类-深度AI"框架，主张人类创造力与人工智能避免窄化、驯化与霸权性自动化的条件相同。
AI.research_question: 认知是否应被理解为独立能力的集合，还是一个由多层次辩证构成的统一系统？人类创造力与人工智能避免窄化与霸权自动化的条件是否相同？
AI.motivation: 传统智能模型将认知视为可独立测量和训练的分立能力，但经验证据和神经科学证据均不支持这种划分，需要一种新的过程逻辑解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Brenner的"现实逻辑"（Logic in Reality），提出分层智能理论（LIT），包含五个嵌套层次（生理、情绪、联想、符号、整合），并引入"深度人类-深度AI"双轨框架。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念演绎，结合现有实证证据（神经科学、心理学）进行逻辑论证，并提出四个可证伪预测和研究议程。
AI.findings: 认知系统是五个层次辩证依赖的统一系统；人类创造力的条件与AI避免窄化、驯化与霸权自动化的条件相同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出LIT作为超越传统多元智能理论的过程逻辑框架，以"现实逻辑"整合认知层次，为智能研究提供新的本体论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计、教育实践和创造力培养提供统一原则：避免将系统简化为单一层次功能，应保持多层次整合与开放性。

title: Liquidity Constraints and Price Discovery in Digital Asset Markets: A Case Study of the Counter-Strike 2 Economy

detail.title: Liquidity Constraints and Price Discovery in Digital Asset Markets: A Case Study of the Counter-Strike 2 Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the sole trader and subject of the case study described in this paper. No third party or organization had any financial interest in, or influence over, the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study describes only the author's own trading activity and relies on publicly available marketplace data (Steam Community Market). No human participants, patients, or third-party personal data were involved, so formal ethics board approval was not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All trading activity described was conducted using the author's own funds.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how structural liquidity constraints distort price discovery in digital asset markets, using the Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) Fever Case economy as a laboratory. In April 2025, following the release of the Fever Case through Valve's Armory Pass system, I bought and sold 53 Fever Cases obtained through Armory Credits. A mandatory seven-day trade restriction-a structural barrier that Valve applies to all items acquired through its store, trades, and market-prevented sale near the case's early price peak, forcing execution after the peak had passed. The resulting Liquidity Gap of 42.67% between theoretical and realized revenue shows that correct market prediction is not, on its own, sufficient for realizing profit when a structural execution barrier sits between the two. Once the acquisition cost of the underlying Armory Passes is accounted for, the true net profit on the position is smaller still than the gross figures suggest. The paper draws an explicit parallel to IPO lock-up periods in traditional finance (Field & Hanka, 2001; Brau, Carter, Christophe & Key, 2004) and argues that execution constraints of this kind should be modeled as primary variables in a trading strategy rather than treated as a secondary risk.

AI.tldr: 本文以CS2 Fever Case为实验室，发现Valve设置的七天交易锁定期造成42.67%的流动性缺口，表明结构性执行约束应被建模为交易策略的主要变量，而非次要风险。
AI.research_question: 结构性流动性约束如何扭曲数字资产市场的价格发现过程？
AI.motivation: 传统金融中IPO锁定期已被广泛研究，但数字资产市场中类似的结构性执行约束（如交易锁定期）对价格发现和实际收益的影响尚未被充分实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性约束理论、价格发现理论、IPO锁定期类比（Field & Hanka, 2001; Brau et al., 2004）
AI.method: 单案例实验研究：作者在2025年4月通过Valve的Armory Pass系统获取53个Fever Case，记录交易时间、价格和执行结果，比较理论收益与实际收益。
AI.findings: 七天交易锁定期导致作者无法在价格峰值卖出，被迫在峰值后执行交易；理论收益与实际收益间的流动性缺口达42.67%；扣除Armory Pass获取成本后，实际净利润更低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统金融中IPO锁定期理论拓展至数字资产市场，提出执行约束应作为交易策略的主要变量而非次要风险进行建模。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字资产交易者提供警示：正确预测市场不足以保证盈利，结构性的流动性约束可能显著侵蚀实际收益；建议交易策略设计中优先考虑执行限制因素。

title: Functional Zoning Analysis of Family Spaces for Preschool Children with Disabilities in China
affiliations: University of Bologna and Università di Bologna

detail.title: Functional Zoning Analysis of Family Spaces for Preschool Children with Disabilities in China
detail.abstract: Home life comprises much of CWDs’daily activity, including sleeping, eating, playing, learning, and rehabilitation. However, evidence on home spatial organization and accessibility constraints for preschool CWDs remains limited. This study examines preschool CWDs in developing inland Chinese cities. It analyzes functional zoning in family spaces and related factors to explain how caregiving needs, child functional dependence, housing conditions, and furniture or assistive-device arrangements jointly shape home spatial organization and children’s independent activity. Using a quantitatively led design, questionnaires (n = 305) and structured interviews (n = 35) were conducted with preschool CWDs, caregivers, and relevant staff through rehabilitation and early special-education settings. Quantitative analysis applied PCA, ANOVA, and logistic regression. Interview notes were used to contextualize the quantitative findings and interpret convergent and divergent cases. The results show that 1) home spaces often form a high-use core area shaped by caregivers’ visual supervision and rapid intervention needs, and functional boundaries frequently overlap and shift; 2) indoor mobility among CWDs combines goal-oriented tasks and spontaneous exploration, while routes are constrained by spatial scale, circulation continuity, and space occupied by furniture and assistive devices; 3) children’s age, housing conditions, caregiving structure, and furniture- and assistive-device arrangements jointly affect whether stable child-specific functional zones can be established and maintained. This study provides a contextually interpreted account of how home functional zoning is shaped in families of preschool CWDs and offers an operational basis for home-space optimization. Future research will develop and test spatial optimization models to improve household adaptability and children’s independent mobility.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过问卷调查（n=305）和结构化访谈（n=35），分析了中国内陆城市学龄前残疾儿童的家庭空间功能分区及其影响因素，发现家庭空间形成以 caregivers 视觉监督和快速干预需求为核心的高使用率区域，儿童室内移动受空间尺度、动线连续性和家具/辅助设备布局的制约，儿童的年龄、住房条件、照护结构和家具设备安排共同影响稳定功能区的建立。
AI.research_question: 学龄前残疾儿童的家庭空间功能分区如何形成？哪些因素（照护需求、儿童功能依赖程度、住房条件、家具/辅助设备安排）共同塑造了家庭空间组织与儿童的独立活动能力？
AI.motivation: 学龄前残疾儿童的日常活动（睡眠、饮食、游戏、学习、康复）大部分在家中完成，但关于其家庭空间组织和可达性约束的实证证据有限，尤其是在发展中国家内陆城市的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭空间功能分区理论；儿童独立移动性与环境约束理论；照护需求与空间组织的关系理论。
AI.method: 定量主导的混合方法设计：问卷调查（n=305）和结构化访谈（n=35），对象包括学龄前残疾儿童、照护者和相关工作人员。定量分析采用主成分分析（PCA）、方差分析（ANOVA）和逻辑回归，访谈笔记用于情境化定量发现并解释趋同和分歧案例。
AI.findings: 1）家庭空间形成以照护者视觉监督和快速干预需求为核心的高使用率区域，功能边界经常重叠和移动；2）儿童的室内移动结合目标导向任务和自发探索，但路线受空间尺度、动线连续性和家具/辅助设备占用的空间限制；3）儿童年龄、住房条件、照护结构以及家具和辅助设备安排共同影响能否建立和维持稳定的儿童特定功能区。
AI.theory_contributions: 为学龄前残疾儿童家庭空间功能分区的形成机制提供了情境化解释，揭示了照护需求、功能依赖、住房条件和物理环境安排之间的交互作用对空间组织的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学龄前残疾儿童家庭空间优化提供了操作基础，未来可进一步开发和测试空间优化模型，以提高家庭适应性和儿童独立移动能力。

title: The Phantom Third Bidder: Minimum-Bid Rules and Manufactured Competition in Indian Public Procurement

detail.title: The Phantom Third Bidder: Minimum-Bid Rules and Manufactured Competition in Indian Public Procurement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. The data used in this study were scraped from public government portals and released openly by Sarthak Sidhant, with whom the author has no financial or professional relationship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available administrative records published by the Government of India and state governments on their e-procurement portals. No human participants, patients or private personal data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Indian procurement rules typically require a minimum number of bids, usually three, before a government tender can be awarded. Using 3.1 million contract awards from India’s national electronic procurement system between 2012 and 2026, worth about 26 trillion rupees, I show that this safeguard produces the appearance of competition rather than competition itself. The number of bids per tender piles up sharply at exactly three: depending on the counterfactual, 36 to 73 percent of all three-bid awards are in excess of what a smooth bidding process would generate, which is at least one in eight of all awards in the country. The pile-up sits precisely where each state’s rule sits. West Bengal, where the threshold binds at three, has 69 percent of awards at exactly three bids. Kerala and Tamil Nadu, where tenders may effectively proceed with two, pile up at exactly two. Madhya Pradesh, which tolerates single bids, shows no spike at all. Matched to tender notices, awards with exactly three bids cost about 10 percent more than comparable awards with four or five bids, and moving from two bids to three saves almost nothing while moving from three to four saves ten times as much. The third bidder, in short, is often not real. Over time, single-bid awards fell from 26 percent to 7 percent of the total while the share at the minimum more than doubled, suggesting that enforcement converted visible non-competition into staged competition. The world’s most common procurement safeguard, a minimum bidder count, can manufacture the appearance of the competition it was meant to guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度310万份政府采购合同数据（2012-2026年，约26万亿卢比），发现最低竞标人数要求（通常为3家）并未真正促进竞争，而是制造了"虚假竞争"——大量合同恰好达到最低门槛，且这些合同的成本比有4-5家竞标者的合同高出约10%。第三家竞标者往往是"不真实的"，该政策实际上将显性的缺乏竞争转化为了伪装的竞争。
AI.research_question: 印度政府采购中要求最低竞标人数（通常为3家）的规定是否真正促进了竞争，还是仅仅制造了竞争的假象？
AI.motivation: 最低竞标人数要求是全球最常见的采购保障措施，但其实际效果缺乏严谨的大规模实证检验。作者希望揭示这一看似合理的制度在实践中可能产生的扭曲效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争与拍卖理论、制度合规性理论、政策意外后果理论
AI.method: 利用印度国家电子采购系统2012-2026年间的310万份合同数据（价值约26万亿卢比），采用断点回归、反事实分析、邦际比较（西孟加拉邦、喀拉拉邦、泰米尔纳德邦、中央邦）、匹配分析法等，对比不同竞标人数下的合同价格差异。
AI.findings: （1）竞标人数在恰好3家处出现显著堆积，36%-73%的3家竞标合同是"多余的"；（2）各邦堆积点恰好对应其各自的最低门槛要求；（3）恰好3家竞标的合同比有4-5家竞标的合同成本高出约10%；（4）从2家增加到3家竞标几乎不节省成本，但从3家增加到4家节省的成本是前者的10倍；（5）政策执行后，单家竞标合同占比从26%降至7%，而刚好达标合同占比翻倍，说明政策将显性不竞争转化为伪装竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了最低竞标人数要求这一"保障措施"在实践中产生了"制度性伪装"效应——规则反而激励了形式合规而非实质竞争，为制度设计的 unintended consequences 理论提供了有力实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对全球各国普遍采用的最低竞标人数政策提出警示：该政策不仅未能有效促进竞争，反而可能推高政府采购成本（约10%），并助长"虚假投标"行为。建议政策制定者重新审视或废除此类数量门槛，转向更注重竞争实质的采购监管方式。

title: Past the Goodhart Horizon: The Architecture and Price of Welfare-Touching Escape

detail.title: Past the Goodhart Horizon: The Architecture and Price of Welfare-Touching Escape
detail.abstract: The Goodhart Horizon says the decision-relevant quantity, the welfare given back once optimization passes the welfare peak, is non-identifiable from any monitoring channel whose conditional law given the system’s trajectory does not depend on welfare. That is an impossibility. This paper is the constructive answer to the obvious next question: if you cannot see the gap from inside, how do you get past it, what does it cost, and what shape must the overseeing institution take? Three results. First, the escape requirement is a theorem. By a Blackwell comparison straight from the (OC) definition, a channel whose law given the trajectory is independent of welfare carries no decision value about welfare beyond the trajectory, so escape requires a channel whose readings depend on welfare itself. The classical internal-model and good-regulator principles are the control-theoretic lineage that makes this feel familiar, not the proof; each presupposes detectability of the regulated variable, which (OC) denies.
