detail.abstract:
Biodiversity loss is a long-horizon, fat-tail risk to the productive capacity of whole national economies, and the financial system has only recently begun to see it. The response over the past decade has been substantial: nature has been threaded into corporate and financial disclosure through frameworks such as the TNFD, into measurement and management standards such as ISO 17298, and into a growing family of instruments from biodiversity credits to debt-for-nature swaps and sustainability-linked bonds. This paper addresses a narrow, complementary question that opens once the lens shifts from single to double materiality: from protecting returns against biodiversity loss to protecting the natural capital those returns ultimately rest on. 

That shift challenges an assumption much of the investment industry has been built on: that relative size is the primary proxy for importance. The larger the balance sheet or the position, the more it is assumed to matter. Once the objective includes pricing a public-good externality and not only a return, what matters is the intensity of a participant's transmission into outcomes, not the size of its balance sheet. Notably, the leveraged investors who use credit-default swaps (CDS) to hedge can be a meaningful share of the flows that set sovereign borrowing costs, so a deeper, hedgeable CDS rail can move a sovereign’s cost of capital through that channel; Section 6 sets out who these pricesetters are and what frees each to act. 

This is also where the choice of market infrastructure comes into view. Where finance has reached for a market mechanism to price nature, it has largely extended the infrastructure built for carbon, which in turn drew on the rails of commodity markets. A commodity rail is built to price a fungible unit of consumable value changing hands over time. Biodiversity loss is not a missing unit; it is a slow, compounding fat-tail risk to a sovereign's solvency, which is the kind of risk credit markets are designed to insure against. The instrument built for it already exists. We argue the credit-default swap, pointed deliberately and bounded by design, can translate a verified national biodiversity signal into the cost of sovereign capital, working through a mechanism that already moves capital at very large scale. We offer this as a complement to the disclosure, measurement and market-building work already underway.

The economic premise, that nature loss already moves sovereign creditworthiness, rests on an established body of research, most recently corroborated by peer-reviewed work (Agarwala et al., 2026). Our focus is the question that evidence leaves open: through what market mechanism a sovereign can most credibly be incentivised for stewardship. We set out the design and its single-todouble-materiality logic, locate it among adjacent instruments, state the pricing logic and confront the small-sample detectability problem, specify a pilot hosted by a multilateral development bank with explicit scale-up and sunset logic, and set out the principal risks and objections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，生物多样性丧失是国家经济生产力的长期肥尾风险，而信用违约互换（CDS）可以作为一种市场机制，将经过核实的国家生物多样性信号转化为主权资本成本，从而激励主权国进行自然资本管理。文章从双重重要性（double materiality）视角出发，挑战了以相对规模作为重要性代理变量的传统投资假设，指出在考虑公共品外部性定价时，参与者的行为强度而非资产负债表规模才是关键。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种市场机制，将国家层面的生物多样性保护信号转化为主权资本成本，从而通过金融渠道激励主权国家进行自然资本管理？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性丧失已对主权信用产生可量化的影响（Agarwala et al., 2026），但现有碳市场式商品基础设施不适合处理生物多样性这种缓慢累积的肥尾主权偿付风险。需要一种与风险性质匹配的现有金融工具来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重重要性（double materiality）；单一重要性到双重重要性的视角转换；相对规模 vs. 行为强度的投资假设批判；公共品外部性定价理论。
AI.method: 概念设计与机制论证：基于已有主权信用风险研究（Agarwala et al., 2026），设计以CDS为核心的市场机制，阐述定价逻辑、小样本可检测性问题、多边开发银行试点的实施路径、扩张与退出逻辑，并分析主要风险与反对意见。
AI.findings: 1）现有商品市场式基础设施不适合生物多样性风险定价；2）CDS已具备大规模资本流动能力，机制设计与生物多样性风险的肥尾、长期特性匹配；3）杠杆投资者（如使用CDS对冲者）可以成为影响主权资本成本的价格制定者；4）提出多边开发银行主导的试点方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双重重要性概念从企业层面延伸至主权资本市场设计；挑战了投资行业中"相对规模=重要性"的核心假设，提出"行为强度"作为替代衡量标准；为生物多样性风险与金融市场的连接提供了一套完整的理论化机制框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种可操作的、与现有大规模金融市场基础设施（CDS）兼容的解决方案，作为对TNFD披露、ISO 17298标准等现有工作的补充；设计了具体的多边开发银行试点路径及扩张与退出逻辑。

title: BayesXAI: Horseshoe Priors for Explainable AI
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: BayesXAI: Horseshoe Priors for Explainable AI
detail.abstract: We develop BayesXAI, a Bayesian framework for Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) grounded in model-free variable selection via the horseshoe prior. Existing approaches-SHAP, LIME, and integrated gradients-produce point estimates of feature importance with no principled uncertainty quantification. We recast XAI as a sparse Bayesian regression problem: given oracle queries to a black-box model f , we learn a posterior distribution over feature importance coefficients using the horseshoe prior of Carvalho et al. (2010). The horseshoe's near-Cauchy tails prevent excessive shrinkage of large signals; its pole at zero achieves automatic, continuous spike-and-slab-like sparsification. We prove posterior contraction at the minimax rate s 0 log(p/s 0)/n for s 0-sparse explanations (Theorem 1) and establish horseshoe predictive minimaxity via the GLX framework (Theorem 2; Polson et al. 2025e). Bayesian hypothesis tests for feature relevance exploit the moderate-deviation Bayes factor approximation. We compare BayesXAI with SHAP, LIME, integrated gradients, ALE, Anchors, and counterfactual methods, providing an honest regime map of when the horseshoe wins and when it does not. Experiments on synthetic sparse benchmarks show signal recovery of 0.96 at FDR 0.02, versus 0.74 / 0.19 for kernel SHAP. A complete Python implementation is provide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BayesXAI，一个基于马靴先验的贝叶斯可解释人工智能框架，将XAI重述为稀疏贝叶斯回归问题，实现特征重要性的后验分布学习与不确定性量化，在稀疏基准测试中信号恢复率达0.96（FDR=0.02），显著优于SHAP等方法。
AI.research_question: 如何为黑箱模型的特征重要性估计提供具有原则性不确定性量化的解释方法？
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法（SHAP、LIME、Integrated Gradients等）仅提供特征重要性的点估计，缺乏严格的不确定性量化，导致用户无法判断解释的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马靴先验（Horseshoe Prior, Carvalho et al., 2010）；稀疏贝叶斯回归；后验收缩率（minimax最优速率）；GLX框架下的预测极小性；贝叶斯假设检验与中偏差贝叶斯因子近似。
AI.method: 将XAI重新表述为稀疏贝叶斯回归问题：通过对黑箱模型进行预言机查询，使用马靴先验学习特征重要性系数的后验分布；利用马靴先验的近柯西尾部避免大信号过度收缩，零点处的极点实现自动连续 spike-and-slab 稀疏化；后验收缩定理证明；贝叶斯因子进行特征相关性检验。
AI.findings: 定理1证明后验收缩率达minimax最优速率 s₀ log(p/s₀)/n；定理2建立马靴预测极小性；合成稀疏基准实验中，信号恢复率达0.96（FDR=0.02），远优于Kernel SHAP的0.74（FDR=0.19）；提供了完整的Python实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将XAI纳入稀疏贝叶斯回归框架，为特征重要性估计提供后验分布而非点估计；证明了后验收缩的minimax最优速率和预测极小性；建立了贝叶斯假设检验用于特征相关性判断的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可量化不确定性的XAI方法，使用户能判断解释的可靠性；在稀疏场景下显著优于现有主流方法；提供了完整的Python实现，便于实际应用和推广。

title: Too Much Finance: Mechanisms That Harm Growth and Policy Implications
affiliations: Birkbeck, University of London, Birkbeck, University of London and Heriot-Watt University

detail.title: Too Much Finance: Mechanisms That Harm Growth and Policy Implications
detail.abstract: The mechanisms for the financial sector to harm growth arise through short-termism of financial markets. This leads to the misallocation of resources in the private sector, leading to financial crises and damage to growth. However, harm to growth comes not only from financial crises, but also from the failure of short-termist financial markets to facilitate public investment in long-term, growth-enhancing projects. While the literature has discussed the first channel extensively, it is largely silent on the second one. Our contribution is to develop a formal model to clarify how investment reticence of governments can arise from the fear of financial crises. A central conclusion is that in the presence of a large financial sector, the fear of market turmoil can damage growth even in the absence of an actual crisis episode. We discuss policy responses to both mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了金融部门的短期主义不仅通过金融危机损害增长，还通过阻碍政府对长期增长项目的公共投资造成损害。即使在缺乏实际危机的情况下，对金融市场动荡的恐惧也足以抑制增长。
AI.research_question: 短期主义的金融市场如何通过阻碍公共投资（而非仅通过金融危机）损害经济增长？
AI.motivation: 现有文献广泛讨论了金融危机损害增长的渠道，但对短期主义金融市场导致政府不愿投资长期增长项目这一渠道关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融市场短期主义理论，构建了政府投资决策与金融市场反应之间的博弈模型。
AI.method: 形式化模型（formal model），分析政府因恐惧金融市场动荡而出现投资沉默（investment reticence）的机制。
AI.findings: 在大型金融部门存在的情况下，即使未发生实际金融危机，仅对市场动荡的恐惧就足以损害经济增长；政府因害怕金融市场负面反应而放弃长期增长项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融市场损害增长的"第二条渠道"——通过抑制公共投资而非仅通过引发危机；阐明了"投资沉默"形成的微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对两种损害机制的政策建议，提醒关注金融市场短期主义对公共投资的隐性抑制效应。

title: Heterogeneous beliefs with Uninsurable Income
affiliations: National University of Singapore and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Heterogeneous beliefs with Uninsurable Income
detail.abstract:
This paper analyzes the general equilibrium of a pure-exchange economy in which agents with uninsurable income trade a dividend-paying stock and borrow from or lend to each other. Agents are heterogeneous in risk aversion, time preferences and beliefs about the growth rates of both the dividend and all agents' incomes. We derive in closed form the equilibrium interest rate, stock price, and agent consumption and investment policies.

Key findings include: a positive correlation between optimists' income and dividend growth lowers the interest rate; beliefs on hedgeable risks and those on unhedgeable incomes are aggregated differently in equilibrium; agents with atypical beliefs possess high subjective utility while facing potentially unbounded negative expected utility under the objective probability measure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含不可保险收入、异质性代理人（风险厌恶、时间偏好、信念差异）的纯交换一般均衡模型，并给出了均衡利率、股票价格及消费投资策略的闭式解。
AI.research_question: 在不可保险收入环境下，具有异质性风险厌恶、时间偏好和增长信念的代理人如何影响一般均衡的利率、股价及消费投资决策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假设代理人同质或仅考虑单一维度的异质性，而现实中投资者在风险态度、耐心程度及对经济和收入增长的信念上存在显著差异，这些差异如何共同作用于资产价格和资源配置尚缺乏完整的理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纯交换一般均衡模型、异质性代理人（风险厌恶、时间偏好、信念）、不可保险收入、闭式解均衡分析
AI.method: 构建纯交换经济的一般均衡模型，允许代理人在风险厌恶、时间偏好以及关于股息和收入增长的信念上存在异质性，通过求解得到均衡利率、股价及消费投资策略的闭式解。
AI.findings: (1) 乐观者的收入与股息增长正相关会降低均衡利率；(2) 可对冲风险与不可对冲收入的信念在均衡中以不同方式被加总；(3) 持有异质信念的代理人虽然主观效用较高，但在客观概率测度下可能面临无界的负期望效用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在不可保险收入和多重异质性（风险厌恶、时间偏好、信念）框架下，给出均衡的闭式解；揭示了不同风险类型的信念在均衡定价中的差异化加总机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解投资者异质性对利率、股价等核心资产价格的影响提供了理论基准，有助于解释市场中乐观/悲观情绪对资产定价的复杂效应。

title: The Structural Directive: Vindicating The High Purpose of the Antitrust Laws
affiliations: Open Markets Institute

detail.title: The Structural Directive: Vindicating The High Purpose of the Antitrust Laws
detail.abstract:
After more than a decade of vigorous advocacy by policy analysts, journalists, and legal scholars, federal and state enforcers finally found the political will to initiate numerous antitrust enforcement actions under Section 2 of the Sherman Act—the antitrust provision proscribing unfair monopolization. During the first Trump and Biden administrations, multiple enforcement actions were brought against the world’s largest corporations, some of which are currently navigating the litigation process. Yet, lawsuits are neither the objective nor the measure of success; remedies are. Remedies are the heart, body, and soul of litigation. No enforcement action is consequential without meaningful relief.

With this generational influx of enforcement, antitrust in the United States is at an inflection point. Over the last two decades, federal judges have not had to seriously contemplate or implement structural antitrust remedies. Structural remedies are those that permanently dismantle a corporation’s dominant control and alter the market architecture itself by divesting assets or breaking up firms. The last structural relief issued by a court was in 1982 with the breakup of telecommunications giant AT&T Judges’ experience with structural antitrust remedies has become atrophied, demanding a return to first principles. Judges and enforcers must recenter effective remedies as the core of antitrust law and resist the urge to issue or seek favorable judgments that merely identify violations and restrain the conduct at issue.

To give effect to the “high purpose” of the antitrust laws, judges must adhere to what I call the “structural directive.” The structural directive is the binding doctrinal principle that obligates lower courts to impose the requested structural relief on liable parties—as opposed to merely permitting courts to do so—if the plaintiff requests the remedy and the request is reasonable.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在美国反垄断执法新时代，法院应遵循"结构性指令"原则——当原告提出合理请求时，下级法院有义务对违法企业实施结构性救济（如资产剥离或拆分），而非仅止于认定违法行为或限制行为。
AI.research_question: 在反垄断执法进入新时代的背景下，法院应如何对待结构性救济措施？是否存在一种约束性法律原则要求法院在特定条件下必须实施结构性救济？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年联邦法院很少处理结构性反垄断救济措施，法官对此经验已严重退化。而当前针对大型科技公司的反垄断诉讼浪潮中，救济措施（而非诉讼本身）才是执法的核心。因此需要回归第一原则，重新确立有效救济在反垄断法中的中心地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: "结构性指令"（structural directive）——一项具有约束力的法律原则，要求下级法院在原告提出合理的结构性救济请求时，必须（而非可以）对违法方实施该救济。
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal analysis（法律教义分析），结合反垄断法历史、判例法梳理及当前执法实践分析。
AI.findings: 1. 美国的反垄断执法正处于转折点，司法经验不足构成重大挑战；2. 救济措施是反垄断诉讼的心脏、身体和灵魂，没有有意义的救济就没有有效的执法；3. "结构性指令"原则应成为法院处理反垄断结构性救济的核心约束性规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"结构性指令"这一新的法律教义概念，系统论证了下级法院在反垄断案件中实施结构性救济的义务而非裁量权，填补了相关法律理论的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官和执法者在当前反垄断诉讼浪潮中如何有效执行反垄断法提供了明确的操作指南，强调应抵制仅寻求违法认定或限制行为的冲动，将重心回归到有效救济上。

title:
Thieves in Law
Vory V Zakone, European Hybrid Threats, and the Scandinavian Gang Wars

detail.title:
Thieves in Law
Vory V Zakone, European Hybrid Threats, and the Scandinavian Gang Wars

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No written consent was required because no individual participants or identifiable private case-study subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was independently conducted by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the Vory v zakone-the post-Soviet fraternity of elite criminal authorities known as thieves in law-through five interconnected analytical lenses: their structural evolution from Gulag-born institution to transnational criminal enterprise; their documented role within Russia hybrid warfare campaign against European states; their calculated weaponisation by Iran as proxies for assassination and paramilitary operations across Europe and North America; their relationship to the gang violence reshaping Scandinavia and the degree to which Dubai and Istanbul have become operational rear bases for the entire ecosystem. (Galeotti, 2018; GLOBSEC & ICCT, 2025) The paper argues that the Vory can no longer be understood as a criminal phenomenon alone. They represent a node within a broader, state-proximate architecture in which organised crime, rival intelligence services, and competing geopolitical strategies have become entangled in ways that European security institutions have not yet found coherent answers to. (Varese, Lonsky & Podvysotskiy, 2021

AI.tldr: 本文分析后苏联时代的精英犯罪组织"法律上的贼"（Vory v zakone），通过五个分析视角揭示其从古拉格监狱诞生的犯罪组织演变为跨国犯罪企业，并被俄罗斯和伊朗等国用作混合战争工具和代理人的过程。论文认为，该组织已成为有组织犯罪、情报机构和地缘政治战略相互纠缠的"国家邻近架构"中的关键节点，欧洲安全机构尚未找到有效应对方案。
AI.research_question: 后苏联时代的"法律上的贼"犯罪组织如何从古拉格监狱制度演变为跨国犯罪网络，并在俄罗斯和伊朗等国的混合战争、代理人行动中扮演何种角色？这一组织现象对欧洲安全机构构成怎样的挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统的犯罪学研究将"法律上的贼"仅视为有组织犯罪现象，但该组织已深度介入国家间地缘政治博弈、混合战争和情报行动，现有研究未能充分揭示其与国家行为体之间的复杂纠缠关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家-犯罪共生理论（state-crime nexus）、混合战争理论（hybrid warfare）、跨国犯罪网络理论（transnational criminal network theory）、安全化理论（securitization theory）
AI.method: 多案例综合分析（multi-case analysis），整合Galeotti（2018）的定性研究、GLOBSEC & ICCT（2025）的政策分析报告以及Varese, Lonsky & Podvysotskiy（2021）的实证研究，通过五个分析透镜（结构演变、俄罗斯混合战争、伊朗代理人行动、斯堪的纳维亚帮派暴力、迪拜和伊斯坦布尔的后方基地功能）进行交叉验证。
AI.findings: 1."法律上的贼"已从古拉格监狱制度演变为跨国犯罪企业；2.该组织被俄罗斯用作针对欧洲的混合战争工具；3.伊朗将其作为在欧洲和北美进行刺杀和准军事行动的代理人；4.该组织与斯堪的纳维亚地区的帮派暴力重塑密切相关；5.迪拜和伊斯坦布尔已成为该犯罪生态系统的运营后方基地；6.该组织已成为"国家邻近架构"中的关键节点，有组织犯罪、情报机构和地缘政治战略在此深度纠缠。
AI.theory_contributions: 突破传统犯罪学将"法律上的贼"仅视为犯罪现象的分析框架，提出"国家邻近架构"概念，揭示了有组织犯罪、情报机构和地缘政治战略三者之间的系统性纠缠关系，为理解后苏联时代跨国犯罪的政治化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲安全机构识别和应对源自后苏联空间的跨国犯罪与混合威胁提供了系统性分析框架；揭示了迪拜和伊斯坦布尔作为犯罪后方基地的功能，为国际合作执法提供了关键情报切入点；指出了现有欧洲安全机制在应对国家-犯罪共生威胁方面的制度性盲区。

title: Designing an Islamic Financial Product Ijarah

detail.title: Designing an Islamic Financial Product Ijarah

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No written consent was required because no individual participants or identifiable private case-study subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body for the research, authorship, or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper examines Ijarah as a Sharia-compliant leasing structure and its potential application in a modern Islamic financial product for the Dutch market. It explains the doctrinal foundations of Ijarah in the Qur’an, Sunnah, and classical Islamic jurisprudence, highlighting the core distinction between ownership of an asset and the lessee’s lawful right to use its benefit. The paper compares the treatment of Ijarah across the Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi‘i, and Hanbali schools, showing how each balances contractual certainty, commercial flexibility, custom, and avoidance of uncertainty. It argues that Ijarah differs fundamentally from interest-based lending because the financier earns rental income from providing access to a real asset rather than charging for the use of money. Building on this foundation, the paper positions Ijarah as a transparent, asset-based financing model suitable for retail households and SME owner-operators in the Netherlands, with potential for wider EU-ready design.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Ijarah作为符合伊斯兰教法的租赁结构，及其在荷兰市场现代伊斯兰金融产品中的潜在应用。论文从古兰经、圣训和古典伊斯兰法理学出发，阐述了Ijarah的教义基础，对比了四大法学派对Ijarah的不同处理，论证其与利息借贷的根本区别，并定位其为适合荷兰零售家庭和中小企业主的透明、资产基础的融资模式。
AI.research_question: Ijarah这种符合伊斯兰教法的租赁结构如何应用于荷兰市场的现代伊斯兰金融产品？
AI.motivation: 在非穆斯林占多数的荷兰市场中，探索Ijarah作为一种透明、资产基础的融资模式，为零售家庭和中小企业主提供符合伊斯兰教法的替代性金融产品。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以古兰经、圣训和古典伊斯兰法理学为教义基础，结合哈乃斐、马立克、沙斐仪和罕百里四大法学派对Ijarah的不同解释，强调资产所有权与收益使用权分离的核心区别。
AI.method: 文献分析与比较法学研究，对比四大伊斯兰法学派（哈乃斐、马立克、沙斐仪、罕百里）对Ijarah的处理方式。
AI.findings: Ijarah与利息借贷有根本区别：金融家通过提供真实资产的使用权赚取租金收入，而非通过使用货币收费。四大法学派在契约确定性、商业灵活性、习俗和避免不确定性之间各有平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了Ijarah在四大法学派中的不同处理方式，阐明了其与利息借贷的教义区分，丰富了伊斯兰金融中资产基础融资的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出Ijarah作为适合荷兰零售家庭和中小企业主的透明融资模式，具备面向欧盟市场设计的潜力，为非穆斯林国家的伊斯兰金融产品开发提供了实践路径。

title: Trade Arrangements Between Pakistan and EU/UK

detail.title: Trade Arrangements Between Pakistan and EU/UK
detail.abstract: This brief outlines the features of the EU's Generalized Scheme of Preferences Plus (GSP+) and the UK's post-Brexit Developing Countries Trading Scheme (DCTS), both of which give Pakistan preferential, tariff-free access to European and British markets respectively. It weighs these advantages against notable drawbacks — including export caps and demanding compliance requirements tied to international conventions — and argues that Pakistan should instead pursue full Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) with the EU and UK to secure more durable, equal-footing trade relationships and improve the quality and volume of its exports.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟GSP+和英国DCTS两个优惠贸易安排对巴基斯坦的利弊，主张巴基斯坦应争取与欧盟和英国签订全面自由贸易协定（FTA）以获得更稳定、平等的贸易关系。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦应如何优化其与欧盟和英国的贸易安排——是继续依赖GSP+/DCTS优惠方案，还是应追求全面的自由贸易协定？
AI.motivation: 现有优惠方案（GSP+和DCTS）虽给予巴基斯坦免关税准入，但存在出口上限和严格的国际公约合规要求等明显缺陷，需要探讨更优的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 优惠贸易安排（Preferential Trade Arrangements）与自由贸易协定（Free Trade Agreements）的比较分析框架。
AI.method: 政策分析与比较研究，对比GSP+/DCTS与FTA的利弊特征。
AI.findings: GSP+和DCTS虽提供免关税准入，但存在出口上限和严格的国际公约合规要求等缺陷；FTA能提供更持久、平等的贸易关系，有助于提升巴基斯坦出口的质量和数量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家如何在优惠贸易安排与自由贸易协定之间进行战略选择提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦及其他类似发展中国家制定对欧贸易战略提供了政策建议，即应追求FTA而非依赖优惠方案。

title: Murābaḥah Penalty Clause is Ribā in Disguise! The Penalty Clause Questions the Deep-rooted Preference for Literal Interpretation over Substantial Interpretation of Ribā

detail.title: Murābaḥah Penalty Clause is Ribā in Disguise! The Penalty Clause Questions the Deep-rooted Preference for Literal Interpretation over Substantial Interpretation of Ribā
detail.abstract: Following the literal interpretation of ribā, jurists have agreed that muḍārabah and mušārakah are legitimate modes of financing. As both arrangements are highly risky to manage in practice, murābaḥah has been introduced as an alternate mode of financing. Despite its extraordinary success, murābaḥah has led to moral hazard in the form of frequent delays in payments and defaults for which Islamic scholars have introduced a penalty clause as discouragement. Examination of the murābaḥah penalty clause instrument suggests that it is ribā, prohibited when interpreted literally. Moreover, the penalty clause has never been enforced in Pakistani courts. This article suggests that the literal interpretation based on the objectives of Sharīʿah (substantial interpretation) will prevent loopholes such as the abuse of the murābaḥah instrument and consequently the penalty clause as well and will lead to substantial compliance with the principles of Islamic finance.

AI.tldr: 本文指出伊斯兰金融中的穆拉巴哈（murābaḥah）罚则条款在字面解释下实质上等同于被禁止的利息（ribā），且在巴基斯坦法院从未被强制执行。作者主张基于沙里亚目标（maqāṣid al-Sharīʿah）的实质性解释，而非字面解释，能够堵住穆拉巴哈工具被滥用的漏洞，从而实现伊斯兰金融原则的实质性合规。
AI.research_question: 伊斯兰金融中穆拉巴哈（murābaḥah）的罚则条款在字面解释下是否等同于被禁止的利息（ribā）？如何通过基于沙里亚目标的实质性解释来避免这种悖论？
AI.motivation: 穆拉巴哈虽已成为伊斯兰金融最成功的融资模式，但其罚则条款在实际操作中面临道德风险（延迟付款和违约），且学者对其是否构成被禁的ribā存在争议。巴基斯坦法院从未执行该罚则，表明现行字面解释存在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊斯兰金融法原理（ribā禁令）、沙里亚目标（maqāṣid al-Sharīʿah）理论、字面解释 vs. 实质性解释的诠释学框架。
AI.method: 规范性法学分析（jurisprudential analysis），通过对穆拉巴哈合同及其罚则条款的文本解读，结合伊斯兰法学中字面解释与实质性解释的对比，以及巴基斯坦司法实践的经验观察。
AI.findings: （1）穆拉巴哈罚则条款在字面解释下确属被禁止的ribā；（2）该罚则在巴基斯坦法院从未被强制执行；（3）基于沙里亚目标的实质性解释能够避免字面解释导致的悖论，防止穆拉巴哈工具的滥用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为伊斯兰金融法诠释学提供了从字面解释转向实质性解释（基于maqāṣid al-Sharīʿah）的理论论证，澄清了罚则条款的合法性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议伊斯兰金融机构和司法实践采纳实质性解释路径，以增强穆拉巴哈合同的执行力，减少道德风险，促进伊斯兰金融原则的真正落实。

title: Social Media Disputes, Toxicity and Spillovers
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, Department of Applied Economics and University of Connecticut

detail.title: Social Media Disputes, Toxicity and Spillovers
detail.abstract: Online disputes are pervasive on social media, yet their effects on user welfare remain largely unexplored. We study fan-group disputes on Weibo, a leading social media platform in China, using 8.9 million posts from 30,516 users. Exploiting plausibly exogenous dispute shocks in a stacked difference-indifferences design, we show that disputes sharply increase toxic expression and late-night posting, with implications for both mental and physical well-being. The effects are especially pronounced among younger users, women, and opinion leaders. Mechanism evidence is consistent with identity reinforcement: disputes increase out-group-directed toxicity and support for the focal celebrity through consumption-related posting. We further document spillovers across topics and over time, showing that the harms of online disputes extend beyond the original conflict to the broader online discourse environment.

AI.tldr: 本文利用微博上8.9百万条帖子，研究粉丝群体间的在线争端如何通过增加恶意言论和深夜发帖行为，对用户的心理和生理健康产生负面影响，尤其对年轻用户、女性和意见领袖影响更大。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体上的粉丝群体争端如何影响用户福祉？
AI.motivation: 在线争端在社交媒体上普遍存在，但其对用户福祉的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份认同强化理论（identity reinforcement）
AI.method: 利用准外生的争端冲击，采用堆叠双重差分法（stacked difference-in-differences），分析微博上30,516名用户的890万条帖子。
AI.findings: （1）争端显著增加恶意言论和深夜发帖行为；（2）对年轻用户、女性和意见领袖影响更大；（3）机制上，争端增加对外群体的恶意和对内群体的消费型支持；（4）争端存在跨话题、跨时间的溢出效应，损害更广泛的在线讨论环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 从身份认同强化视角揭示了在线争端损害用户福祉的内在机制，拓展了社交媒体负面效应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台治理在线争端、保护用户（特别是弱势群体）心理健康提供了实证依据和政策启示。

title: The Sharpe Ratio within the ARMA-GARCH Framework
affiliations: Finance and Risk Engineering, NYU Tandon School of Engineering

detail.title: The Sharpe Ratio within the ARMA-GARCH Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The Sharpe ratio (SR) being the risk-adjusted asset return has been a major portfolio performance measure widely used by practitioners. In classical finance, risk is associated with price volatility that is usually estimated using the standard deviation (SD) of asset returns. This implies that returns are assumed to be independent, identically distributed, and Normal. There have been several analytical studies devoted to autocorrelations and volatility clustering (GARCH) in asset returns that highlighted importance of these effects for obtaining the adequate SR estimates. In this work, we offer a computational approach for calculating SR using the optimal ARMA-GARCH models that account for both autocorrelations and GARCH effects. First, for each given data sample, we use MLE-based derivations of the optimal ARMA-GARCH models with different flavors. Then, we compare the accuracy of these models out of sample using their forecasts of the 21 trading-day returns. Finally, we use the volatility (sigma) of the most accurate out-of-sample model for calculating SR. As an example of this approach, we discuss the AIC-based and BIC-based optimal ARMA-GARCH and ARMA-GJR-GARCH models for the S&P 500 returns in all one-year periods within 2000-2024. We found that the ARMA-GARCH sigma can be notably higher than SD in the samples with pronounced autocorrelations, which results in the corresponding changes in the SR values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于最优ARMA-GARCH模型计算夏普比率的计算方法，通过考虑收益率序列的自相关性和波动聚集性，得到比传统标准差法更准确的波动率估计，进而调整夏普比率数值。
AI.research_question: 如何通过考虑收益率的自相关性和GARCH效应，更准确地计算夏普比率？
AI.motivation: 传统夏普比率假设收益率独立同分布且服从正态分布，忽视了金融时间序列中普遍存在的自相关性和波动聚集性（GARCH效应），导致夏普比率估计不够准确。
AI.theoretical_framework: ARMA模型（处理自相关性）、GARCH/GJR-GARCH模型（处理波动聚集性和杠杆效应）、AIC/BIC信息准则（模型选择）、最大似然估计（MLE）
AI.method: 对每个样本数据，先通过MLE估计不同设定下的最优ARMA-GARCH模型；比较各模型对21个交易日收益率的样本外预测精度；选择样本外预测最准确的模型所估计的波动率（sigma）计算夏普比率。以2000-2024年间S&P 500指数每个一年期区间为例进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 在自相关性显著的样本中，ARMA-GARCH模型估计的sigma显著高于传统标准差，从而导致夏普比率发生相应变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自相关性和GARCH效应同时纳入夏普比率的计算框架，提供了比传统独立同分布假设更符合金融数据特征的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了一种更精确的夏普比率计算工具，有助于更合理地评估投资组合的风险调整后收益。

title: Regime-aware Risk-sensitive Reinforcement Learning for Trading: A Controlled Study of CVaR-constrained Policy Optimization under Distribution Shift

detail.title: Regime-aware Risk-sensitive Reinforcement Learning for Trading: A Controlled Study of CVaR-constrained Policy Optimization under Distribution Shift
detail.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents trained to maximize expected return can adopt positions whose downside risk is unacceptable in financial applications, where rare crisis regimes drive most large losses. We present a controlled study of risksensitive policy optimization for trading in which the data-generating process is known, so that the effect of the risk objective can be isolated from confounders such as deep function approximators and noisy historical data. We introduce a reproducible regime-switching market simulator with fat-tailed (Student-t) crisis dynamics, and compare three agents that share an identical proximal policy optimization (PPO) update: a risk-neutral baseline, a Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR)-constrained agent following the CVaR-PPO/CPPO formulation, and a mean-variance agent. All three risk mechanisms are expressed through a single trajectory-level advantage augmentation, making the comparison exact. Across five random seeds, the CVaR agent reduces the 5% tail loss of annual return from 34.0% to 28.0% and the mean maximum drawdown from 18.9% to 16.2% while sacrificing only 0.5 percentage points of mean annual return; sweeping the riskaversion coefficient traces a monotone risk-return frontier. A regime-conditional analysis shows that the benefit comes from cutting gross exposure specifically during high-volatility crisis periods. We further find that CVaR attains a better return-for-downside tradeoff than mean-variance, which by penalizing symmetric variance also sacrifices upside. Code and full experimental configuration are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文在已知数据生成过程的受控环境中，系统比较了风险中性、CVaR约束和均值-方差三种强化学习交易智能体，发现CVaR约束能在仅牺牲少量平均年化收益的情况下显著降低尾部风险和最大回撤，且优于均值-方差方法。
AI.research_question: 在金融交易中，风险敏感策略优化（特别是CVaR约束）相比风险中性基准和均值-方差方法，能否在不显著牺牲收益的情况下有效控制下行风险？
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体最大化期望收益时可能采取在金融应用中不可接受的下行风险头寸，而以往研究常因深度函数近似器、历史数据噪声等混杂因素难以隔离风险目标本身的真实效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险敏感强化学习；条件风险价值（CVaR）约束；均值-方差优化；机制转换市场模型；Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
AI.method: 构建已知数据生成过程的机制转换市场模拟器（含肥尾Student-t危机动态），设计三种共享相同PPO更新的智能体（风险中性基线、CVaR-PPO/CPPO智能体、均值-方差智能体），通过轨迹级优势增强统一表达三种风险机制，进行5个随机种子的对比实验。
AI.findings: CVaR智能体将年度收益率5%尾部损失从34.0%降至28.0%，最大回撤从18.9%降至16.2%，仅牺牲0.5个百分点的平均年化收益；收益来自在高波动危机时期降低总风险敞口；CVaR在下行风险-收益权衡上优于均值-方差方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 在隔离混杂因素的受控环境中验证了CVaR约束策略优化在金融交易中的有效性；揭示了CVaR约束降低尾部风险的机制在于危机时期主动降低风险敞口；证明了CVaR在下行风险控制上优于对称惩罚的均值-方差方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复现的机制转换市场模拟器和完整实验配置；为金融交易中的风险敏感RL部署提供了明确的量化参考（尾部损失降低6个百分点、最大回撤降低2.7个百分点、收益成本仅0.5个百分点）；验证了CVaR-PPO/CPPO框架在交易中的实际可行性。

title: India's Government e-Marketplace (GeM): Architecture, Outcomes, and a Replication Framework for the Global South

detail.title: India's Government e-Marketplace (GeM): Architecture, Outcomes, and a Replication Framework for the Global South

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is currently employed as Project Manager (MCD) – IT & Digital Governance at the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Government of India (On rolls of Velocis Systems pvt.ltd). The views expressed in this paper are entirely personal and do not represent the official position of NIC or any Government of India institution. The author has drawn only on publicly available data and practitioner observations. No financial conflict of interest exists.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, or primary fieldwork requiring ethics clearance. All data used is drawn from publicly available government publications and institutional reports.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding. The paper was prepared independently by the author using publicly available data sources.

detail.abstract: Public procurement, which constitutes between 15 and 20 percent of GDP in most developing countries, remains one of the most corruption-prone and inefficiency-laden functions of government in the Global South. Fragmented legal frameworks, opaque tendering processes, limited supplier access, and weak audit trails collectively cost developing economies hundreds of billions of dollars annually in leakages, overpricing, and foregone market participation by small businesses. India's Government e-Marketplace (GeM), launched in August 2016, offers a compelling and evidencebacked alternative. Within a decade, it has become the world's largest single-government procurement platform by order volume, transacting ₹18.4 lakh crore cumulatively and ₹5 lakh crore in FY 2025–26 alone, while simultaneously positioning Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs), womenled businesses, SC/ST entrepreneurs, and startups as primary beneficiaries of government demand. This brief examines GeM's architecture, its distinguishing design features, its measurable outcomes, and the institutional preconditions that made it possible. It then assesses the replication potential for Global South countries and proposes a structured framework for South-South cooperation through which India can share not just the platform, but the governance logic that makes it work. The analysis draws on publicly available GeM transaction data, World Bank assessments, and the author's practitioner experience in digital governance across multiple Government of India institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了印度政府电子市场（GeM）平台的设计架构、制度前提、可衡量成效及其对全球南方国家的复制潜力，并提出南南合作框架以输出该平台的治理逻辑。
AI.research_question: 印度GeM平台如何在高度腐败和低效的公共采购领域实现突破？其制度设计、可衡量成效及对全球南方国家的复制潜力是什么？
AI.motivation: 公共采购占发展中国家GDP的15%-20%，却是腐败和低效的重灾区，每年因漏损、定价过高和小企业市场排斥造成数千亿美元损失。印度GeM平台的成功提供了可验证的替代方案，其经验和复制路径对全球南方国家具有重要政策价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字治理理论、公共采购制度改革理论、制度经济学中的交易成本理论、平台经济学中的网络效应理论、南南合作与制度扩散理论。
AI.method: 基于公开可获取的GeM交易数据、世界银行评估报告，以及作者在印度多个政府机构从事数字治理的实践经验，进行定性制度分析与定量成效评估相结合的研究。
AI.findings: GeM在不到十年内成为全球订单量最大的单一政府采购平台，累计交易额达18.4万亿卢比，2025-26财年单年交易额达5万亿卢比；有效将小微企业、女性主导企业、表列种姓/表列部落企业家和初创企业定位为政府需求的主要受益者；平台的成功依赖于碎片化法律框架整合、透明招标流程、供应商准入扩展和审计追踪强化等制度前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字平台如何解决公共采购领域的制度腐败和效率低下问题提供了实证证据；拓展了数字治理理论在发展中国家政府采购场景中的应用；提出了制度扩散的南南合作理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方国家提供了可复制的公共采购数字化转型路线图；设计了包含平台输出和治理逻辑输出两个层面的南南合作结构化框架；为发展中国家节省数百亿美元的采购漏损提供了具体政策方案。

title: Financial Reporting Regulation, Market Power, and Welfare
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

detail.title: Financial Reporting Regulation, Market Power, and Welfare
detail.abstract: How does financial reporting regulation affect welfare? We present a novel outcome of financial reporting regulation: it can generate cross-sectional markup dispersion with considerable welfare effects, despite having no influence on the average firm. The cross-sectional markup dispersion has an impact on the misallocation of capital. Using a generalized difference-in-differences design centered around the Sarbanes Oxley Act, 2002 (SOX), we demonstrate that there is a reallocation of market power from young life cycle firms to mature firms, as measured by price-marginal cost markup. Young life cycle firms' markup decreases as mature firms' markup increases. There is a comparable redistribution of economic outputs. After regulation, high markup firms—which were already more mature and productive—have been able to increase both their productivity and intangible assets. However, compared to mature firms, the costs have risen disproportionately for younger firms. Cross-sectional markup dispersion reduces misallocation, as assessed by a decrease in the industry-level dispersion of Marginal Revenue Product of Capital (MRPK). Additionally, the regulation causes a labor reallocation from young to mature firms. The results uncover a distinct allocative role for transparency regulation that operates not through the average firm but through the cross-sectional market power dispersion it induces with significant welfare implications - improving eﬀiciency while generating sharp distributional consequences that fall on the young, innovation-intensive firms central to long-run growth.

AI.tldr: 本文发现财务报告监管（如SOX法案）会引发企业间的加价率（markup）横截面离散，导致资本从年轻企业向成熟企业重新配置，虽提高了整体效率，但产生了显著的分配效应，对年轻创新型企业构成不利冲击。
AI.research_question: 财务报告监管如何影响社会福利？
AI.motivation: 传统观点多关注监管对平均企业的影响，本文发现监管可通过影响企业间的横截面加价率离散度，对资本错配和福利产生重要影响，即使对平均企业无显著作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加价率（markup）离散度与资本错配（misallocation）；边际收入产出资本（MRPK）离散度衡量资源配置效率；生命周期理论（年轻企业与成熟企业的异质性）。
AI.method: 以2002年萨班斯-奥克斯利法案（SOX）为准自然实验，采用广义双重差分（generalized difference-in-differences）设计。
AI.findings: （1）监管导致市场势力从年轻企业向成熟企业再分配，年轻企业加价率下降，成熟企业加价率上升；（2）经济产出也发生类似再分配；（3）高加价率（本就更成熟、生产率更高）企业进一步提升生产率和无形资产；（4）年轻企业成本上升幅度不成比例地高于成熟企业；（5）行业层面MRPK离散度下降，即资本错配程度降低；（6）劳动力从年轻企业向成熟企业再分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了透明度监管的一个独特分配性作用——它不通过影响平均企业，而是通过诱发横截面市场势力离散来影响资源配置效率，同时产生显著的分配后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者权衡财务报告监管的效率收益与分配成本（尤其是对年轻创新企业的负面影响）提供了实证依据；提醒政策制定者关注监管的异质性效应。

title: Letting the Reins Loose: Central Bank Stock Purchases and Corporate Governance
affiliations: ,  and Meisei University

detail.title: Letting the Reins Loose: Central Bank Stock Purchases and Corporate Governance
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) equity purchases via exchangetraded funds (ETFs) on firm-level corporate governance. As part of its unconventional monetary easing policy, the BOJ became one of the world's largest institutional shareholders, raising concerns about the governance implications of passive central bank ownership. Using a panel of Japanese listed firms from 2006-2023, we construct a composite governance index and employ a Difference-inDifferences framework with continuous treatment intensity. Our baseline estimates indicate that a 1% increase in the BOJ's effective ownership share is associated with a decline in the governance index of approximately 0.7 points, with the effects concentrated in shareholder structure and board accountability. These findings suggest a trade-off: while central bank equity purchases stabilize markets, they can weaken corporate discipline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究日本央行通过ETF购买股票对公司治理的影响，发现央行持股比例每增加1%，公司治理指数下降约0.7分，主要体现在股东结构和董事会问责方面。
AI.research_question: 日本央行通过ETF购买股票如何影响企业的公司治理水平？
AI.motivation: 日本央行通过ETF成为全球最大机构股东之一，这种被动的央行所有权对公司治理的影响引发担忧，但相关实证研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、机构投资者治理理论、央行非常规货币政策理论
AI.method: 使用2006-2023年日本上市公司面板数据，构建综合公司治理指数，采用连续处理强度的双重差分模型。
AI.findings: 央行有效持股比例每增加1%，公司治理指数下降约0.7分，影响主要集中在股东结构和董事会问责维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了被动中央行所有权对企业治理的负面影响，拓展了机构投资者持股与公司治理关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行非常规货币政策的治理后果提供实证证据，提示政策制定者需平衡市场稳定与公司纪律之间的权衡。

title: Labor, Investment and Financing Decisions with Diffusion and Jump Ambiguity
affiliations: Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics, Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics and Jishou University

detail.title: Labor, Investment and Financing Decisions with Diffusion and Jump Ambiguity
detail.abstract: We develop a dynamic real-options model of a firm with market power that incorporates diffusion and jump ambiguity in product-market demand. The model elucidates how ambiguity affects investment timing, labor demand, operating scale, financing policy, and welfare when the firm jointly chooses labor, capital, debt, and default policy. First, ambiguity generates two opposite effects, i.e., the project-value effect, which reduces the robust value of post-investment cash flows, and the option-multiple effect, which decreases the first-passage valuation of waiting. Furthermore, the investment threshold has a non-monotone relationship with ambiguity, which is driven by the two effects. Second, decomposing ambiguity shows that diffusion ambiguity is mainly reflected in the project-value effect, whereas jump ambiguity is mainly reflected in the option-multiple effect. Third, ambiguity reduces operating scale through the joint choice of capital and labor. At the investment threshold, however, capital and labor are governed by the jump-adjusted option multiple rather than by the payoff coefficient alone. Fourth, ambiguity lowers debt capacity and raises credit spreads. Finally, ambiguity widens the private-social wedge: compared with a social planner who internalizes consumer surplus, private levered policies reduces labor and output and delay investment, thereby giving rise to welfare losses.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含市场势力的动态实物期权模型，引入产品市场需求的扩散模糊性和跳跃模糊性，系统分析了模糊性如何影响企业的投资时机、劳动力需求、运营规模、融资政策和福利水平。
AI.research_question: 当企业面临产品市场需求中的扩散模糊性和跳跃模糊性时，模糊性如何影响企业关于投资时机、劳动力雇佣、运营规模、债务融资和违约策略的联合决策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少同时考虑市场势力、模糊性与企业动态投融资决策的交互作用，尤其缺乏对扩散模糊性与跳跃模糊性不同经济效应的区分，以及模糊性对私人-社会福利差距影响的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态实物期权理论、模糊性厌恶（稳健控制）、市场势力模型、资本-劳动联合决策、最优资本结构理论
AI.method: 构建动态实物期权模型，引入扩散模糊性和跳跃模糊性，通过稳健控制方法刻画企业的模糊性厌恶，求解企业关于投资、劳动力、资本、债务和违约的联合最优决策。
AI.findings: （1）模糊性产生两种相反效应：项目价值效应（降低投资后现金流稳健价值）和期权乘数效应（降低等待的首次通过估值），投资阈值与模糊性呈非单调关系；（2）扩散模糊性主要体现为项目价值效应，跳跃模糊性主要体现为期权乘数效应；（3）模糊性通过资本和劳动的联合选择降低运营规模；（4）模糊性降低债务容量并提高信用利差；（5）模糊性扩大私人-社会福利差距，导致福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了扩散模糊性与跳跃模糊性在投资决策中的不同作用机制；揭示了投资阈值与模糊性的非单调关系；建立了模糊性条件下企业投融资与劳动力联合决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者在需求不确定性环境下优化投资、融资和雇佣决策提供理论指导；为政策制定者理解模糊性如何导致市场失灵和福利损失提供依据。

title: Slice Sampling the Polyak Ravine
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Slice Sampling the Polyak Ravine
detail.abstract: Polyak’s ravine is a deceptively simple global optimization problem: minimize f(x) = min{99 − c ⊤x,(c ⊤x − 99)/398} over the ball ∥x∥ ≤ 100 in R n. A long shallow valley of slope 1/398 leads descent methods to a local minimum of value −1/2, while the global minimum of value −1 hides behind a steep face inside a spherical cap whose relative volume decays geometrically in n. Following Birge and Polson (2012), we recast the problem as sampling the Boltzmann distribution πκ(x) ∝ e −κf(x) with an auxiliary variable slice sampler, and we develop the theory in full. Because f depends on x only through the projection s = c ⊤x, the ideal two block sampler collapses exactly to a one dimensional slice chain, and every question becomes tractable. We prove: a Doeblin minorization giving uniform ergodicity with the explicit rate ∥P g x −πκ∥TV ≤ (1−e −κ ) g ; a sighting bound showing that from the valley interior the chain sees the winning cap at essentially the uniform search rate, so the information theoretic hardness is respected; a refinement theorem showing that, once inside a cap, the optimality gap contracts at the exact rate E[log Dg+1 | Dg = d] ≤ log d− 2 n+1 + 1 κd , so polishing costs O(n log(1/ε)) iterations; and a tunneling theorem giving the exact one step escape probability from the local optimum, whose n → ∞ limit is 1 − e −κ/794 with explicit O(κ/n) finite dimension error, so a temperature of order a thousand suffices at any n. The last result yields a drill and tunnel mechanism, confirmed numerically at n = 50, in which the sampler escapes the local minimum by first descending into it: sharp local minima betray themselves to slice samplers because their shallow level sets grow too slowly to hold the chain against the competing cap. We also prove that the critical temperature at which the winning cap captures half the Boltzmann mass grows as κ ∗ (n) = γ ∗n + β ∗ + o(1) with γ ∗ ≈ 5.8175 the root of an explicit variational equation and β ∗ ≈ 6.11 a second order Laplace constant, and that for n ≥ 6 the cap mass is initially decreasing in κ, so mild tempering helps the wrong minimum first.

AI.tldr: 本文对Polyak's ravine这一高维全局优化问题进行了完整的马尔可夫链理论分析，证明切片采样器能够通过"先下降后隧穿"机制逃离局部最优，并给出了显式的收敛速率和逃逸概率。
AI.research_question: 切片采样器（slice sampler）在Polyak's ravine这一高维非凸优化问题中的理论表现如何？能否克服"峡谷"陷阱找到全局最优？
AI.motivation: Polyak's ravine是一个经典的高维全局优化难题：一个长浅谷误导梯度下降方法走向局部最优（值-1/2），而全局最优（值-1）隐藏在一个几何体积随维度指数衰减的球冠内。传统优化方法难以突破，但贝叶斯采样方法可能提供新路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Boltzmann分布采样框架；切片采样器（slice sampler）；马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）；Doeblin minorization；几何遍历性理论。
AI.method: 将优化问题重新表述为从Boltzmann分布π_κ(x) ∝ e^{-κf(x)}采样；利用f(x)仅依赖于投影s=c^Tx的特性，将二维分块切片采样器精确坍缩为一维切片链，从而使所有问题可解析处理。
AI.findings: (1) 均匀遍历性：显式率‖P^g x - π_κ‖_TV ≤ (1-e^{-κ})^g；(2) 搜索效率：从峡谷内部看，链找到获胜球冠的速度等价于均匀搜索率；(3) 精炼速率：进入球冠后，最优间隙收缩率为E[log D_{g+1}|D_g=d] ≤ log d - 2/(n+1) + 1/(κd)；(4) 逃逸概率：精确一步逃逸概率，n→∞时极限为1-e^{-κ/794}，有限维度误差O(κ/n)；(5) 临界温度：κ*(n)=γ*n+β*+o(1)，其中γ*≈5.8175，β*≈6.11。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次给出了Polyak's ravine问题的完整MCMC理论分析；(2) 提出了"钻探-隧穿"（drill and tunnel）机制：切片采样器先下降进入局部最优，然后隧穿逃离；(3) 证明了局部最优的浅层水平集增长缓慢，无法"困住"切片链，从而揭示了"尖锐的局部最小值反而会暴露自身"的反直觉现象；(4) 给出了临界温度的渐近表达式。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 证明了切片采样器在高维非凸优化中具有理论保证，温度参数κ在约1000量级时即可有效工作；(2) 数值验证（n=50）支持理论结果；(3) 为MCMC方法在全局优化中的应用提供了坚实的理论基础，特别是"适度升温首先帮助错误的最小值"这一反直觉发现对调参具有重要指导意义。

title: Automated Tax Decisions: Revisiting Part IVC, The ADJR Act and Taxpayer Rights
affiliations: Curtin University - Curtin Law School

detail.title: Automated Tax Decisions: Revisiting Part IVC, The ADJR Act and Taxpayer Rights
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is expected to play a substantive role in future Australian tax administration by automating aspects of assessments and administrative decision-making. Yet the legal frameworks governing review and accountability remain anchored in assumptions of human deliberation. This article examines the implications of automated tax decisions for taxpayer rights through an analysis of Part IVC of the Taxation Administration Act 1953 (Cth) and the Administrative Decisions (Judicial Review) Act 1977 (Cth). It argues that both regimes are poorly aligned with technology-driven administrative practices. The article suggests that targeted adjustments—particularly in relation to transparency obligations, evidentiary burdens and the legal status of automated decision letters—are necessary to preserve intelligibility, fairness and meaningful access to review. In turn, such reforms are essential to maintaining public trust in the tax system and supporting the effective operation of Australia’s self-assessment regime.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了澳大利亚现行税务审查与问责法律框架（Part IVC和ADJR法案）与自动化税务决策之间的不匹配，指出两者均未适应人工智能驱动的税务管理实践，并提出透明度、举证责任和自动化决策函法律地位等方面的针对性改革建议。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚现行法律框架（Part IVC和ADJR法案）如何影响自动化税务决策下纳税人权利的保障？需要哪些法律调整来适应人工智能驱动的税务管理？
AI.motivation: 人工智能将在澳大利亚税务管理中发挥实质性作用，但现行审查与问责法律框架仍固守于人类决策的假设，两者之间存在严重错位，可能损害纳税人权利和公众信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法中的审查与问责理论、纳税人权利保护理论、自动化决策与法律透明度理论。
AI.method: 法律条文分析（Part IVC of Taxation Administration Act 1953 和 Administrative Decisions (Judicial Review) Act 1977）、比较分析与规范论证。
AI.findings: 现行两大法律框架均与技术驱动的行政实践严重不匹配；自动化税务决策在透明度、举证责任和决策函法律地位方面存在根本性缺陷，损害了可理解性、公平性和有意义的审查权。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人工智能时代传统行政法审查框架的理论局限性，提出了自动化行政决策中"可理解性"与"有意义审查"的理论内涵更新需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为澳大利亚乃至其他采用自动化税务管理的司法管辖区提供了具体的法律改革建议：强化透明度义务、调整举证责任分配、明确自动化决策函的法律地位，以维护纳税人权利和公众对税制的信任。

title: Randomization in Optimization and Simulation: The Russian School Meets Generative Bayesian Computation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Randomization in Optimization and Simulation: The Russian School Meets Generative Bayesian Computation
detail.abstract: When is a random choice better than a deterministic one? Polyak and Shcherbakov posed this question for robustness, estimation, and optimization and gave a largely cautionary answer: direct Monte Carlo fails exponentially in dimension even for the best convex problems, while carefully structured randomization (random search with smoothing, randomized coordinate descent, random feasibility algorithms, hit-and-run) succeeds. We revisit their program from the standpoint of generative Bayesian computation (GBC) and sequential simulation, and argue that the two schools solve dual problems. The Russian school randomizes the algorithm while treating the objective as a black box; the generative school randomizes the representation, converting optimization into sampling from a tilted measure. A single quantity, the chi-square divergence between the tilted target and the proposal, equals the relative variance of every estimator in the paper and is the common ledger for the comparison. Three case studies make the duality precise. For a linear function on a ball, a Laplace-method argument shows that a von Mises-Fisher tilt collapses Polyak and Shcherbakov's exponential sample size to a dimension-free one, and adaptive multilevel splitting achieves the same in polynomial time without conjugacy. For convex optimization the argument becomes a theorem: the tilt is log-concave, hit-and-run samples it in polynomial dimension, and annealing the temperature yields a polynomial-time optimizer, so the Russian school's own hit-and-run, wrapped in a homotopy of tilts, is the generative solver. For self-avoiding walks the optimal proposal is a Doob transform, and a product bound on the sequential chi-square explains exactly when importance weights degenerate. We are equally precise about the limits: the guarantees are coextensive with log-concavity, weights degenerate exponentially otherwise, and no method escapes the Nemirovskii-Yudin lower bounds on nonconvex targets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了随机化算法与确定性算法的比较问题，将Polyak和Shcherbakov的俄罗斯学派（随机化算法）与生成式贝叶斯计算学派（随机化表示）联系起来，证明二者解决的是对偶问题。关键发现是：卡方散度是连接两学派的统一度量，通过对数凹性条件下的倾斜变换，可将指数级样本量降至维度无关，但非凸目标仍无法超越Nemirovskii-Yudin下界。
AI.research_question: 何时随机选择优于确定性选择？具体而言，如何比较俄罗斯学派（随机化算法，将目标函数视为黑箱）与生成式贝叶斯计算学派（随机化表示，将优化转化为从倾斜测度中采样）的优劣？
AI.motivation: Polyak和Shcherbakov曾提出随机化方法在高维凸问题中可能指数级失败，但结构化随机化策略成功。本文希望从生成式贝叶斯计算的视角重新审视这一问题，建立两大学派之间的对偶关系，并找出统一的理论框架进行比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡方散度（chi-square divergence）、倾斜测度（tilted measure）、拉普拉斯方法（Laplace method）、对数凹性（log-concavity）、Doob变换、自适应多层分裂（adaptive multilevel splitting）、退火（annealing）、Nemirovskii-Yudin下界。
AI.method: 理论推导与案例分析相结合。通过三个案例（球上线性函数、凸优化、自避行走）精确阐述对偶性，并分析不同条件下的样本复杂度。
AI.findings: 1）卡方散度是统一衡量所有估计量相对方差的关键指标；2）在线性函数案例中，von Mises-Fisher倾斜可将指数级样本量降至维度无关，自适应多层分裂在多项式时间内实现；3）凸优化中，对数凹倾斜可通过hit-and-run在多项式维度采样，退火温度可得到多项式时间优化器；4）自避行走的最优提议是Doob变换，序贯卡方乘积界准确解释了重要性权重何时退化；5）保证与对数凹性共延，否则权重指数级退化，非凸目标无法超越Nemirovskii-Yudin下界。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了俄罗斯学派（算法随机化）与生成式贝叶斯计算学派（表示随机化）之间的对偶关系；2）提出卡方散度作为两大学派的统一核算标准；3）将倾斜变换与优化问题联系起来，揭示了退火倾斜下的hit-and-run可作为生成式优化器。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为高维贝叶斯计算提供了样本复杂度的精确刻画；2）明确了结构化随机化方法（如倾斜变换、自适应多层分裂）的成功条件与失败边界；3）为实践者提供了选择随机化策略的理论指导，尤其是在对数凹条件下可实现多项式时间算法。

title: THE COST OF ASKING: Investment Chill in the Run-Up to Separation Referendums

detail.title: THE COST OF ASKING: Investment Chill in the Run-Up to Separation Referendums

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial interest in any firm named in this paper, including the firms in the three event-study portfolios listed in Appendix B. The author holds no equity, debt, advisory, board, or consulting relationship with any Alberta or Ontario headquartered firm in the sample, and received no compensation from any party for this work. The author is a Canadian citizen resident in Alberta and British Columbia, and therefore has a personal stake in the outcome of the October 19, 2026 referendum. The analysis is positive rather than normative. The paper does not advocate a vote in either direction, and Section 5 states explicitly that the policy discussion is conditional on federal objectives rather than a recommendation. Generative AI was used for light editorial support, including grammar, consistency, and phrasing, and to assist with brainstorming titles and clarifying wording around the interpretation of statistical results. All analysis, arguments, and substantive contributions are the author's own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or personally identifiable data, and therefore did not require ethics review. The analysis uses publicly available macroeconomic series from Statistics Canada, the Bank of Canada, the Office for National Statistics, the Bank of England, Idescat, the Colegio de Registradores de Espana, and FRED, together with firm-level daily equity return and market capitalization data from Compustat North America Daily. All firms in the sample are publicly listed. No individual-level data were collected or used.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding. It was conducted independently, without financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit agency, and without institutional grant support. The author received no compensation for this work. Data were drawn from public sources listed in Appendix A, and from Compustat North America Daily, accessed through the author's University of Calgary institutional subscription.

detail.abstract: On May 21, 2026, Premier Danielle Smith added a tenth question to Alberta's October 19 ballot: should the province start the legal process to hold a binding separation referendum? The political debate that followed concentrated on the result. I take up a different question. What happens to inward investment in the months before a separation referendum, and in the decade after, regardless of how the vote goes? I compare four historical cases, Quebec 1980 and 1995, the United Kingdom 2016, Scotland 2014, and Catalonia 2017, on a common framework: headquarters relocations, inward-investment shares, sovereign-yield repricing, and long-run economic-share persistence. The pattern is consistent and the result is uncomfortable. Capital reallocation begins on the separatist signal. Legal headquarters move first. Inward-investment shares decline and do not fully recover. Persistence does not depend on outcome. Quebec has run negative net interprovincial migration in every year of the StatCan series, 54 consecutive years from 1971/72 through 2024/25; the outflow had been shrinking into the mid-1970s, then the November 1976 Parti Quebecois victory sharply reversed and deepened it, producing the worst year on record in 1977/78 at minus 46,429. Its share of Canadian non-residential investment fell from 22.5 percent in 1976 to 17.6 percent in 1981 and never recovered. Catalan foreign direct investment in 2024 still sits below its 2016 peak, seven years after a vote Spain nullified. I then apply the framework to Alberta. A difference-indifferences event study on daily returns of forty-nine Alberta-headquartered oil and gas firms against one hundred and fifty-four large Ontario-headquartered firms, oil-controlled, shows the abnormal-return distribution shifted at the December 8, 2022 Sovereignty Act royal assent (Welch t equals minus 2.01, p equals 0.045). A within-Alberta cross-sectional placebo passes cleanly (Welch t equals 0.16, p equals 0.87): the effect is in the oil and gas sector, not in Alberta firms generally. The cross-case range predicts an investment chill of one to four percentage points of Alberta's share of Canadian inward investment, persisting for at least a decade, regardless of the October outcome. The cost of asking is paid before the answer is given.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分离公投前后对内投资的影响。通过比较魁北克（1980、1995）、英国脱欧（2016）、苏格兰（2014）和加泰罗尼亚（2017）四个历史案例，发现资本重新配置在分离信号发出时就开始，法律总部先行搬迁，内投资份额下降且无法完全恢复，该效应不依赖于投票结果。将此框架应用于阿尔伯塔省，发现2022年《主权法案》批准后，阿尔伯塔油气企业的异常收益分布发生了显著偏移，预测阿尔伯塔将面临持续至少十年的投资降温。
AI.research_question: 分离公投前后几个月和之后十年内，对内投资会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 现有政治争论集中于公投的"结果"，而忽略了"提问"本身带来的经济代价，特别是对内投资的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较案例框架，涵盖总部搬迁、内投资份额、主权收益重新定价和长期经济份额持续性四个维度。
AI.method: 历史比较案例研究（魁北克、英国、苏格兰、加泰罗尼亚）结合双重差分事件研究法（阿尔伯塔油气企业 vs 安大略油气企业）。
AI.findings: 资本重新配置在分离信号发出时即开始；总部先行搬迁；内投资份额下降且无法完全恢复；该效应独立于公投结果。魁北克经历了54年连续净省际迁出；加泰罗尼亚FDI在七年后的2024年仍低于2016年峰值。阿尔伯塔油气企业在《主权法案》批准后异常收益显著下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"提问的代价"——分离公投本身就是一种成本，无论结果如何，对内投资的损害在投票前已经开始并持续多年。
AI.practical_contributions: 预测阿尔伯塔将损失1-4个百分点的加拿大内投资份额，且至少持续十年，为政策制定者提供量化依据。

title: From Demand Forecasting to Inventory Resilience: A Risk-sensitive Decision-Support Framework for Multi-echelon Enterprise Operations
affiliations: University of Gloucestershire

detail.title: From Demand Forecasting to Inventory Resilience: A Risk-sensitive Decision-Support Framework for Multi-echelon Enterprise Operations
detail.abstract: Demand forecasting is central to enterprise operations, yet statistical forecast accuracy does not directly determine whether an inventory system avoids stockouts, excessive stock accumulation, unstable ordering, and service-level degradation. This paper proposes a risk-sensitive decision-support framework that translates SKU-store demand forecasts into downstream inventory-resilience outcomes. The empirical study uses the public M5/Walmart forecasting benchmark, containing 30,490 finest-level SKU-store daily sales series across 3,049 items, 10 stores, 3 states, and three product categories. A transparent active-sample rule retains 26,483 SKU-store series with recent and holdout demand activity. Eight forecasting policies are evaluated over the final 28-day holdout window, including seven transparent statistical policies and one applied machine-learning baseline based on global Ridge regression with lag, rolling-window, calendar, and hierarchy features. Forecasts are then passed into a simulated multi-echelon replenishment environment consisting of store-level base-stock control and state-level distribution-center aggregation. The simulation reports service level, stockout rate, overstock exposure, holding cost, order frequency, and an Inventory Resilience Score (IRS). The results show that Moving Average 28 achieves the lowest MAE (1.164) and WAPE (0.724), whereas Risk-Adjusted MA28 achieves the highest IRS (88.021), the highest service level (96.29%), and the lowest stockout rate (1.98%). The Ridge regression model provides an applied AI benchmark, but its uncalibrated negative bias produces weaker inventoryresilience outcomes, reinforcing the need to evaluate AI forecasts through operational risk metrics rather than accuracy alone. Category and state breakdowns indicate higher simulated risk for FOODS and CA under the selected risk-sensitive policy. Sensitivity analysis confirms that Risk-Adjusted MA28 remains the top IRS model under changes in lead time, safety factor, and stockout penalty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个风险敏感的决策支持框架，将SKU-门店的需求预测转化为库存韧性结果。基于M5/Walmart公开基准数据，评估八种预测策略，发现风险调整的移动平均法（Risk-Adjusted MA28）在库存韧性评分（IRS）和服务水平上优于传统精度指标最优的模型，而机器学习模型因未校准的负向偏差导致库存韧性表现较差。
AI.research_question: 统计预测精度（如MAE、WAPE）能否直接决定库存系统在缺货、过度库存、订单不稳定和服务水平退化方面的表现？如何将需求预测转化为下游库存韧性结果？
AI.motivation: 传统上企业过度关注预测精度指标，但统计预测精度并不直接决定库存系统是否避免缺货、过度库存、订单不稳定和服务水平退化。因此需要建立一个风险敏感的决策支持框架，将预测与库存韧性结果直接关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 库存韧性（Inventory Resilience）、多级库存补货系统（多梯队补货环境）、基库存控制（Base-Stock Control）、风险敏感决策框架
AI.method: 使用M5/Walmart公开基准数据（30,490个SKU-门店日销售序列），经主动样本筛选保留26,483个序列。评估八种预测策略（七种透明统计策略和一种基于全局Ridge回归的机器学习基线），将预测输入模拟的多梯队补货环境（门店级基库存控制+州级配送中心聚合），计算服务水平、缺货率、过度库存暴露、持有成本、订单频率和库存韧性评分（IRS）。
AI.findings: (1) 移动平均28天（MA28）在MAE（1.164）和WAPE（0.724）上最低；(2) 风险调整的MA28（Risk-Adjusted MA28）在IRS（88.021）、服务水平（96.29%）和缺货率（1.98%）上最优；(3) Ridge回归模型作为AI基准，其未校准的负向偏差导致较差的库存韧性结果；(4) FOODS和CA品类在风险敏感政策下模拟风险更高；(5) 敏感性分析确认Risk-Adjusted MA28在提前期、安全因子和缺货惩罚变化下仍是IRS最优模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了库存韧性评分（IRS）这一综合评估指标；揭示了预测精度与库存运营绩效之间的非直接对应关系；强调了在AI预测中需要引入运营风险指标而非仅依赖精度评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了将需求预测与库存管理决策直接链接的风险敏感框架；推荐了风险调整的移动平均法作为实际库存补货的优先选择；提醒企业在部署AI预测模型时需校准偏差以避免库存韧性下降。

title:
People’s Republic of China’s Strategic

 Cognitive Warfare
affiliations: Liberty University - Helms School of Government

detail.title:
People’s Republic of China’s Strategic

 Cognitive Warfare
detail.abstract:
This thesis argues that the People's Republic of China (PRC) is engaged in systematic cognitive warfare against the United States. This campaign is a whole-of-government and whole-of-society effort, with roots in Chairman Mao Zedong's methods of population control, later adapted for the internet age and informed by the "Three Warfares" doctrine of public opinion, psychological, and legal warfare.

The PRC's strategic narrative positions China as a victim of past Western aggression, now rightfully claiming its place as a global leader. It portrays the United States as a declining, corrupt power and presents itself as a better steward of the international "rules-based order." Through sophisticated social media tactics, the PRC aims to sow division, undermine U.S. institutions, and weaken the nation's will.

Conversely, the United States is depicted as operating with an outdated 1990s information operations doctrine, lacking a clear strategic message and a coordinated, whole-of-government response to 21st-century cognitive threats. The thesis proposes that the U.S. has the capacity and a powerful, proven strategic message rooted in the principles of the Declaration of Independence to counter this threat. The central challenge for the U.S. is not a lack of capability, but the will to implement a comprehensive cognitive warfare strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文论述中华人民共和国正在对美国发动系统性认知战，该运动根植于毛泽东的人口控制方法，后适应互联网时代并融合了"三种战争"（舆论战、心理战、法律战）理论。美国仍沿用过时的信息作战理论，缺乏协调统一的应对策略。论文提出美国有能力基于《独立宣言》原则进行反击，关键在于是否有意志实施全面的认知战战略。
AI.research_question: 中国如何对美国进行系统性认知战？美国应如何有效应对这一威胁？
AI.motivation: 揭示中国认知战策略的系统性与历史根源，指出美国现行应对策略的不足，呼吁美国采取更积极的认知防御与反击战略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 毛泽东人口控制方法、互联网时代适应性改造、"三种战争"（舆论战、心理战、法律战）理论、认知战理论、战略叙事理论。
AI.method: 基于对中国官方文件、战略论述及社交媒体行为的综合分析，结合美国现行信息作战理论进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1) 中国的认知战是"全政府、全社会"的系统性努力；2) 中国战略叙事将自身塑造为受害者、将美国描绘为衰落腐败力量；3) 美国沿用90年代信息作战理论，缺乏统一战略信息与协调响应；4) 美国的核心问题不在于能力，而在于实施全面认知战战略的意志。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"三种战争"理论与互联网时代认知战实践相结合，提出认知战系从传统信息战向更高层次战略博弈的演进视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国政府提供认知战应对策略建议，指出美国应以《独立宣言》原则为核心构建反叙事，并提出克服"意志障碍"是首要任务。

title: Factor-Residual Local Turning Calculus for Model Validation and Stress-Gated Usage Control

detail.title: Factor-Residual Local Turning Calculus for Model Validation and Stress-Gated Usage Control
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Factor-Residual Local Turning Calculus (FR-LTC), a model-validation framework for detecting and controlling residual local-turning structure in matrix-valued financial or computational data. The method extends scalar oscillatory-envelope local-turning calculus by placing it inside a conservative teacher-residual architecture. Instead of fitting local oscillatory patterns directly to raw observations, FR-LTC first removes known structure through a teacher baseline, forms a residual matrix, extracts stable low-rank residual modes, and applies scalar oscillatory-envelope diagnostics only to the resulting residual-mode scores.

The framework separates residual-shape detection from model-use permission. Singular gaps, low-rank subspace stability, rank robustness, residual-mode fitting loss, parameter stability, derivative diagnostics, stress sensitivity, and overfitting indicators are collected into a diagnostic vector. A stress-gated decision rule then maps the residual structure to one of four usage states: accept, downgrade, fallback, or reject. The purpose is not to prove market predictability, but to assess whether residual local-turning structure is stable enough for limited diagnostic use or should instead be treated as noise, missing factor exposure, regime shift, jump risk, or potential model misuse.

The paper also includes a scientific-computing audit layer that reports residual-bookkeeping error, ordinary-least-squares projection error, singular-value decomposition reconstruction error, singular-vector orthogonality, selected-rank truncation error, and finite-difference checks of analytic derivative diagnostics. A reproducible Python implementation demonstrates the conservative residual-diagnostic version on synthetic data, where the base window is accepted while a severe jump-and-rotation stress is downgraded to fallback. FR-LTC is therefore positioned as an auditable model-validation and model-risk diagnostic framework for residual local structure, rather than as a standalone trading or forecasting model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因子-残差局部转向微积分（FR-LTC），一种用于检测和控制矩阵数据中残差局部转向结构的模型验证框架。它通过教师-学生架构分离已知结构，对残差矩阵进行低秩分解和诊断，并用压力门控决策规则将结果映射为接受、降级、回退或拒绝四种使用状态。该方法定位为可审计的模型验证工具，而非交易或预测模型。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地检测和评估金融或计算数据中残差局部转向结构的稳定性，以判断其是否可用于有限的诊断用途，还是应被视为噪声、缺失因子暴露、制度转换、跳跃风险或潜在模型误用？
AI.motivation: 现有局部转向微积分直接对原始观测数据拟合局部振荡模式，难以区分真实信号与噪声或模型误用。需要一个保守的框架，先移除已知结构，再对残差进行诊断，并将残差结构分类为不同的使用状态，以增强模型验证的可审计性和风险管理能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 局部转向微积分（Local Turning Calculus）；2) 教师-学生架构（Teacher-Residual Architecture）；3) 低秩矩阵分解；4) 奇异值分解（SVD）；5) 压力门控决策规则（Stress-gated Decision Rule）。
AI.method: (1) 使用教师基线移除已知结构，形成残差矩阵；(2) 提取稳定的低秩残差模式；(3) 对标量振荡包络诊断应用于残差模式得分；(4) 收集诊断向量（包括奇异间隙、低秩子空间稳定性、秩稳健性、残差模式拟合损失、参数稳定性、导数诊断、压力敏感性和过拟合指标）；(5) 通过压力门控决策规则将残差结构映射为四种使用状态之一；(6) 加入科学计算审计层报告多种误差和正交性检查。
AI.findings: 在合成数据上，FR-LTC的保守残差诊断版本能够正确接受基准窗口，而对于严重的跳跃加旋转压力场景则降级为回退状态。该框架实现了残差形状检测与模型使用许可的分离，并提供了全面的可审计诊断报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 将标量振荡包络局部转向微积分扩展为因子-残差框架，引入教师-残差架构分离已知结构和残差诊断；提出压力门控决策规则将残差结构分类为四种使用状态；整合科学计算审计层以提高模型验证的可信度和可重复性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融和计算数据领域的模型验证和模型风险管理提供了可审计的诊断框架；帮助实践者判断残差局部结构是稳定可用还是应被忽略或降级处理；提供了可复现的Python实现，便于实际应用。

title: Beyond Organisational Governance: DARF Portability and Attributable Resolution Authority in Sovereign Systems

detail.title: Beyond Organisational Governance: DARF Portability and Attributable Resolution Authority in Sovereign Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relied exclusively on secondary literature, publicly available institutional documents, and public sovereign debt case materials. No human participants, interviews, patient data, or confidential datasets were used. Formal ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author through the Bentum Institute for Labour and Economic Systems. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines whether the Decision and Authority Resolution Framework (DARF), originally developed for organisational governance environments, remains diagnostically valid when applied to sovereign economic governance systems. DARF assumes that authority converges through hierarchy, governance records function as operational accountability trails, and formal authority reliably evidences real closure authority. This paper tests whether these structural assumptions survive translation into sovereign governance contexts.

Three structural breakpoints emerge. First, single authority convergence frequently fails in sovereign systems because authority is distributed by design. Second, formal accountability chains weaken as formal authority and real closure authority diverge at consequential governance moments. Third, governance records function increasingly as political signals rather than operational accountability trails, creating what this paper identifies as the Sovereign False Confidence Signal.

These breakpoints destabilise ownership, DARF’s original diagnostic variable. The paper evaluates three responses: retention of modified ownership, replacement through Attributable Resolution Authority (ARA), and Distributed Binding Authority as an alternative interpretive frame. On current theoretical and secondary evidence, ARA emerges as the strongest candidate replacement variable.

ARA tests whether binding authority for final resolution can be prospectively located, evidenced, and attributed to a specific actor or actor combination before consequential closure becomes necessary. The paper concludes that DARF portability into sovereign governance is conditional rather than universal, and that ARA is provisionally supported as the strongest diagnostic variable for fragmented sovereign governance environments. Empirical validation remains the next research priority.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了原本用于组织治理的DARF框架是否适用于主权经济治理体系，发现三个结构性断裂点，并提出ARA作为替代诊断变量。
AI.research_question: DARF框架是否适用于主权经济治理体系？其结构性假设在主权治理情境下是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: DARF框架最初为组织治理环境设计，但其向主权治理体系的移植有效性尚未检验，存在理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策与权威解决框架（DARF）、主权治理理论、权威收敛理论、归属解决权威（ARA）
AI.method: 理论检验与概念分析，基于已有理论和二手证据进行结构性断裂点识别与替代变量评估。
AI.findings: 发现三个结构性断裂点：权威收敛失败、正式权威与实际封闭权威背离、治理记录沦为政治信号。提出主权虚假自信信号概念，ARA是当前最佳替代诊断变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了DARF框架向主权治理移植的条件性而非普遍性；识别了主权虚假自信信号这一新现象；提出了ARA作为碎片化主权治理环境的新诊断变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主权经济治理实践提供了更准确的诊断工具（ARA），帮助识别最终决议的归属权威，提升治理问责效率。

detail.abstract: Objective To review the charts of people who requested medical assistance in dying (MAID) to examine their reasons for the request. Design Retrospective chart survey. Setting British Columbia. Participants Patients who requested an assisted death and were assessed by 1 of 6 physicians in British Columbia during 2016. Main outcome measures Patients’ diagnoses and reasons for requesting MAID. Results Data were collected from 250 assessments for MAID: 112 of the patients had assisted deaths, 11 had natural deaths, 35 were assessed as not eligible for MAID, and most of the rest were not ready. For people who had assisted deaths, disease-related symptoms were given as the first or second most important reason for requesting assisted death by 67 people (59.8%), while 59 (52.7%) gave loss of autonomy, 55 (49.1%) gave loss of ability to enjoy activities, and 27 (24.1%) gave fear of future suffering. People who were assessed as eligible but who had not received assisted deaths were more likely to list fear of future suffering (33.7% vs 7.1%) and less likely to list disease-related symptoms (17.4% vs 40.2%) than those who received MAID were. There was a difference in reasons for MAID given by people with different diagnoses; disease-related symptoms were given as the most important reason by 39.0% of patients with malignancies, 6.8% of patients with neurological diseases, and 28.9% of patients with end-organ failure. Loss of autonomy was given as the most important reason by 16.0% of patients with malignancies, 36.4% of patients with neurological diseases, and 23.7% of patients with end-organ failure. Conclusion This study shows that the reasons patients give for requesting an assisted death are similar to those reported in other jurisdictions with similar laws, but in different proportions. Loss of autonomy and loss of ability to enjoy activities were less common reasons among patients in this study compared with other jurisdictions. This might be related to the method of data collection, as in this study, the patients’ reasons were recorded by physicians.

AI.tldr: 本研究回顾了2016年加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省250例医疗协助死亡（MAID）请求者的病历，发现患者请求MAID的首要原因包括疾病相关症状（59.8%）、失去自主权（52.7%）、失去享受活动能力（49.1%）和对未来痛苦的恐惧（24.1%），且不同诊断患者的理由存在差异。
AI.research_question: 请求医疗协助死亡（MAID）的患者有哪些原因？不同诊断的患者在请求理由上是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 了解患者请求医疗协助死亡的真实原因，为相关法律和临床实践提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无明确理论框架，属于描述性实证研究。
AI.method: 回顾性病历调查，收集2016年加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省6名医生评估的250例MAID请求数据，分析患者诊断及请求原因。
AI.findings: （1）实际接受MAID的患者中，59.8%将疾病相关症状列为首要或次要原因，52.7%为失去自主权，49.1%为失去享受活动能力，24.1%为对未来痛苦的恐惧。（2）符合条件但未接受MAID者更可能列出对未来痛苦的恐惧（33.7% vs 7.1%），较少列出疾病相关症状（17.4% vs 40.2%）。（3）不同诊断患者原因不同：恶性肿瘤患者39.0%以疾病症状为首要原因，神经系统疾病患者36.4%以失去自主权为首要原因，终末器官衰竭患者28.9%以疾病症状为首要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了MAID请求原因与类似司法管辖区一致，但比例不同；发现数据收集方法（医生记录）可能影响报告的原因分布。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MAID评估的临床实践提供参考，提示医生应关注不同疾病患者的核心诉求（如神经系统疾病患者更关注自主权丧失），并为政策制定提供实证数据支持。

title: Mental Health in Sentencing Beyond Mitigation
affiliations: York University - Osgoode Hall Law School

detail.title: Mental Health in Sentencing Beyond Mitigation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Osgoode Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Osgoode Hall Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In recent years, the jurisprudence of the Supreme Court has opened an important window to look more seriously at the truth that one must wrestle with the individualized experience of punishment if one hopes to calibrate the severity, and hence proportionality, of a sentence. This is an incipient theme in Canadian sentencing jurisprudence, novel from a comparative perspective, and with the potential to disturb much about how we sentence—perhaps more than the Court foresaw when it embraced this idea. In this article, I peer through this window, examining what it means for the relevance of mental health in sentencing. The article reviews the rise and nature of “individualized proportionality” in Canadian sentencing and explores what we know about the experience of incarceration for those suffering from mental health conditions. I ultimately argue that, both as a normative matter and as a natural consequence of contemporary Canadian sentencing doctrine, the mental health of an offender should be relevant to sentencing whether or not it has any nexus whatsoever with the underlying offence. Having made this argument, I turn to reflect more broadly on what it might mean for our understanding and practices of sentencing if we were to stop “getting rid” of the fact that mental illness is endemic, not exceptional, in our system.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨加拿大量刑法中“个别化比例原则”的兴起，主张无论心理健康问题是否与犯罪有关，都应作为量刑考量因素，并反思心理疾病在刑事司法系统中普遍存在的现实意义。
AI.research_question: 在加拿大量刑法中，心理健康状况应如何在“个别化比例原则”下被纳入考量？
AI.motivation: 加拿大最高法院近年开辟了关注个体化惩罚体验的量刑新路径，这一理念具有比较法上的新颖性并可能深刻改变量刑实践，作者由此切入探讨心理健康在量刑中的相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个别化比例原则（individualized proportionality）；惩罚体验与量刑严厉性的校准理论；量刑比例性原则。
AI.method: doctrinal legal analysis（法律教义分析），包括加拿大量刑判例法梳理、比较法视角分析、规范论证。
AI.findings: 作为规范事项和当代加拿大量刑教义的自然结果，无论心理健康问题是否与犯罪有因果关系，都应影响量刑；应正视心理疾病在刑事司法系统中并非例外而是普遍现象这一事实。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了个别化比例原则的理论内涵，将其从犯罪行为的客观严重性延伸到对犯罪人主观惩罚体验的考量；挑战了传统上要求心理健康与犯罪存在关联度的主流观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官在量刑中更广泛地考虑心理健康因素提供法律论证依据；推动刑事司法系统正视心理疾病的普遍性，可能改变量刑实践和矫正政策。
