The Kaypro workflow becomes a benchmark—a human-cognition standard against which the modern human–machine relation can be measured and, where appropriate, found wanting. The standard it names is not that the machine must never supply wording, but that the human must remain the warrant of the result, whether by authoring it or by auditing it. As the disciplined heir to the Kaypro I set the bounded instrument—a small, source-bound language model the scholar runs locally over a curated corpus, here the Maestro–Stradivarius Language Model (MSLM). Opaque in mechanism but bounded in provenance, it admits machine-supplied wording only on terms the human can audit, and so carries the Kaypro’s standard into 2026 by discipline rather than by incapacity. Appendix A sets out, verified against primary sources and cited, a practical path by which a reader may build one. Appendix B then carries that instrument into use, walking one revision cycle in which machine-supplied surplus is audited against an admitted corpus and only what traces to it is kept. That instrument, however, is reached for only at need. Appendix C measures the choice by the scale of the corpus: where the sources can be read in full, an unaided scholar—online search to find, hand and judgment to digest, citation to bind—keeps the standard whole with no language model at all, and is the default; the bounded instrument is warranted only where the corpus outgrows what one reader can hold, and the opaque frontier model at no scale. Appendix C sets out that scale schema and a step-by-step build for the case that warrants it. That landscape is itself the endpoint of a documented drift: Appendix D samples a single national computing-magazine spine from 1980 to 2015 and traces, issue by issue, the migration of warrant off the scholar’s desk—and with it a measurable slide along the theoria–techne gradient, from technique that serves the scholar’s thinking toward technique that performs it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比1980年代Kaypro便携电脑与2026年预测模型两种写作场景，论证人机关系的核心差异不在于效率或技能，而在于形式因果的归属及人类能否对输出结果进行担保（warrant）。作者提出以Kaypro作为"透明传递工具"的基准，主张人类必须成为结果的担保者，并提出有界工具（如MSLM）作为在2026年延续这一标准的中庸方案。
AI.research_question: 在从早期个人电脑到当代预测模型的工具演变中，人机写作关系的本质变化是什么？人类是否还能对自己工具的输出结果提供认知担保？
AI.motivation: 当代大型语言模型产生了大量"语义剩余"（semantic surplus），即机器自主生成的、人类无法直接担保的内容，这可能导致未经证实的知识进入学术记录。早期个人电脑则不具备这种剩余。作者试图通过历史对比，为当代人机协作确立一个认知担保的标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 形式因果（formal causation）、认知担保（warrant）、语义剩余（semantic surplus）、验证溢价（verification premium）、theoria–techne梯度（理论-技艺梯度）
AI.method: 历史对比分析；基于作者自身使用Kaypro写作的经历、史密森尼博物馆的文献记录、同时代作家对Kaypro的描述；提出并构建一个实践方案（Maestro–Stradivarius Language Model, MSLM）
AI.findings: Kaypro是"零语义剩余"工具的极限案例，人类是所有内容的作者；预测模型则通过设计产生语义剩余，并施加"验证溢价"——若不支付这一溢价，未担保的内容就会作为既定知识进入记录；有界工具（如MSLM）可在保持机器辅助功能的同时，通过限定语料来源使人类仍可审计其输出；当语料库规模允许时，无模型辅助的学者才是默认方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"语义剩余"和"验证溢价"两个概念，用以刻画预测模型与早期透明工具的本质差异；重新定义人机关系中的核心问题不是效率或去技能化，而是认知担保的归属；提出"人类作为结果担保者"（human as warrant of the result）作为评价人机系统是否合格的标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 附录A提供了构建有界语言模型（MSLM）的实操指南，经过原始资料验证并附有引用；附录B演示了使用该工具进行审计的修订周期；附录C给出了判断何时应该使用无模型辅助、有界工具还是黑箱前沿模型的规模标准；附录D通过1980-2015年间计算杂志的文本分析，追踪了认知担保从学者桌面外移的历史轨迹。

title: Bayesian World Models
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Bayesian World Models
detail.abstract: A world model learns a compressed, predictive representation of an environment and lets an agent plan by "dreaming"-rolling the model forward in latent space rather than in the costly real world (Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018). We argue that such a model, if it is to be rolled forward and optimized against, must be Bayesian. A world model is a family of one-step predictive kernels, and the only family that composes coherently into a joint law over trajectories is a σadditive posterior predictive, which under exchangeability is Bayesian updating on an unknown mechanism (de Finetti). Three consequences follow. First, large language models already are Bayesian world models: next-token prediction is an amortized Dirichlet-multinomial posterior predictive whose noninformative limit is a Bayesian bootstrap over corpus continuations, with temperature as tempering and in-context learning as posterior updating (Dalal and Misra, 2024; Rubin, 1981; Newton et al., 2021). Second, conformal prediction gives finite-sample marginal coverage for a single step but cannot serve as the belief state: by the separations of Datta et al. (2025), per-step coverage does not compose across a rollout, and a controller planning in a rankreduced dream is provably deficient. Third, "cheating the world model" (Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018) is off-support misspecification, curable only by epistemic uncertainty that widens where data are scarce-exactly the mechanism that safe model-based agents such as LAMBDA (As et al., 2022) use, and which lets us prove that a multi-step safety constraint is a path-space functional requiring the coherent kernel. The design principle is one line: carry a σ-additive predictive kernel as the state; attach conformal wrappers only as terminal guardrails.

AI.tldr: 本文论证世界模型必须是贝叶斯的：只有σ-加性后验预测核能在轨迹上连贯组合。LLM已是贝叶斯世界模型（下一词预测=狄利克雷-多项后验预测），共形预测无法提供多步覆盖保证，"欺骗世界模型"本质是域外误配，需用认知不确定性修正。设计原则：将σ-加性预测核作为状态，共形包装仅作终端护栏。
AI.research_question: 世界模型应具备什么数学性质才能在多步规划中保持概率一致性？
AI.motivation: 世界模型在规划中需要被"滚动前推"并优化，但现有方法（如共形预测）的单步保证无法在多步推演中组合，导致规划缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯更新（de Finetti可交换性）、σ-加性后验预测核、狄利克雷-多项后验预测（LLM）、共形预测理论（Datta et al. 2025分离性结果）、认知不确定性/域外误配修正。
AI.method: 理论论证：从概率组合公理出发，证明只有贝叶斯后验预测核能在轨迹空间上保持σ-加性；结合LLM的下一词预测等价于狄利克雷-多项后验预测；分析共形预测的多步限制；用认知不确定性解决"欺骗世界模型"问题。
AI.findings: (1) LLM本质上是贝叶斯世界模型（下一词预测=摊销的狄利克雷-多项后验预测）；(2) 共形预测不能作为信念状态，单步覆盖无法组合成多步覆盖；(3) "欺骗世界模型"是域外误配，需认知不确定性（如LAMBDA）修正；(4) 设计原则：σ-加性预测核作为状态，共形包装仅作终端护栏。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次从概率组合公理（σ-加性）严格论证世界模型必须是贝叶斯的；(2) 建立LLM与贝叶斯世界模型的形式等价性（下一词预测=摊销的狄利克雷-多项后验预测）；(3) 证明共形预测在多步规划中的根本不足；(4) 将"欺骗世界模型"重新定义为域外误配问题。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为构建安全、可规划的世界模型提供明确的设计原则；(2) 说明LAMBDA等安全强化学习方法的理论合理性；(3) 指导实践：用贝叶斯预测核作为状态，共形方法仅作为终端安全护栏。

title:
What is Truth?

Sam and Nel’s Round Trip: A Bit’s Journey from a Brooklyn Café to a Hyperscale Datacenter and Back, and the Errors It Cannot See

detail.title:
What is Truth?

Sam and Nel’s Round Trip: A Bit’s Journey from a Brooklyn Café to a Hyperscale Datacenter and Back, and the Errors It Cannot See

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This essay traces two bits of a three-word query — “What is Truth?” — from a Brooklyn café to a hyperscale datacenter and back, keeping a single error ledger across the round trip. The journey divides into transport and computation. In transport — Wi-Fi, glass fiber, the long-haul backbone — every fault the bits can suffer is one the system is built to detect and repair, and the ledger runs green. Inside the datacenter the character of error inverts: runtime arithmetic admits silent corruption no error-correcting code guards; the training corpus admits faithfully-wrong “knowledge” no validation at scale can certify; and fluent prediction admits confabulation, the confident falsehood produced even when hardware and corpus are sound. The essay’s thesis is a distinction between two activities a computing system performs — transporting symbols, which modern infrastructure guards with magnificent fidelity, and certifying that they are true, for which a bare predictive model stands in no position, a limit tool-augmented systems relocate rather than remove. Two instruments make this measurable: the running ledger and the Epistemic Richter Scale, on which each escaping error is rated by order of magnitude. Read through them, one figure recurs at every scale — transport guarded, certification withheld — a self-similarity the essay calls Mandelbrotian. Two appendices test the thesis from opposite directions: Appendix A turns a panel of six frontier systems outward onto a single loaded question and finds them enacting the prediction rather than being merely described by it; Appendix B turns five systems inward to rebuild the essay’s own instruments blind, and finds them reproducing the argument’s shape while missing its hidden rule and over-certifying the result. The essay closes at the café counter, where a human’s grounded inexactitude proves truer than the machine’s bit-perfect groundlessness, and argues that truth is earned by labor and a shared world, not delivered stamped and certified. What the single journey exposes is general: every large language model inherits its world model from a corpus that is epistemically unsound and largely unverifiable — only a small fraction of it ever validated by knowledgeable and otherwise qualified human validation teams — so a flawed world model is the structural inheritance of them all, not the defect of any one system.

AI.tldr: 本文追踪"什么是真理？"这个查询从咖啡馆到超大规模数据中心的往返旅程，通过一个错误账本记录全程。运输阶段所有错误均可检测修复，但数据中心内部出现三种不可修复的错误：算术静默错误、训练语料中的忠实错误、以及模型的虚构。论文区分了"传输符号"（现代基础设施已完美保护）与"认证真理"（预测模型无法做到）两种活动，提出"曼德博罗自相似性"——在所有尺度上都存在"运输被守护，认证被缺失"的重复模式。附录用六个前沿系统验证了这一论断。
AI.research_question: 在大语言模型的信息处理过程中，从物理传输到语义生成的各个尺度上，错误的本质、来源和可修复性有何不同？"传输符号"与"认证真理"之间的根本区别是什么？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型会生成看似可信但实际错误的输出，这种"虚构"现象的根本原因何在？现有研究多关注特定模型的缺陷，但本文试图揭示这是所有大语言模型的"结构性遗传"——即语料库本身在认识论上就是不可靠的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 错误分层理论：物理运输层（可检测可修复）vs. 计算层（不可修复的三种错误）；2. 曼德博罗自相似性：在不同尺度上重复出现的"运输被守护，认证被缺失"模式；3. 认识论区分：传输符号（fidelity）与认证真理（truth）的本质区别；4. 认识论里氏震级：量化不同错误量级的评估工具。
AI.method: 1. 概念追踪法：跟随一个查询从物理世界到数字世界的完整路径；2. 错误账本法：沿路记录每个环节出现的错误类型及其可修复性；3. 实证验证：附录A用六个前沿系统回答同一个问题，观察它们是否表现出"预测而非认证"的行为；附录B让五个系统盲重建论文的分析工具，检验它们是否过度认证结果。
AI.findings: 1. 运输层的所有错误都可被系统检测并修复（错误账本保持绿色）；2. 数据中心内存在三种不可修复的错误：运行时算术的静默错误、训练语料中"忠实但错误"的知识、以及流畅预测产生的虚构（confabulation）；3. 所有大语言模型都继承了一个认识论上不可靠的世界模型——只有极小部分训练语料经过合格人类验证团队的验证；4. 前沿系统在实践中确实表现出"预测"而非"认证"的行为；5. 人类基于经验和共享世界的"接地气的不精确"比机器"比特完美的无根基"更真实。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"运输与认证"的二元区分框架，澄清了信息处理中两个常被混淆的活动；2. 引入"曼德博罗自相似性"概念，揭示了错误模式在不同尺度上的结构性重复；3. 论证了大语言模型的虚构问题不是个别系统的缺陷，而是所有基于不可靠语料训练的模型都拥有的"结构性遗传"；4. 提出了"认识论里氏震级"作为评估错误规模的工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为大语言模型的使用者和开发者提供了一个诊断框架，区分哪些错误是基础设施问题（可修复）哪些是结构性问题（需重新思考根本设计）；2. 警示工具增强系统（如RAG）只是将认证问题的位置转移而非真正解决；3. 提醒在关键应用中不应过度依赖大语言模型输出的"真实性"；4. 强调了人类验证在AI系统中的不可替代性。

title: The Platform-Property Paradox
affiliations: University of Houston Law Center

detail.title: The Platform-Property Paradox
detail.abstract:
In digital markets, the essential functions of property turn against each other. Common law property divides the world into mine, yours, and others’ by excluding non-owners. This exclusion strategy generally serves three essential functions in economic ordering: internalizing externalities by channeling positive and negative effects on third parties back to the owner; creating modularity by dividing the world into manageable chunks; and promoting liberty by enabling private control over resources. These functions usually work in harmony. As this Article shows, not so in the digital platform economy.

Digital networks create enormous value by facilitating communication, transactions, and knowledge production—value that grows exponentially as more people participate. Through property-like entitlements, law enables platforms like Amazon, Google, and Facebook to exclude others from these networks and thereby capture that exponential value. This legal architecture encloses digital networks just as law once enclosed common meadows. The resulting control over digital networks disproportionately benefits incumbents. Paradoxically, this Article argues, property's internalization function captures value so effectively that it fuels industrial concentration. Rather than creating modularity, this concentration amplifies systemic complexity and interdependence; instead of promoting liberty, it entrenches economic dependence, centralizes control, and breeds oligarchy.

This Article reveals property design as a central and underappreciated driver of platform dominance, one amenable to legal correction. While scholarly and policy responses to economic concentration have largely emphasized antitrust enforcement and sector-specific regulation, this Article foregrounds the upstream design of property entitlements. The Article challenges the classical prescription that property should maximize internalization of externalities. When platforms internalize network effects under that logic, the result is industrial concentration with deep structural harms to modularity and liberty. Reconciling property’s essential functions thus requires curtailing property-like entitlements, expanding the digital commons, and recalibrating the remaining protections.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示数字平台经济中，财产权的三大核心功能（内部化外部性、创造模块化、促进自由）相互冲突。法律赋予平台类财产权以排除他人，使其捕获网络效应的指数级价值，但这导致了产业集中、系统复杂化、经济依赖和寡头统治。本文主张削减类财产权、扩大数字公域，以调和财产权的内在矛盾。
AI.research_question: 财产权设计如何成为数字平台主导地位的核心驱动因素？财产权的三大功能（内部化、模块化、自由）在数字平台经济中为何相互冲突？
AI.motivation: 现有针对经济集中的学术与政策回应主要强调反垄断执法和行业监管，但忽视了财产权这一上游设计因素。本文旨在揭示财产权设计是平台主导地位的关键但被低估的驱动力，并指出其可通过法律修正来调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 普通法财产权理论（排除非所有者实现内部化外部性、创造模块化、促进自由三大功能）；数字网络效应理论（价值随参与人数指数增长）；公地/反公地理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（Normative legal analysis），结合财产法理论、网络经济学和平台治理文献进行理论论证。
AI.findings: (1) 数字平台通过类财产权排除他人，成功内部化了网络效应的指数级价值，但这反而加剧了产业集中；(2) 集中并未创造模块化，反而放大了系统复杂性和相互依赖；(3) 集中未促进自由，反而巩固了经济依赖、集中控制和寡头统治；(4) 财产权的内部化功能在数字市场中与模块化和自由功能产生结构性冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"财产应最大化外部性内部化"的经典主张；揭示了财产权三大功能在数字市场中的内在矛盾；将财产权设计纳入平台经济集中问题的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了超越反垄断和行业监管的新路径：通过削减类财产权、扩大数字公域、重新校准剩余保护来纠正平台集中问题。

The Applewood Estates Evidence-generating Operational Research Constitution 
Governing Principles for an Evidence-generating Operational Research Program

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author served as a compensated technology and organizational modernization consultant for Applewood Estates during the operational activities described in this paper. This relationship is disclosed in the interest of transparency. The conceptual framework, analysis, interpretations, and conclusions presented are the independent scholarly work of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a conceptual and methodological framework and does not report research involving human participants, identifiable personal data, or regulated human-subjects research. Institutional ethics approval was therefore not required. Future empirical studies under the Applewood Estates Evidence-Generating Operational Research Program will obtain all required institutional approvals before collecting human-participant data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external grant funding. The operational modernization activities described were conducted as part of a professional consulting engagement through EWTECHNERD LLC. No sponsor influenced the conceptual development, analysis, interpretation, or preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: Small organizations frequently undertake modernization initiatives involving technology, facilities, financial systems, governance, and workforce development. While these initiatives often improve operational performance, they rarely produce systematic organizational evidence that can support executive decision-making, institutional learning, or scholarly research. This paper introduces the Applewood Estates Evidence-Generating Operational Research Program (AE-EGORP), a constitutional framework that integrates operational modernization with continuous evidence generation. Rather than treating consulting and research as separate activities, the framework embeds documentation, evidence validation, organizational learning, and publication directly into implementation activities. The paper presents six original conceptual contributions: the Evidence-Generating Operational Research Framework (EGORP), Evidence Architecture, the Operational Evidence Lifecycle (OEL), the Evidence Maturity Model (EMM), the Applewood Operational Modernization Index (AOMI), and a Dual Workstream Architecture integrating IT and Facilities Modernization with Financial Evidence Architecture. Together these constructs establish a governance model through which modernization activities simultaneously improve organizational performance and generate transferable organizational knowledge. Although developed within a small property management organization, the framework is designed for adaptation across nonprofit, governmental, educational, healthcare, faith-based, and commercial organizations. This constitutional working paper serves as the methodological foundation for a broader research program that will empirically evaluate and refine the proposed constructs through future implementation studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AE-EGORP框架，旨在将小微企业现代化改造与持续性证据生成相结合，建立一种既能提升组织绩效又能产生可迁移组织知识的治理模式。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种制度框架，使小型组织的现代化改造活动在执行过程中能够同时系统性地生成可用于决策、学习和研究的组织证据？
AI.motivation: 小型组织开展现代化改造时虽能改善运营绩效，但很少能系统性地产生可供决策、学习和学术研究使用的组织证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证据生成运营研究框架(EGORP)、证据架构、运营证据生命周期(OEL)、证据成熟度模型(EMM)、Applewood运营现代化指数(AOMI)、双工作流架构。
AI.method: 概念性/理论建构方法，提出六项原创概念贡献，属于制度框架设计论文。
AI.findings: 提出了六个原创概念框架，构建了一种将现代化改造与证据生成融合的治理模式，适用于多种类型组织。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了六个相互关联的概念框架（EGORP、证据架构、OEL、EMM、AOMI、双工作流架构），为组织现代化中的证据生成建立了系统的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小型组织提供了一套可操作的制度框架，使其在现代化改造过程中能够系统性地积累证据，支持决策、组织学习和知识迁移，并适用于非营利、政府、教育、医疗、宗教和商业等多种组织场景。

title: Contextual Trust in AI-driven Financial Services: A Systematic Review of How user Type, Decision Risk, and Individual Characteristics Shape Trust in Algorithmic Decision-making

detail.title: Contextual Trust in AI-driven Financial Services: A Systematic Review of How user Type, Decision Risk, and Individual Characteristics Shape Trust in Algorithmic Decision-making
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence now mediates consequential decisions across financial services, yet adoption has outpaced the value institutions realise, and user trust is widely identified as the binding constraint. This systematic review reconceptualises trust in AI-driven financial services as a contextual, calibration-worthy state rather than a stable, monolithic trait. It maps how trust is formed, calibrated, and broken across two user populations, customers and employees, operating at three decision-risk levels. Following PRISMA 2020 and a preregistered OSF protocol, it synthesises 60 peer-reviewed empirical studies published between 2018 and 2026. Each study is coded along the Ability-Benevolence-Integrity (ABI) dimensions of the Mayer, Davis and Schoorman trust model, adapted for human-AI interaction, by user type and decision-risk level, and by dominant failure mode. Three findings stand out. First, an "empty cell": no study examines trust in employee-facing AI used in routine, lowstakes back-office workflows, precisely where automated decision-making is densest. Second, a stark asymmetry: algorithm aversion is documented in 28 studies but automation bias in only one. Third, a synthesised gradient in which the salience of the three ABI dimensions shifts with decision risk, with ability dominating at low stakes and procedural integrity and benevolence becoming jointly necessary at high stakes. From this evidence the review develops the Contextual Trust Calibration Framework (CTCF), a five-layer model that reorients the field from maximising trust to calibrating it, and derives six testable propositions, including a falsifiable prediction about the empty cell.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了AI金融服务中的信任问题，提出信任应被视为可校准的情境状态，而非稳定特质。通过对60项实证研究的分析，发现了三个关键发现，并提出了情境信任校准框架（CTCF）。
AI.research_question: 在AI驱动的金融服务中，信任如何在不同用户群体（客户与员工）和不同决策风险水平下形成、校准和被打破？
AI.motivation: AI在金融服务中的应用已经超越了机构实际实现的价值，用户信任被认为是主要的制约因素，但现有研究对信任的理解仍不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mayer, Davis和Schoorman的信任模型（能力-善意-正直ABI维度），改编应用于人机互动场景；情境信任校准框架（CTCF）。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA 2020指南和OSF预注册协议，对2018-2026年间60篇同行评审实证研究进行系统性文献回顾与编码分析。
AI.findings: 三个主要发现：（1）存在"空白单元格"——没有研究关注员工在低风险日常后台工作中使用AI的信任问题；（2）明显不对称——28项研究记录了算法厌恶，仅1项研究记录了自动化偏差；（3）ABI三个维度的显著性随决策风险变化：低风险时能力主导，高风险时程序诚信和善意变得同等必要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了情境信任校准框架（CTCF），将研究焦点从"最大化信任"转向"校准信任"，并推导出六个可检验的研究命题，包括关于空白单元格的可证伪预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了指导：不应一味追求用户信任的最大化，而应根据不同用户类型和决策风险水平来校准信任水平，特别关注被忽视的员工端低风险场景。

title: When AI Talks Back: Behavioral Consequences of AI-Generated Social Interaction on Platforms
affiliations: Tsinghua University and

detail.title: When AI Talks Back: Behavioral Consequences of AI-Generated Social Interaction on Platforms
detail.abstract: Social media platforms have begun deploying generative-AI social bots that comment on ordinary users' posts, uninvited, in the same public streams where humans interact. We argue that such bots create hollow ties: interactions that supply the social presence of being responded to while carrying none of the relationship investment a human comment signals. Using a 34-month panel of 20,134 Weibo users and 22.1 million comments around the platform's deployment of its Comment Robot, we combine propensity-score matching with a doubly robust staggered difference-indifferences design to trace what routine bot exposure does to users' participation and to their human ties. AI comments activate participation where human attention is scarce: low-popularity users post 16% more and receive 41% more human comments. The activation, however, is relationally hollow: the extra reply effort that costly human comments normally command flattens, high-popularity users withdraw in an ordered cascade that begins with their own replying, and human ties formed deeper into exposure are progressively less likely to persist (-5.8 to-12.8 percentage points). Aggregated with equal weight, the bot looks beneficial; weighted by where audience-bearing content is produced, platform-level human interaction turns negative in the long run. The spillover weakens when AI comments are distinguishable from human ones, and it runs through the bot's informational rather than emotional content. Engagement volume is thus an incomplete metric for governing social bots; preserving the legibility of human attention is the operative design lever.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了社交媒体平台部署生成式AI社交机器人对普通用户参与行为及人际关系的真实影响，发现机器人会创造"空洞联结"——虽能激活低人气用户的参与，但会侵蚀人际关系的持久性，长期看会损害平台整体的人类互动质量。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台上部署的生成式AI社交机器人（未经邀请即评论普通用户帖子）如何影响用户的参与行为以及他们与人类之间的人际关系纽带？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI社交机器人被大规模部署到社交平台，它们看似增加了互动量，但这种互动本质上是"空洞"的——提供了被回应的社会临场感，却不承载人类评论所隐含的关系投入。现有研究缺乏对这一现象的因果识别和长期影响分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: "空洞联结"（Hollow Ties）概念：AI评论提供了社会回应，但缺乏真实的关系投资。结合社会临场理论、人际关系投资理论、信号理论等，区分AI互动与人类互动的本质差异。
AI.method: 使用微博平台部署"评论机器人"这一准自然实验，构建34个月的面板数据（20,134名用户，2,210万条评论），采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）结合双重稳健的 staggered 双重差分法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）AI评论激活了低人气用户的参与（发帖增加16%，收到人类评论增加41%）；但这种激活是"关系性空洞"的——人类评论本应带来的额外回复努力被削弱；（2）高人气用户出现有序撤退，首先减少自身回复行为；（3）暴露于AI越久，形成的人类纽带越不持久（持久性下降5.8-12.8个百分点）；（4）等权重聚合下AI看起来有益，但按内容产出加权后，平台整体人类互动长期为负；（5）当AI评论可被人类区分时，负向溢出效应减弱；（6）负面效应主要通过信息的而非情感的内容机制传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"空洞联结"概念，区分了AI互动和人类互动的本质差异，丰富了社交机器人研究和社会临场理论；揭示了"参与量"作为治理指标的局限性，指出"人类注意力的可识读性"才是关键设计杠杆。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台治理AI社交机器人提供了关键启示：不能仅以参与量为标准评估AI的正面效应；应保留人类互动的可辨别性，保护用户对"被真实人类关注"这一信号的信赖，从而维护平台健康互动生态。

title: Life-Cycle Effects of Taxation and Social Safety Net Pensions on Labor Supply, Savings, and Human Capital
affiliations: University of Chittagong

detail.title: Life-Cycle Effects of Taxation and Social Safety Net Pensions on Labor Supply, Savings, and Human Capital
detail.abstract: This paper structurally estimates a dynamic life-cycle model of consumption, savings, labor supply, human capital accumulation, and retirement using data from the Bangladesh Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES 2016-2022) and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics Labour Force Survey. We evaluate the effects of the personal income tax schedule and the Old-Age Allowance (OAA), Widow Allowance, and voluntary contributory pension programmes on household behaviour over the life cycle. The model incorporates learning-by-doing human capital, uninsurable wage risk, credit constraints, discrete hours choices, and non-absorbing retirement. Counterfactual simulations show that the current means-tested OAA is poorly targeted: expanding coverage and eliminating the implicit 100% tax at the eligibility threshold yields a consumption-equivalent welfare gain of 3.1% while raising female labour supply by 6.4%. A revenueneutral shift to a universal social pension dominates the status quo on both efficiency and distributional grounds. Results are robust to alternative assumptions on the Frisch elasticity and the intertemporal elasticity of substitution.

AI.tldr: 本文使用孟加拉国家庭调查数据，构建了一个包含消费、储蓄、劳动供给、人力资本积累和退休的动态生命周期模型，评估了个人所得税、老年津贴、寡妇津贴和自愿缴费型养老金计划对家庭行为的长期影响。反事实模拟表明，现行家计调查型老年津贴瞄准效果差，扩大覆盖范围并取消资格门槛处的隐性100%税率可带来3.1%的消费等价福利提升，同时使女性劳动供给增加6.4%。向全民社会养老金的收入中性转换在效率和分配两方面均优于现状。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国现行的个人所得税、老年津贴、寡妇津贴及自愿缴费型养老金计划如何影响家庭在消费、储蓄、劳动供给、人力资本积累和退休等生命周期行为？替代性政策设计能否改善福利与效率？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家（尤其是南亚地区）的社会保障体系扩展迅速，但关于家计调查型转移支付对生命周期行为影响的定量证据匮乏。孟加拉国老年津贴存在"100%隐性边际税率"的问题，其福利与效率成本尚未被系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态生命周期模型，包含干中学人力资本积累、不可保险的工资风险、信贷约束、离散劳动时间选择以及非吸收性退休（退休后可重返劳动市场）。
AI.method: 结构估计方法，使用孟加拉国家庭收入和支出调查（HIES 2016-2022）及劳动调查数据，通过模拟矩估计（SMM）拟合模型参数，并进行反事实政策模拟。
AI.findings: (1) 现行家计调查型老年津贴瞄准效果差，资格门槛处存在隐性100%税率，扭曲劳动供给决策；(2) 扩大覆盖范围并消除门槛税率，可实现3.1%的消费等价福利提升，女性劳动供给增加6.4%；(3) 收入中性的全民社会养老金在效率和分配上均优于现状；(4) 结果对Frisch弹性和跨期替代弹性的不同假设保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次在发展中国家生命周期模型中同时纳入干中学人力资本、信贷约束和非吸收性退休机制；(2) 量化揭示了家计调查型转移支付中隐性边际税率对生命周期行为的扭曲效应；(3) 为全民社会养老金制度在低收入国家的福利改进提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为孟加拉国及其他发展中国家改革家计调查型社会保障制度提供了定量政策依据；(2) 指出消除资格门槛处的隐性税率可同时提升福利和女性劳动参与；(3) 证明了收入中性的全民社会养老金是帕累托改进的可行方向。

title: Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks
affiliations: , Celona Inc., Chongqing University and NIT, Warangal

detail.title: Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks
detail.abstract: Private wireless networks are increasingly becoming operational infrastructure for factories, ports, airports, logistics campuses, hospitals, mines, and energy facilities. In these environments, connectivity decisions affect production continuity, safety, quality control, logistics flow, operating cost, and return on investment. However, most autonomous network-control frameworks still optimize technical key performance indicators such as latency, throughput, reliability, coverage, and spectral efficiency, rather than the enterprise value created by those improvements. This paper introduces Economic-Aware Agentic Private Networks, a framework in which bounded autonomous or semi-autonomous agents reason over technical state, spectrum state, application criticality, business-economic state, governance rules, and historical evidence to select or recommend private-network actions. The proposed framework treats spectrum, edge compute, slice capacity, energy, redundancy, and operational attention as economic assets. It combines business-intent interpretation, service-level specifications, digital-twin validation, supervisorspecialist agent orchestration, economic scoring, and governance-constrained actuation. The paper formalizes economic-aware private-network control as a constrained enterprise-utility maximization problem and presents a reference architecture, data model, closed-loop workflow, illustrative enterprise use cases, scenario-based numerical validation, and a sensitivity analysis across workload, criticality, cost, energy, and SLS-penalty assumptions. The numerical results compare economic-aware control with KPI-only, static-priority, and cost-minimizing baselines and show that economic-aware control provides the strongest utility-cost tradeoff while preserving critical SLSs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了经济感知的智能专网（EAPN）框架，将频谱、边缘计算、切片容量、能源、冗余和运营注意力视为经济资产，通过有界自主或半自主智能体进行业务-技术联合决策，以最大化企业效用而非仅优化传统KPI。
AI.research_question: 如何在专网控制中引入经济意识，使网络决策优化企业价值而非仅关注技术KPI？
AI.motivation: 现有自主网络控制框架主要优化延迟、吞吐量、可靠性等技术指标，而非这些改进所创造的企业商业价值，导致网络决策与业务目标脱节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济资产理论、智能体与专家系统架构、约束优化理论（将专网控制形式化为约束下的企业效用最大化问题）。
AI.method: 提出EAPN参考架构（含业务意图解析、数字孪生验证、监督者-专家智能体编排、经济评分、治理约束执行），通过情景化数值验证和敏感性分析（对比KPI-only、静态优先级、成本最小化基线）。
AI.findings: 经济感知控制相比KPI-only、静态优先级和成本最小化方法，在保持关键服务等级规范（SLS）的前提下提供了最强的效用-成本权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了经济感知专网控制为约束企业效用最大化问题；提出了将网络资源视为经济资产的系统性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工厂、港口、矿山等关键基础设施场景提供了可操作的网络自治决策框架，帮助企业在连续性、安全、质量、成本和投资回报间实现平衡。

title: Cooperation is Not a Safety Property: A Position on Adversarial-Resistant Agent Identity

detail.title: Cooperation is Not a Safety Property: A Position on Adversarial-Resistant Agent Identity
detail.abstract: Recent technical-governance proposals for AIagent identity-provider-side schemes, signed agent cards, decentralized-identifier registries, multi-stakeholder frameworks-defend an honest issuer against external forgery, spoofing, and theft. They share an architectural assumption: identity is issued or attested by an entity willing to cooperate. We invert the threat model. The party that issues identity is often the party a safety case must hold accountable, so cooperation is itself the vulnerability, and it fails in four structural cases: open-source models with no provider, partial-cooperation labs with variable transparency, adversarial providers with incentives to evade attribution, and jurisdictional asymmetries beyond regulator reach. The governance regimes that depend on identity-attribution, liability, audit, deterrence-fail when they are most needed. We propose adversarial-resistance as a design requirement, derive four conditions it entails, and argue that the structurally non-cooperative cases are where agent-identity safety research is most needed.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了当前AI Agent身份治理方案中"身份由合作方签发"的核心假设，指出在开源模型、透明度有限的实验室、对抗性提供商及 jurisdictional 不对称等四种不合作场景下，这一假设会失效。作者提出应将"对抗性抵抗"作为设计要求，并推导出四个必要条件。
AI.research_question: 当前AI Agent身份治理方案在面临不合作的身份签发方时，存在哪些结构性失效场景？如何设计具有对抗性抵抗能力的身份安全方案？
AI.motivation: 现有技术治理方案（如签名代理卡、去中心化标识符注册表等）都假设身份签发方是诚实的合作方，但实践中，需要被问责的往往正是身份签发方本身，这一威胁模型倒置导致现有方案在最需要时失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威胁模型倒置（Inverted Threat Model）、对抗性抵抗（Adversarial Resistance）、结构性不合作（Structural Non-cooperation）
AI.method: 概念分析与逻辑论证，通过对四种结构性不合作案例的识别与分类，推导安全设计所需的条件。
AI.findings: 识别出四种结构性不合作场景：1）开源模型无提供商；2）透明度有限的实验室；3）有逃避归因动机的对抗性提供商；4）监管无法触及的jurisdictional不对称。在这些场景中，依赖身份归因的治理机制（问责、审计、威慑）均会失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 颠覆了AI Agent身份治理的主流假设，提出"对抗性抵抗"作为新的设计范式，并明确了四个必要条件，为Agent身份安全研究开辟了新方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI安全治理实践提供警示：不应过度依赖基于合作方身份签发的治理方案，需针对四种不合作场景提前布局对抗性抵抗机制。

title:
The Body Cannot Consent 
Inferred Mental States, Consumer Spatial Computing, and the Triple Gap Between Data Protection, the AI Act, and Neurorights
affiliations: University of London

detail.title:
The Body Cannot Consent 
Inferred Mental States, Consumer Spatial Computing, and the Triple Gap Between Data Protection, the AI Act, and Neurorights
detail.abstract: Consumer spatial-computing headsets such as Apple Vision Pro depend on continuous physiological sensing-gaze, fixation, pupil dilation and fine motor behaviourfrom which systems can infer attention, arousal, intent and sensitive traits. The argument here does not depend on proving present third-party access to raw gaze data; its concern is the legal status of mental-state inference from bodily interaction signals and their proxies. Such inference, the paper argues, occupies a triple gap: data-protection law is built around consent and declared data, not involuntary signals; the EU AI Act prohibits emotion recognition only in the workplace and education, leaving consumer settings insufficiently prohibited rather than unregulated; and neurorights frameworks are anchored to neural signals these devices never record. Building on the established notions of mental data (Ienca & Malgieri) and cognitive biometrics (Magee, Ienca & Farahany), the contribution is not the concept but its legal operationalisation: a doctrinal account of the AI Act's consumer-venue gap, a comparative reading of Chile's Emotiv ruling extended from neural signal to inference, an operational test and a model clause, and a signal-agnostic per-se rule for consumer spatial computing. The analysis is conceptual and doctrinal; it relies on no human-subjects data.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了消费级空间计算头显（如Apple Vision Pro）通过生理传感信号（如注视、瞳孔扩张、精细运动）推断心理状态，而这一过程存在法律三重空白：数据保护法以同意和声明数据为基础，而非无意识信号；欧盟AI Act仅在工作场所和教育场景禁止情绪识别，消费场景存在漏洞；神经权利框架锚定于神经信号，而这类设备并不记录神经信号。作者在已有"心理数据"和"认知生物识别"概念基础上，提出了法律操作化方案：包括AI Act消费场景漏洞的教义分析、智利Emotiv判决的扩展解读、可操作测试与示范条款，以及针对消费级空间计算的一种信号无关的当然禁止规则。
AI.research_question: 消费级空间计算头显从无意识的生理行为信号推断心理状态（如注意力、唤醒、意图、敏感特质），这一过程在法律（数据保护法、AI Act、神经权利框架）中处于何种法律空白？如何将已有的"心理数据"和"认知生物识别"概念进行法律操作化，填补这些空白？
AI.motivation: 空间计算头显（如Apple Vision Pro）依赖于持续的生理传感（注视、瞳孔扩张、精细运动），系统从中推断注意力、唤醒、意图和敏感特质。作者指出，这种推断处于三重法律空白之中，而现有的学术和法律框架尚未提供充分的操作化方案来应对消费场景中的这一新兴问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建立在Ienca & Malgieri的"心理数据"（mental data）概念和Magee、Ienca & Farahany的"认知生物识别"（cognitive biometrics）概念之上。作者的核心贡献不是提出新概念，而是对这些概念进行法律操作化。
AI.method: 概念性与教义学分析（conceptual and doctrinal analysis），不依赖人类被试数据。具体包括：AI Act消费场景漏洞的教义学分析、智利Emotiv判决的比较法扩展解读、可操作测试与示范条款的构建、信号无关的当然禁止规则的设计。
AI.findings:
1. 数据保护法基于"同意"和"声明数据"，无法覆盖无意识的生理信号推断；
2. EU AI Act只禁止工作场所和教育场景中的情绪识别，消费场景存在监管缺口；
3. 神经权利框架锚定在"神经信号"上，而空间计算设备并不记录神经信号；
4. 作者提出了填补上述空白的法律操作化工具：AI Act消费场景漏洞分析、智利Emotiv判决的扩展适用、可操作测试与示范条款、信号无关的当然禁止规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 在"心理数据"和"认知生物识别"概念的基础上，将抽象概念转化为可操作的法律工具（doctrinal account），包括对AI Act漏洞的教义分析、对智利Emotiv判决的比较法扩展解读，以及提出信号无关的当然禁止规则。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接用于立法和监管实践的操作化工具：针对消费级空间计算的可操作测试与示范条款，以及一种信号无关的当然禁止规则（per-se rule），为政策制定者和立法者填补现有法律空白提供了具体路径。

title: Personalized Bayesian Causal Inference: The Probability of Individual Effect
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Personalized Bayesian Causal Inference: The Probability of Individual Effect
detail.abstract: The average treatment effect (ATE) is an accounting identity: a population average whose value depends on the reference population, not on the underlying mechanism. We argue the correct estimand for individual decisions is the probability of benefit. We give four results. (i) A positive ATE is compatible with harm to a majority of units, illustrated with the 1930 Lanarkshire milk experiment and the RECOVERY dexamethasone trial. (ii) A hierarchical Bayesian model with a horseshoe prior on sparse effect heterogeneity, fit via Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) after Neyman-orthogonal residualization, achieves the sparse minimax rate O(s log p/n) and circumvents Ritov et al.'s (2014) curse-of-dimensionalityappropriate ("CODA") critique of high-dimensional Bayesian inference by orthogonalizing the nuisance functions before the Bayesian step. (iii) A Bayesian difference-indifferences estimator with individual random effects  on the treatment indicator delivers  exactly; across 200 replications a panel simulation shows about a fourfold smaller individual-effect RMSE and near-oracle signdecision accuracy relative to two-way fixed effects (TWFE), which, giving one number for all units, is near chance. (iv) The excess decision regret of double machine learning (DML) relative to the personalized Bayes rule is non-negative, a weak-dominance result, with three identifiable sources: uncertainty, heterogeneity, and sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文论证平均处理效应（ATE）不适合个体决策，应改用获益概率（Probability of Benefit）作为估计目标。通过四个结果展示：ATE为正时多数人可能受害；提出结合Neyman正交残差化与生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）的高维贝叶斯方法，规避了维数灾难；贝叶斯双重差分估计量在个体效应估计上精度提升约四倍；双重机器学习的决策遗憾非负，来源可分解为不确定性、异质性和稀疏性。
AI.research_question: 正确的个体决策估计目标是什么？如何克服高维贝叶斯推断中的维数灾难问题？
AI.motivation: ATE作为条件期望，仅反映总体平均效果，可能误导个体决策（如ATE为正但多数个体受害）。现有方法（如TWFE、DML）在个体化推断中存在精度不足或决策遗憾问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稀疏效应异质性的层级贝叶斯模型（马蹄先验）；Neyman正交化；生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）；贝叶斯双重差分；双重机器学习的决策遗憾分析。
AI.method: （i）理论证明与反例演示；（ii）Neyman正交残差化 + 稀疏马蹄先验 + GBC的贝叶斯推断；（iii）贝叶斯双重差分（含个体处理效应随机效应）与TWFE模拟对比；（iv）DML与个性化贝叶斯决策规则的遗憾比较。
AI.findings: （i）ATE为正时，多数个体可能受害（兰开夏牛奶实验、RECOVERY地塞米松试验）；（ii）提出方法达到稀疏 minimax 速率 O(s log p/n)，规避高维贝叶斯CODA批评；（iii）贝叶斯DiD相比TWFE，个体效应RMSE降低约四倍，符号决策接近最优，TWFE接近随机猜测；（iv）DML的决策遗憾非负，来源为不确定性、异质性和稀疏性。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确区分ATE（总体参数）与获益概率（个体决策目标）的本质差异；提出规避高维贝叶斯维数灾难的正交化-贝叶斯框架；证明DML相对个性化贝叶斯规则的决策遗憾弱占优性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和临床医生提供个体化决策依据（获益概率），而非依赖可能误导的ATE；提供可操作的高维贝叶斯推断方法（正交化+GBC）和贝叶斯双重差分工具。

title: Navigating Artificial Intelligence in Education: Pathways to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
affiliations: , University of Groningen, University of Groningen, University of Groningen, University of Groningen, University of Groningen and University of Groningen

detail.title: Navigating Artificial Intelligence in Education: Pathways to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
detail.abstract:
The recent ranking of 28th in The World's Most International Universities 2025 demonstrates the University of Groningen's (UG) reputation for its high-quality, inclusive education serving diverse student populations and its commitment to fostering diversity and student success. However, recent developments threaten this progress through budget cuts that may lead to fewer educational opportunities, limited investment possibilities and reduced individual student support. Simultaneously, educators and students increasingly rely on Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools as convenient solutions amid limited resources, creating a critical intersection between digital technology adoption and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) principles.
This white paper emerges from collaborative work between two Communities of Practice at the UG —one focused on DEI in teaching and learning, another on AI in Education. The paper's objective is to promote ethical selection, development, and use of digital tools grounded in DEI principles that support educational practice at the UG. It aims to guide broader community discussion on ethical AI integration while representing educator concerns and offering practical strategies.
Presented in the paper are three main calls for action. The first promotes ethical selection and use of digital tools through criteria for inclusivity, accessibility, and sustainability. Also proposed is exploring educational applications for AI literacy via transparency, responsive professional development, and aligned policies. The third recommendation is to involve the UG community in ethical AI integration discussions within a structure of educators and policymakers. These recommendations aim to address the urgent need to ensure that the necessary digital systems serve diverse populations equitably.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份白皮书，基于格罗宁根大学两个实践社区的合作，提出在资源削减与AI普及背景下，应基于DEI（多样性、公平性与包容性）原则进行数字工具的伦理选择与使用。核心建议包括：制定包容性、可及性和可持续性的工具筛选标准；通过透明的AI素养教育、响应式教师发展和政策对齐来推广AI教育应用；以及让全体社区参与AI伦理整合的讨论。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限和AI工具普及的背景下，以DEI原则为指导，在格罗宁根大学实现数字工具和AI技术的伦理选择、开发与使用？
AI.motivation: 格罗宁根大学在国际化与包容性教育方面享有盛誉，但预算削减威胁着教育资源与学生支持；与此同时，教育者和学生日益依赖AI工具作为资源有限的便捷解决方案。这两个趋势的交汇催生了在数字技术采纳中融入DEI原则的迫切需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: DEI原则；AI教育伦理；包容性设计；技术采纳与教育公平理论
AI.method: 实践社区协作白皮书——基于"教学DEI"和"教育AI"两个实践社区的协作工作，提出行动呼吁与策略建议。
AI.findings: 提出了三项核心行动呼吁：1) 以包容性、可及性和可持续性为标准，伦理地选择和使用数字工具；2) 通过透明度、响应式专业发展和政策对齐，探索AI素养的教育应用；3) 在教师和决策者的结构化框架内，让UG社区参与AI伦理整合讨论。这些建议旨在确保数字系统公平服务多元人群。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DEI原则系统性地嵌入AI教育工具选择与使用的伦理框架中，为高等教育中数字技术与公平包容原则的交叉领域提供了实践导向的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为格罗宁根大学及类似高等教育机构提供了可操作的三项行动呼吁，包括具体的工具筛选标准、AI素养教育路径和社区参与机制，有助于在预算削减背景下维护教育公平与包容性。

title: Generative AI and Venture Scaling
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Management Department and Fundación Instituto de Empresa, S.L. - IE Business School

detail.title: Generative AI and Venture Scaling

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge support from the Spanish Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades and the Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative.

detail.abstract: A central challenge in venture scaling is that growing external output typically demands a corresponding increase in human and financial resources. This study investigates how the adoption of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) reshapes this relationship. Using a panel of U.S. software startups in 2018-2024 and a difference-in-differences design centered on ChatGPT’s release, we find that GenAI adoption does not significantly affect overall hiring or venture funding. Instead, GenAI-adopting startups experience greater adoption of complementary technologies and significant output growth, as reflected in increased website traffic and faster commercialization outcomes. While total headcount remains unchanged, GenAI adoption induces a compositional shift away from junior roles toward senior-level positions. This organizational change is reflected in an increase in internal promotions, suggesting that GenAI enhances the value of labor by accelerating upskilling and internal career advancement. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that GenAI allows nascent firms to accelerate scaling without a proportional expansion in headcount.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式人工智能（GenAI）如何改变初创企业规模化过程中外部产出与人力/财务资源之间的关系。通过对2018-2024年美国软件初创企业的面板数据以及以ChatGPT发布为中心的准自然实验分析，发现GenAI采纳并未显著影响整体招聘或融资，而是促进了互补技术采纳、产出增长（网站流量和商业化速度加快），并推动劳动力结构从初级岗位向高级岗位转变，同时增加了内部晋升。这表明GenAI使初创企业能够在不等比扩大人员规模的情况下加速规模化。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的采纳如何重塑初创企业外部产出与人力资源投入之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 企业规模化面临的核心挑战是：增长外部产出通常需要相应增加人力和财务资源。GenAI的出现可能改变这一关系，但缺乏系统性实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观、劳动力技能结构变迁、AI与组织变革理论
AI.method: 采用2018-2024年美国软件初创企业面板数据，以ChatGPT发布为外生冲击，使用双重差分（DID）设计进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）GenAI采纳未显著影响整体招聘或风险融资；（2）采纳GenAI的初创企业经历了互补技术采纳增加和显著的产出增长（网站流量增加、商业化速度加快）；（3）劳动力结构发生从初级岗位向高级岗位的转变；（4）内部晋升增加，表明GenAI通过加速技能提升和内部职业发展增强了劳动力的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GenAI在组织层面如何打破产出增长与人员扩张之间的传统绑定关系，提出了"GenAI驱动的规模化"新机制；丰富了AI对劳动力技能结构影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为初创企业管理者提供了GenAI采纳的战略价值证据：企业可以在不扩大团队规模的情况下实现更快的增长；提示投资者和政策制定者关注GenAI对劳动力市场结构和内部晋升路径的深远影响。

title: Low-Tech Sector, High-Complexity Innovation: Firm-Level Patent Specialisation in Türkiye's Dairy Industry

detail.title: Low-Tech Sector, High-Complexity Innovation: Firm-Level Patent Specialisation in Türkiye's Dairy Industry
detail.abstract: This article examines whether firms operating in conventionally low-technology sectors can develop measurable technological specialisation through production-system innovation. Focusing on Türkiye's dairy industry, the study analyses the patent and utility model portfolio of SÜTAŞ, one of the country's largest integrated dairy firms, for the period 2016-2024. Rather than treating patents as simple counts of inventive output, the article constructs a firm-level patent landscape by combining International Patent Classification codes, WIPO 35 technology fields, NACE sectoral correspondences, technology-intensity classifications, concentration indicators, diversity measures, portfolio similarity coefficients and relative technological specialisation indices. The analysis asks whether SÜTAŞ's patent portfolio reflects a narrow product-based food technology profile or a broader and more complex production-system architecture. The findings show that the firm's technological profile is not confined to dairy products or food chemistry. Instead, it is structured around a dual core of dairy product technologies and production-system engineering, including packaging, filling, transport, special machinery, heat treatment, hygiene, process control and resource-efficiency technologies. SÜTAŞ accounts for a substantial share of dairy-related patent and utility model applications in Türkiye and displays strong relative specialisation in A01J, A23C, B65B and B67C technology classes. The article contributes to low-tech innovation, firm-level innovation systems and patent landscape literatures by showing that low-technology sectoral classifications may conceal complex, cumulative and patentable technological capabilities at the firm level. The results also suggest that patent data can support technology mapping and industrial policy design in agrifood manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低科技行业企业能否通过生产系统创新形成可测量的技术专业化，以土耳其乳制品企业SÜTAŞ为例，通过专利组合分析发现其技术轮廓并非局限于食品领域，而是围绕乳制品技术与生产系统工程（包装、灌装、热处理、过程控制等）构建了双核心结构，揭示了低科技分类可能掩盖企业层面的复杂技术能力。
AI.research_question: 在传统上被归类为低技术部门的行业中，企业能否通过生产系统创新发展出可测量的技术专业化？
AI.motivation: 传统产业分类将乳制品行业归为低技术部门，但企业可能通过生产系统创新积累复杂技术能力，现有文献对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 低技术创新理论、企业层面创新系统理论、专利景观分析方法
AI.method: 以土耳其最大综合乳制品企业SÜTAŞ为案例，分析其2016-2024年专利和实用新型组合，构建企业层面专利景观，综合运用IPC分类、WIPO 35技术领域、NACE行业对应、技术强度分类、集中度指标、多样性指标、组合相似系数和相对技术专业化指数。
AI.findings: SÜTAŞ的技术轮廓并非局限于乳制品或食品化学，而是围绕乳制品技术与生产系统工程（包括包装、灌装、运输、专用机械、热处理、卫生、过程控制和资源效率技术）构成双核心结构；该公司占土耳其乳制品相关专利和实用新型申请的显著份额，在A01J、A23C、B65B和B67C技术类别中展现出强相对专业化。
AI.theory_contributions: 向低技术创新、企业层面创新系统和专利景观文献表明，低技术部门分类可能掩盖企业层面复杂、累积且可获得专利的技术能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 专利数据可支持农业食品制造业的技术图谱绘制和产业政策设计。

title: Spectral-Gap-Protected Non-Abelian Quantum Memory: Certified Exponential Lifetime via a Constructive Yang–Mills Mass Gap
affiliations: Universal Standard Axiom Corp

detail.title: Spectral-Gap-Protected Non-Abelian Quantum Memory: Certified Exponential Lifetime via a Constructive Yang–Mills Mass Gap
detail.abstract: We propose and analyze the Spectral-Gap-Protected Non-Abelian Quantum Memory (SGP-NQM), a cryogenic, large-scale quantum memory whose logical qubits are encoded in non-local Wilson-loop sectors of a three-dimensional lattice Yang–Mills (YM) simulator with gauge group SU(2) or SU(3). The central theoretical obstacle to certifying exponential memory lifetime has been the absence of a nonperturbative, constructive proof that the four-dimensional YM mass gap ∆YM > 0 is strictly positive with computable bounds. We demonstrate that a constructive solution to the Yang–Mills Existence and Mass Gap Millennium Prize Problem, supplied by the QASL-P framework, removes this obstacle in its entirety. Given constructive bounds ∆YM ≥ cG ΛMS (with cG explicitly computed for SU(2), SU(3)), we derive a rigorous continuum-to-lattice mapping guaranteeing a simulator spectral gap ∆eff ≥ f(∆YM), which implies: (i) exponential suppression of thermally activated error strings at Top ≪ Tc = ∆eff /kB; (ii) exponential scaling of logical lifetime τ (L, T) ≥ τ0 exp(γL) with system linear size L; and (iii) deterministic, specification-level reliability certification derived from first-principles QFT. We present two physical implementation routes (cold-atom Rydberg/alkalineearth optical lattices; superconducting Josephson-junction arrays), a five-criterion Compton-Class Safety certification (CCS-RH), and a concrete falsifiability protocol specifying experimental refutation conditions. The SGP-NQM constitutes the first quantum memory architecture whose reliability guarantee is anchored to a solved Millennium Prize problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于谱隙保护的非阿贝尔量子存储器（SGP-NQM），通过将逻辑量子比特编码在三维晶格杨-米尔斯模拟器的非局域威尔逊圈扇区中，借助四维杨-米尔斯质量间隙的构造性解（QASL-P框架），严格证明该存储器具有指数级寿命和可认证的可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何构造一种可严格证明具有指数级寿命、并且其可靠性可从第一性原理量子场论出发进行认证的大规模量子存储器？
AI.motivation: 量子存储器的可靠性认证长期缺乏非微扰的严格证明；杨-米尔斯存在性与质量间隙千禧年难题的构造性解为突破这一障碍提供了契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非阿贝尔规范场论、杨-米尔斯质量间隙、谱隙保护、Wilson-loop扇区编码、QASL-P框架、从连续到场论的晶格映射。
AI.method: 理论构造（连续到晶格的严格映射）+ 物理实现路线设计（冷原子/超导）+ 安全性认证标准（CCS-RH）+ 可证伪性协议。
AI.findings: (i) 热激发误差弦在低温下指数抑制；(ii) 逻辑寿命随系统尺寸呈指数增长；(iii) 基于第一性原理QFT的确定性可靠性认证首次实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将千禧年难题的解决与量子存储器可靠性严格证明建立直接联系；为规范场论在量子信息中的应用提供了非微扰框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两种可实验实现的物理实现路径（冷原子光晶格和超导约瑟夫森结阵列）；设计了五准则康普顿级安全认证（CCS-RH）和可证伪性实验协议。

title:
The Anticipatory Economy and Ambient Commerce 
AI, Geospatial Intelligence, and the Architecture of Presence-Triggered Trade
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The Anticipatory Economy and Ambient Commerce 
AI, Geospatial Intelligence, and the Architecture of Presence-Triggered Trade
detail.abstract: A new coordination logic is forming across retail, logistics, and consumer services: economic activity organized around predicted demand rather than confirmed orders. This paper names and traces that logic as the anticipatory economy and introduces ambient commerce as its consumerfacing expression. In ambient commerce, the act of signalling intent to go somewhere, entering a destination into a navigation application, triggers the entire service chain ahead of arrival. A grocery store sees the customer coming, confirms inventory, stages the order, and reserves a curbside slot before the car leaves the driveway. A restaurant receives arrival time, requests a menu decision, and has the order placed before the customer walks in. Every transaction is just in time. Every service is pre-positioned. The physical visit becomes the final step in a transaction already substantially complete. We trace the verified evidence base for this emerging system. Walmart's hurricane-stocking program, running continuously since 2004, established that demand correlation can drive supply decisions without causal explanation. The more consequential development is the agentic commerce infrastructure built between September 2025 and early 2026, when OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Stripe, PayPal, Visa, and Mastercard (Mastercard, 2026) launched competing transaction protocols allowing AI agents to discover, negotiate, and pay on a consumer's behalf in real time. McKinsey projects this channel will redirect 3 to 5 trillion dollars in global retail spending by 2030 (Roberts, 2025). We connect this evidence to classical economic theory (Hayek, Coase, North, Granovetter) and examine the implications for competition policy, data governance, and the participation of developing economies in standards-setting processes now underway.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预期经济"（anticipatory economy）与"环境商业"（ambient commerce）概念，论述了一种以预测需求而非确认订单为核心的新型协调逻辑，并分析了其经济理论根源、证据基础及政策影响。
AI.research_question: 以预测需求而非确认订单驱动的经济活动是如何形成、运作的，其对经济协调逻辑、竞争政策、数据治理及发展中国家参与标准制定有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统经济协调以确认订单为触发点，而新兴技术（导航应用、AI代理支付协议等）使得经济活动可以在消费者明确下单之前即被触发和完成。这一转变尚未被系统性命名和理论化，亟需概念构建与政策审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连接哈耶克（知识分散与价格信号）、科斯（交易成本）、诺斯（制度变迁）、格兰诺维特（嵌入性）等经典经济理论。
AI.method: 概念构建与理论论证，辅以案例证据（沃尔玛飓风库存计划）和行业数据（McKinsey预测、2025-2026年AI代理支付基础设施发展）进行验证。
AI.findings: （1）预期经济已成为现实，以预测需求驱动供应链的逻辑已从应急场景（沃尔玛飓风库存）扩展至日常消费；（2）2025-2026年间OpenAI、Google、Microsoft、Stripe等巨头推出的AI代理交易协议是关键的制度基础设施；（3）McKinsey预测该渠道到2030年将重塑3-5万亿美元零售支出；（4）这一转变对竞争政策、数据治理和发展中国家参与标准制定提出紧迫挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"预期经济"与"环境商业"作为新的经济协调逻辑分析框架，将数字技术引发的预测驱动型交易纳入经典制度经济学和经济社会学的理论视野。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售、物流、消费服务等领域的企业战略提供前瞻性框架；为竞争政策制定者、数据治理立法者以及参与全球数字贸易标准谈判的发展中国家提供政策参考。

detail.abstract: We generalize the time-varying parameter (TVP) framework for environments where parameters do not change only in time but in an arbitrary number of dimensions, such as across sectors or space. Each dimension is represented as a separate graph allowing for straightforward modeling and interpretation. We derive a closed-form solution to the associated least squares problem, study conditions under which it is unique, and show how the model can easily be modified to accommodate missing values and non-varying coefficients. Our empirical application to Phillips curve modeling illustrates inflation dynamics in multiple dimensions using the EU and US data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种广义时变参数框架，允许参数在任意多个维度（如时间、空间、行业）上变化，每个维度用独立图表示。推导了最小二乘问题的闭式解，研究了唯一性条件，并展示了如何处理缺失值和非时变系数。通过欧盟和美国数据的菲利普斯曲线建模实证，展示了多维度通胀动态分析。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个允许参数在多个维度（不仅是时间）上变化的广义TVP框架，并推导其闭式解？
AI.motivation: 传统TVP模型仅允许参数随时间变化，但现实经济中参数可能同时随行业、空间等多个维度变化，现有方法缺乏统一的多维建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时变参数模型、图结构表示、最小二乘闭式解、非时变系数约束
AI.method: 将每个维度表示为独立图，推导多维TVP模型最小二乘问题的闭式解，研究唯一性条件，扩展处理缺失值和非时变系数。
AI.findings: 1. 推导出多维TVP模型最小二乘问题的闭式解；2. 给出了解唯一性的条件；3. 模型可灵活处理缺失值和非时变系数；4. 实证显示该方法能有效捕捉欧盟和美国通胀的多维动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TVP框架从单一时间维度推广到任意多维度，提供了闭式解而非数值迭代，给出了唯一性条件的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家提供了一种可解释的多维参数变化建模工具，能同时分析时间、空间、行业等多个维度的动态关系，实证展示了在菲利普斯曲线分析中的应用价值。

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA

detail.abstract: This study examines evolving dynamics of Arab national security and forecasts developments over the next decade. It identifies key determinants, including political stability, economic resilience, military capability, and social cohesion, while accounting for geopolitical shifts, technological change, climate pressures, and global power realignments. Employing a qualitative survey design, the research draws on semi-structured interviews with 112 regional security and policy experts and applies thematic analysis. Findings indicate that limited regional cooperation and weak economic performance undermine Arab national security. Looking toward 2035, the study anticipates foreign intervention, internal instability, and significant changes in alliances and technological utilization. The research underscores the necessity of enhanced regional cooperation. It proposes strategic measures, including strengthened partnerships, increased investment in emerging technologies, and expanded intelligence sharing to improve collective security resilience across Arab states.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过定性访谈112位区域安全专家，分析了阿拉伯国家安全的演变动态，预测到2035年将面临外国干预、内部不稳定及联盟变化，提出加强区域合作、投资新兴技术和情报共享等战略措施。
AI.research_question: 阿拉伯国家安全的演变动态及其未来十年（至2035年）的发展趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯国家安全正受到地缘政治变化、技术变革、气候压力和全球权力重组等多重因素影响，需要系统性的前瞻性研究来识别关键决定因素并提出应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家安全理论、区域安全复合体理论、集体安全理论
AI.method: 定性调查研究，采用半结构化访谈法，访谈112位区域安全与政策专家，运用主题分析法进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 有限的区域合作和疲弱的经济表现削弱了阿拉伯国家安全；展望2035年，预计将出现外国干预、内部不稳定、联盟关系重大变化以及技术利用方式的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了区域安全研究视角，为阿拉伯国家安全的理论分析提供了经验证据，深化了对发展中国家集体安全机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了加强区域合作、投资新兴技术、扩大情报共享等具体战略措施，为阿拉伯国家的集体安全韧性建设提供了政策参考。

detail.abstract: Digital technologies have transformed economic and organisational systems, generating substantial gains in efficiency, connectivity, and innovation. However, an emerging consequence of digitalisation that remains insufficiently explored within economic discourse is digital fatigue. Existing research has primarily examined digital fatigue as a psychological, behavioural, or organisational phenomenon, while its broader implications for productivity sustainability remain under-theorised. This conceptual short communication addresses the research question: How can digital fatigue be conceptualised as a structural economic concern affecting productivity in digitally intensive economies? Adopting an interdisciplinary conceptual approach, the article synthesises insights from economics, psychology, neuroscience, organisational studies, media studies, and human-computer interaction research. The study develops a conceptual framework linking digital intensification, cognitive overload, attentional fragmentation, decision fatigue, and reduced cognitive recovery to challenges in productivity sustainability. By repositioning digital fatigue as a structural rather than purely individual concern, the article highlights its potential implications for labour quality, decision-making efficiency, innovation capacity, and longterm economic performance. The paper contributes to emerging debates on cognitive sustainability, the future of work, and digitally mediated economic systems, while proposing directions for future empirical and policy research.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字疲劳作为数字经济中一个结构性经济问题，如何影响生产力的可持续性，并提出了一个跨学科的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将数字疲劳概念化为影响数字密集型经济体生产力可持续性的结构性经济关切？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要将数字疲劳视为心理、行为或组织现象，但其对生产力可持续性的更广泛经济影响尚未得到充分理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字强化、认知超载、注意力碎片化、决策疲劳与认知恢复能力下降等概念，链接到生产力可持续性挑战。
AI.method: 跨学科概念性研究方法，综合经济学、心理学、神经科学、组织研究、媒体研究与人机交互研究等领域的洞见。
AI.findings: 将数字疲劳重新定位为结构性（而非纯粹个体性）问题，其对劳动力质量、决策效率、创新能力及长期经济绩效具有潜在影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出数字疲劳作为结构性经济关切的概念框架，拓展了认知可持续性与数字经济的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来关于认知可持续性、未来工作形态以及数字中介经济系统的实证研究与政策制定提供了方向。

detail.abstract: Despite Chinese progress, the United States remains for now ahead in the race for dominance over the so-called artificial intelligence hardware stack – the resources and equipment, especially semiconductors, needed to run AI models. US multinational Nvidia is the global market leader with the best-performing AI chips. It accounts for roughly half the world’s installed AI chip stock but as much as two thirds of installed computing capacity.

AI.tldr: 尽管中国取得进展，但美国目前在人工智能硬件堆栈（尤其是半导体）领域仍保持领先。英伟达作为全球市场领导者，占据全球AI芯片存量约一半，但安装的计算容量高达三分之二。
AI.research_question: 中美在AI硬件堆栈（特别是AI芯片和半导体领域）的竞争格局如何？
AI.motivation: 人工智能的全球竞争日益激烈，硬件堆栈是AI产业的基础，理解中美在该领域的相对地位具有重要的战略意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际竞争力理论、技术领先与追赶理论、半导体产业生态分析
AI.method: 基于市场数据和行业份额的实证分析
AI.findings: 美国目前仍领先中国；英伟达是全球AI芯片市场绝对主导者，占全球AI芯片存量约50%，但安装了全球约三分之二的计算容量，显示出其芯片性能优势。
